title: Mathematical analysis and symmetric fractional-order reduction method for diffusion-wave equations
summary: In this work, our aim is to introduce a symmetric fractional-order reduction (SFOR) method to develop numerical algorithms on nonuniform temporal meshes for fractional wave equations under lower regularity assumptions. The $L$-type methods--including $L1$ and $L2$-$1_σ$ schemes--are specifically designed for diffusion-wave equations, and we propose novel optimal parameter selections tailored to nonuniform meshes. Finally, several numerical experiments are conducted to validate the efficiency and accuracy of the algorithms.

title: Rethinking IRSTD: Single-Point Supervision Guided Encoder-only Framework is Enough for Infrared Small Target Detection
summary: Infrared small target detection (IRSTD) aims to separate small targets from clutter backgrounds. Extensive research is dedicated to the pixel-level supervision-guided "encoder-decoder" segmentation paradigm. Although having achieved promising performance, they neglect the fact that small targets only occupy a few pixels and are usually accompanied with blurred boundary caused by clutter backgrounds. Based on this observation, we argue that the first principle of IRSTD should be target localization instead of separating all target region accompanied with indistinguishable background noise. In this paper, we reformulate IRSTD as a centroid regression task and propose a novel Single-Point Supervision guided Infrared Probabilistic Response Encoding method (namely, SPIRE), which is indeed challenging due to the mismatch between reduced supervision network and equivalent output. Specifically, we first design a Point-Response Prior Supervision (PRPS), which transforms single-point annotations into probabilistic response map consistent with infrared point-target response characteristics, with a High-Resolution Probabilistic Encoder (HRPE) that enables encoder-only, end-to-end regression without decoder reconstruction. By preserving high-resolution features and increasing effective supervision density, SPIRE alleviates optimization instability under sparse target distributions. Finally, extensive experiments on various IRSTD benchmarks, including SIRST-UAVB and SIRST4 demonstrate that SPIRE achieves competitive target-level detection performance with consistently low false alarm rate (Fa) and significantly reduced computational cost. Code is publicly available at: https://github.com/NIRIXIANG/SPIRE-IRSTD.

title: TFRBench: A Reasoning Benchmark for Evaluating Forecasting Systems
summary: We introduce TFRBench, the first benchmark designed to evaluate the reasoning capabilities of forecasting systems. Traditionally, time-series forecasting has been evaluated solely on numerical accuracy, treating foundation models as ``black boxes.'' Unlike existing benchmarks, TFRBench provides a protocol for evaluating the reasoning generated by forecasting systems--specifically their analysis of cross-channel dependencies, trends, and external events. To enable this, we propose a systematic multi-agent framework that utilizes an iterative verification loop to synthesize numerically grounded reasoning traces. Spanning ten datasets across five domains, our evaluation confirms that this reasoning is causally effective; useful for evaluation; and prompting LLMs with our generated traces significantly improves forecasting accuracy compared to direct numerical prediction (e.g., avg. $\sim40.2\%\to56.6\%)$, validating the quality of our reasoning. Conversely, benchmarking experiments reveal that off-the-shelf LLMs consistently struggle with both reasoning (lower LLM-as-a-Judge scores) and numerical forecasting, frequently failing to capture domain-specific dynamics. TFRBench thus establishes a new standard for interpretable, reasoning-based evaluation in time-series forecasting. Our benchmark is available at: https://tfrbench.github.io

title: From Clues to Generation: Language-Guided Conditional Diffusion for Cross-Domain Recommendation
summary: Cross-domain Recommendation (CDR) exploits multi-domain correlations to alleviate data sparsity. As a core task within this field, inter-domain recommendation focuses on predicting preferences for users who interact in a source domain but lack behavioral records in a target domain. Existing approaches predominantly rely on overlapping users as anchors for knowledge transfer. In real-world scenarios, overlapping users are often scarce, leaving the vast majority of users with only single-domain interactions. For these users, the absence of explicit alignment signals makes fine-grained preference transfer intrinsically difficult. To address this challenge, this paper proposes Language-Guided Conditional Diffusion for CDR (LGCD), a novel framework that integrates Large Language Models (LLMs) and diffusion models for inter-domain sequential recommendation. Specifically, we leverage LLM reasoning to bridge the domain gap by inferring potential target preferences for single-domain users and mapping them to real items, thereby constructing pseudo-overlapping data. We distinguish between real and pseudo-interaction pathways and introduce additional supervision constraints to mitigate the semantic noise brought by pseudo-interaction. Furthermore, we design a conditional diffusion architecture to precisely guide the generation of target user representations based on source-domain patterns. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LGCD significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in inter-domain recommendation tasks.

title: 3DTurboQuant: Training-Free Near-Optimal Quantization for 3D Reconstruction Models
summary: Every existing method for compressing 3D Gaussian Splatting, NeRF, or transformer-based 3D reconstructors requires learning a data-dependent codebook through per-scene fine-tuning. We show this is unnecessary. The parameter vectors that dominate storage in these models, 45-dimensional spherical harmonics in 3DGS and 1024-dimensional key-value vectors in DUSt3R, fall in a dimension range where a single random rotation transforms any input into coordinates with a known Beta distribution. This makes precomputed, data-independent Lloyd-Max quantization near-optimal, within a factor of 2.7 of the information-theoretic lower bound. We develop 3D, deriving (1) a dimension-dependent criterion that predicts which parameters can be quantized and at what bit-width before running any experiment, (2) norm-separation bounds connecting quantization MSE to rendering PSNR per scene, (3) an entry-grouping strategy extending rotation-based quantization to 2-dimensional hash grid features, and (4) a composable pruning-quantization pipeline with a closed-form compression ratio. On NeRF Synthetic, 3DTurboQuant compresses 3DGS by 3.5x with 0.02dB PSNR loss and DUSt3R KV caches by 7.9x with 39.7dB pointmap fidelity. No training, no codebook learning, no calibration data. Compression takes seconds. The code will be released (https://github.com/JaeLee18/3DTurboQuant)

title: AI and Collective Decisions: Strengthening Legitimacy and Losers' Consent
summary: AI is increasingly used to scale collective decision-making, but far less attention has been paid to how such systems can support procedural legitimacy, particularly the conditions shaping losers' consent: whether participants who do not get their preferred outcome still accept it as fair. We ask: (1) how can AI help ground collective decisions in participants' different experiences and beliefs, and (2) whether exposure to these experiences can increase trust, understanding, and social cohesion even when people disagree with the outcome. We built a system that uses a semi-structured AI interviewer to elicit personal experiences on policy topics and an interactive visualization that displays predicted policy support alongside those voiced experiences. In a randomized experiment (n = 181), interacting with the visualization increased perceived legitimacy, trust in outcomes, and understanding of others' perspectives, even though all participants encountered decisions that went against their stated preferences. Our hope is that the design and evaluation of this tool spurs future researchers to focus on how AI can help not only achieve scale and efficiency in democratic processes, but also increase trust and connection between participants.

title: LLM-as-Judge for Semantic Judging of Powerline Segmentation in UAV Inspection
summary: The deployment of lightweight segmentation models on drones for autonomous power line inspection presents a critical challenge: maintaining reliable performance under real-world conditions that differ from training data. Although compact architectures such as U-Net enable real-time onboard inference, their segmentation outputs can degrade unpredictably in adverse environments, raising safety concerns. In this work, we study the feasibility of using a large language model (LLM) as a semantic judge to assess the reliability of power line segmentation results produced by drone-mounted models. Rather than introducing a new inspection system, we formalize a watchdog scenario in which an offboard LLM evaluates segmentation overlays and examine whether such a judge can be trusted to behave consistently and perceptually coherently. To this end, we design two evaluation protocols that analyze the judge's repeatability and sensitivity. First, we assess repeatability by repeatedly querying the LLM with identical inputs and fixed prompts, measuring the stability of its quality scores and confidence estimates. Second, we evaluate perceptual sensitivity by introducing controlled visual corruptions (fog, rain, snow, shadow, and sunflare) and analyzing how the judge's outputs respond to progressive degradation in segmentation quality. Our results show that the LLM produces highly consistent categorical judgments under identical conditions while exhibiting appropriate declines in confidence as visual reliability deteriorates. Moreover, the judge remains responsive to perceptual cues such as missing or misidentified power lines, even under challenging conditions. These findings suggest that, when carefully constrained, an LLM can serve as a reliable semantic judge for monitoring segmentation quality in safety-critical aerial inspection tasks.

title: HDG Methods for the two-dimensional Vector Laplacian
summary: We introduce new hybridizable discontinuous Galerkin (HDG) methods for solving the two-dimensional vector Laplacian equation under three types of boundary conditions: electric, magnetic, and Dirichlet. The method is formulated on a first-order system form of the equations, in which the rotational and divergence of the electric field are introduced as auxiliary variables. We study the well-posedness of the method and prove that, when using piecewise polynomial approximations of degree $k \geq 0$, the error in the $L^2$ norm of the electric field converges at the optimal rate of $k+1$. Additionally, we prove that the $L^2$-errors of the auxiliary variables, the rotational and divergence, converge with order $k + 1/2$. We also show that the methods can be implemented in three different forms, corresponding to three distinct hybridizations based on the choice of the globally coupled unknowns among the numerical traces defined on the mesh skeleton. Finally, we provide numerical tests that not only validate the theoretical convergence rates but also consistently showcase the optimal convergence across all variables.

title: LMI-Net: Linear Matrix Inequality--Constrained Neural Networks via Differentiable Projection Layers
summary: Linear matrix inequalities (LMIs) have played a central role in certifying stability, robustness, and forward invariance of dynamical systems. Despite rapid development in learning-based methods for control design and certificate synthesis, existing approaches often fail to preserve the hard matrix inequality constraints required for formal guarantees. We propose LMI-Net, an efficient and modular differentiable projection layer that enforces LMI constraints by construction. Our approach lifts the set defined by LMI constraints into the intersection of an affine equality constraint and the positive semidefinite cone, performs the forward pass via Douglas-Rachford splitting, and supports efficient backward propagation through implicit differentiation. We establish theoretical guarantees that the projection layer converges to a feasible point, certifying that LMI-Net transforms a generic neural network into a reliable model satisfying LMI constraints. Evaluated on experiments including invariant ellipsoid synthesis and joint controller-and-certificate design for a family of disturbed linear systems, LMI-Net substantially improves feasibility over soft-constrained models under distribution shift while retaining fast inference speed, bridging semidefinite-program-based certification and modern learning techniques.

title: DAT: Dual-Aware Adaptive Transmission for Efficient Multimodal LLM Inference in Edge-Cloud Systems
comments: 10 pages, 6 figures. Submitted to ACM Multimedia 2026
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown strong capability in semantic understanding and visual reasoning, yet their use on continuous video streams in bandwidth-constrained edge-cloud systems incurs prohibitive computation and communication overhead and hinders low-latency alerting and effective visual evidence delivery. To address this challenge, we propose DAT to achieve high-quality semantic generation, low-latency event alerting, and effective visual evidence supplementation. To reduce unnecessary deep reasoning costs, we propose a collaborative small-large model cascade. A lightweight edge-side small model acts as a gating module to filter non-target-event frames and perform object detection, triggering MLLM inference only for suspicious frames. Building on this, we introduce an efficient fine-tuning strategy with visual guidance and semantic prompting, which improves structured event understanding, object detection, and output consistency. To ensure low-latency semantic alerting and effective visual evidence supplementation under bandwidth constraints, we further devise a semantics and bandwidth-aware multi-stream adaptive transmission optimization method. Experimental results show that DAT achieves 98.83% recognition accuracy and 100% output consistency. Under severe congestion, it reduces weighted semantic alert delay by up to 77.5% and delivers 98.33% of visual evidence within 0.5 s, demonstrating the effectiveness of jointly optimizing cascade inference and elastic transmission.

title: To Defer or To Shift? The Role of AI Data Center Flexibility on Grid Interconnection
summary: The integration of AI data centers into power grid represents one of the most emerging and complex challenges for the energy systems. As computational demand scales at an unprecedented rate, the traditional grid planning study's paradigm of treating data centers as rigid, inflexible loads is becoming economically, mathematically and operationally untenable. This work tries to understand and address the large load interconnection bottleneck by modeling and evaluating AI load flexibility. By examining data center's temporal and spatial shifting capabilities within a grid capacity expansion framework, we build a quantitative grid planning model, and evaluate their impacts on additional generation, operational costs, and network congestion. Numerical study reveals interesting observations, as AI data center flexibility are not felt consistently, and increasing flexibility does not necessarily translate to less generation capacity required. Depending on data center's locations, flexibility range, and grid load conditions, flexible AI load can help reduce grid investment and operational costs by 3-21%. Our work also indicate that longer deferral time of AI compute has diminishing returns for offloading grid electricity dispatch pressure.

title: UAVReason: A Unified, Large-Scale Benchmark for Multimodal Aerial Scene Reasoning and Generation
summary: Vision-Language models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capability in ground-view visual understanding but often fracture when deployed on high-altitude Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). The failure largely stems from a pronounced domain shift, characterized by tiny and densely packed objects, repetitive textures, and ambiguous top-down orientations. These factors severely disrupt semantic grounding and hinder both spatial reasoning and controllable generation. To bridge this critical gap, we introduce UAVReason, the first unified large-scale multi-modal benchmark dedicated to nadir-view UAV scenarios, derived from a high-fidelity UAV simulation platform. In contrast to existing UAV benchmarks, which are largely siloed and focus on single tasks like object detection or segmentation, UAVReason uniquely consolidates over 273K Visual Question Answering (VQA) pairs, including 23.6K single frames with detailed captions, 68.2K 2-frame temporal sequences, and 188.8K cross-modal generation samples. The benchmark probes 22 diverse reasoning types across spatial and temporal axes while simultaneously evaluating high-fidelity generation across RGB, depth, and segmentation modalities. We further establish a strong, unified baseline model via multi-task learning. Extensive experiments validate the efficacy of our unified approach across diverse metrics, such as EM/F1 for VQA, mIoU for segmentation, and CLIP Score for generation. These results indicate limitations of general-domain vision-language models and show that unified multi-task learning substantially improves UAV-native performance. All data, code, and evaluation tools will be publicly released to advance UAV multimodal research.

title: ICR-Drive: Instruction Counterfactual Robustness for End-to-End Language-Driven Autonomous Driving
summary: Recent progress in vision-language-action (VLA) models has enabled language-conditioned driving agents to execute natural-language navigation commands in closed-loop simulation, yet standard evaluations largely assume instructions are precise and well-formed. In deployment, instructions vary in phrasing and specificity, may omit critical qualifiers, and can occasionally include misleading, authority-framed text, leaving instruction-level robustness under-measured. We introduce ICR-Drive, a diagnostic framework for instruction counterfactual robustness in end-to-end language-conditioned autonomous driving. ICR-Drive generates controlled instruction variants spanning four perturbation families: Paraphrase, Ambiguity, Noise, and Misleading, where Misleading variants conflict with the navigation goal and attempt to override intent. We replay identical CARLA routes under matched simulator configurations and seeds to isolate performance changes attributable to instruction language. Robustness is quantified using standard CARLA Leaderboard metrics and per-family performance degradation relative to the baseline instruction. Experiments on LMDrive and BEVDriver show that minor instruction changes can induce substantial performance drops and distinct failure modes, revealing a reliability gap for deploying embodied foundation models in safety-critical driving.

AI.result: 实验表明，对指令进行微小改动会导致 LMDrive 和 BEVDriver 模型性能显著下降，并引发特定的失效模式，证实了现有模型在安全性要求极高的场景中存在显著的可靠性缺口。
AI.conclusion: ICR-Drive 揭示了当前端到端语言驱动自动驾驶模型在指令鲁棒性上的重大缺陷，即微小的指令变化即可导致严重的性能下降，强调了在部署前进行鲁棒性诊断的必要性。
AI.translation: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的最新进展使得语言驱动的自动驾驶智能体能够在闭环仿真中执行自然语言导航指令，但现有的标准评估大多假设指令是精确且规范的。在实际部署中，指令的措辞和具体程度各异，可能遗漏关键限定词，甚至偶尔包含误导性或权威框架的文本，这使得指令层面的鲁棒性未得到充分衡量。我们引入了 ICR-Drive，这是一个用于端到端语言驱动自动驾驶中指令反事实鲁棒性的诊断框架。ICR-Drive 生成涵盖四类扰动的受控指令变体：改写、歧义、噪声和误导，其中误导性变体与导航目标冲突并试图覆盖意图。我们在匹配的模拟器配置和随机种子下重放相同的 CARLA 路线，以隔离由指令语言导致的性能变化。鲁棒性通过标准的 CARLA 排行榜指标以及相对于基准指令的各类别性能下降来量化。在 LMDrive 和 BEVDriver 上的实验表明，微小的指令变化可能导致性能大幅下降和明显的失效模式，揭示了在安全关键型驾驶中部署具身基础模型的可靠性缺口。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 ICR-Drive 框架，旨在诊断端到端语言驱动自动驾驶模型的指令鲁棒性。通过引入四种类型的指令扰动，研究发现现有模型在面对多样化或误导性指令时表现脆弱，性能下降明显，为提升自动驾驶系统的安全性提供了评估基准。
AI.keywords: 自动驾驶, 语言模型, 指令鲁棒性, 反事实推理, 鲁棒性评估
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地引入了反事实推理框架来评估自动驾驶模型的指令鲁棒性，揭示了当前大模型在处理非理想指令时的脆弱性。其局限在于主要在CARLA仿真环境中验证，真实物理场景下的表现仍有待观察。这项工作对于提升自动驾驶系统的安全性和可靠性具有重要意义。

title: Retrieve-then-Adapt: Retrieval-Augmented Test-Time Adaptation for Sequential Recommendation
summary: The sequential recommendation (SR) task aims to predict the next item based on users' historical interaction sequences. Typically trained on historical data, SR models often struggle to adapt to real-time preference shifts during inference due to challenges posed by distributional divergence and parameterized constraints. Existing approaches to address this issue include test-time training, test-time augmentation, and retrieval-augmented fine-tuning. However, these methods either introduce significant computational overhead, rely on random augmentation strategies, or require a carefully designed two-stage training paradigm. In this paper, we argue that the key to effective test-time adaptation lies in achieving both effective augmentation and efficient adaptation. To this end, we propose Retrieve-then-Adapt (ReAd), a novel framework that dynamically adapts a deployed SR model to the test distribution through retrieved user preference signals. Specifically, given a trained SR model, ReAd first retrieves collaboratively similar items for a test user from a constructed collaborative memory database. A lightweight retrieval learning module then integrates these items into an informative augmentation embedding that captures both collaborative signals and prediction-refinement cues. Finally, the initial SR prediction is refined via a fusion mechanism that incorporates this embedding. Extensive experiments across five benchmark datasets demonstrate that ReAd consistently outperforms existing SR methods.

AI.title_translation: 检索后调整：用于序列推荐的检索增强测试时自适应
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为Retrieve-then-Adapt (ReAd)的新框架，用于解决序列推荐模型在测试时难以适应用户偏好变化的问题。ReAd通过检索用户偏好信号来动态调整已部署的模型，通过整合协同过滤相似项和预测细化线索来生成增强嵌入，并以此来优化初始预测。实验证明ReAd在多个数据集上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 序列推荐模型在推理时难以适应用户偏好变化，这源于分布差异和参数化约束。现有方法计算开销大、依赖随机策略或需要复杂的两阶段训练。
AI.method: 提出Retrieve-then-Adapt (ReAd)框架，首先从协同记忆数据库中检索与测试用户协同相似的物品，然后利用轻量级检索学习模块将这些物品整合为包含协同信号和预测细化线索的增强嵌入，最后通过融合机制结合该嵌入来优化初始推荐预测。
AI.result: 在五个基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，ReAd持续优于现有的序列推荐方法。
AI.conclusion: ReAd通过动态检索用户偏好信号，实现了有效的增强和高效的适应，解决了序列推荐模型在测试时适应性差的问题，并在实验中取得了优于现有方法的性能。
AI.translation: 序列推荐（SR）任务旨在根据用户历史交互序列预测下一个物品。SR模型通常在历史数据上进行训练，但由于分布差异和参数化约束的挑战，在推理过程中很难适应实时偏好变化。解决此问题的现有方法包括测试时训练、测试时增强和检索增强微调。然而，这些方法要么引入显著的计算开销，要么依赖于随机增强策略，要么需要精心设计的两阶段训练范式。在本文中，我们认为有效进行测试时自适应的关键在于实现有效的增强和高效的适应。为此，我们提出了Retrieve-then-Adapt (ReAd)，一个新颖的框架，通过检索到的用户偏好信号动态地将已部署的SR模型适应于测试分布。具体来说，给定一个训练好的SR模型，ReAd首先从构建的协同记忆数据库中检索与测试用户协同相似的物品。然后，一个轻量级的检索学习模块将这些物品整合为包含协同信号和预测细化线索的信息增强嵌入。最后，通过结合该嵌入的融合机制来优化初始SR预测。跨五个基准数据集的广泛实验表明，ReAd持续优于现有的SR方法。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了Retrieve-then-Adapt (ReAd)框架，用于解决序列推荐模型在测试时适应用户偏好变化的问题。ReAd通过检索协同相似物品并将其整合为增强嵌入，来动态调整模型，从而在不显著增加计算开销或依赖随机策略的情况下提高预测精度。实验结果表明ReAd在多个数据集上表现优异。
AI.keywords: 序列推荐, 测试时自适应, 检索增强, 用户偏好, 协同过滤
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的检索增强测试时自适应方法（ReAd），用于序列推荐。其核心创新在于动态地利用检索到的用户偏好信号来适应测试分布，解决了现有方法计算开销大或策略随机的问题。该方法通过整合协同信号和预测细化线索来生成有效的增强嵌入，并成功地提高了模型的适应性。实验结果令人信服，表明ReAd在实际应用中具有潜力。

title: WSCM-Lite: A Practitioner-Ready Implementation of the Weak Signal Cultivation Model
comments: 15 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables, 1 appendix. Companion paper to arXiv:2604.01495. Excel simulator and supplementary materials at https://github.com/emmgonai/wscm-lite
summary: The Weak Signal Cultivation Model (WSCM) provides a mathematically rigorous framework for tracking frontline risk signals across a two-dimensional coordinate field using 15 equations and 16 tunable parameters. While this specification is designed for eventual software implementation, its computational requirements create an adoption barrier for organizations whose available infrastructure is a spreadsheet. This paper introduces WSCM-Lite, a lookup-table implementation that reproduces the full WSCM's coordinate trajectories within 0.01 field units while eliminating all exponential functions, state-dependent tracking, and free parameters. The simplification replaces continuous recency weighting with a four-row lookup table and removes consensus momentum and reversal amplification entirely, reducing the specification to seven formulas and five hardcoded constants. A 26-session worked example using the Gas Fumes signal from the parent paper demonstrates that WSCM-Lite traverses the same four-region path (Question Marks --> Lit Fuses --> Owls --> Sleeping Cats --> Question Marks) and triggers SMS escalation within two sessions of the full model. Five additional scenarios validate boundary behavior, and a sensitivity analysis confirms stability under +/-30% gap threshold variation. An accompanying Excel simulator and supplementary materials are publicly available at https://github.com/emmgonai/wscm-lite.
comment: 15 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables, 1 appendix. Companion paper to arXiv:2604.01495. Excel simulator and supplementary materials at https://github.com/emmgonai/wscm-lite

AI.title_translation: WSCM-Lite：一种面向实践者的弱信号培育模型实现方案
AI.tldr: WSCM-Lite 将复杂的弱信号培育模型简化为易于在电子表格中部署的查表实现，在保持高精度的同时消除了计算障碍。
AI.motivation: 原版弱信号培育模型（WSCM）计算要求过高，导致依赖电子表格等基础工具的组织难以应用。
AI.method: 提出 WSCM-Lite，将原模型的 15 个方程和 16 个参数简化为 7 个公式和 5 个固定常量；利用查表法替代指数函数和状态依赖追踪，并通过 Excel 模拟器进行验证。
AI.result: WSCM-Lite 在 0.01 场域单位的误差范围内复现了原模型的坐标轨迹，且在风险信号升级触发方面与原模型高度一致（相差不超过两个会话周期）。
AI.conclusion: WSCM-Lite 成功证明了在不依赖复杂计算基础设施的情况下，能够以极高的精度复现 WSCM 的核心功能，是企业进行风险信号监测的实用工具。
AI.translation: 弱信号培育模型（WSCM）提供了一个数学严谨的框架，用于通过 15 个方程和 16 个可调参数在二维坐标场中追踪前沿风险信号。虽然该规范旨在最终实现软件化，但其计算要求为那些仅具备电子表格基础设施的组织创造了应用壁垒。本文介绍了 WSCM-Lite，这是一种查表实现，它在 0.01 场域单位内复现了完整 WSCM 的坐标轨迹，同时消除了所有指数函数、状态相关追踪和自由参数。该简化版用四行查找表取代了连续近因加权，并完全移除了共识动量和反转放大，将规范简化为 7 个公式和 5 个硬编码常量。通过使用父论文中“煤气烟雾”信号进行的 26 次会话工作示例表明，WSCM-Lite 遍历了相同的四个区域路径，并且在触发短信升级方面与完整模型相差不超过两个会话。五个额外的场景验证了边界行为，敏感性分析证实了其在 +/-30% 间隙阈值变化下的稳定性。随附的 Excel 模拟器和补充材料可在 https://github.com/emmgonai/wscm-lite 公开获取。
AI.summary: WSCM-Lite 是一种轻量级的风险信号追踪实现方案，旨在解决原版弱信号培育模型计算复杂度高的问题。通过简化公式、移除状态依赖并引入查表法，WSCM-Lite 在保持与原模型极高的一致性和稳定性的同时，显著降低了部署难度。
AI.keywords: 弱信号培育模型, 风险监测, 查表法, WSCM-Lite, 简化模型
AI.comments: 该论文通过简化复杂的数学模型，极大地降低了前沿风险信号追踪技术的应用门槛，对于资源有限的企业具有极高的实用价值。其创新点在于通过查表法而非复杂的计算公式来逼近原模型，展示了理论模型向工程实践转化的优秀案例。

title: SpeakSoftly: Scaffolding Nonviolent Communication in Intimate Relationships through LLM-Powered Just-In-Time Interventions
summary: Conflicts are common in text-based communication, particularly in intimate relationships, where misunderstandings can easily escalate into verbal aggression. To address this, we present SpeakSoftly, a system that applies Nonviolent Communication (NVC) principles to scaffold couples' conflict communication through LLM-powered just-in-time interventions. Informed by formative interviews with couples and NVC principles, we designed two core features: NVC-Prompt, which detects verbal aggression and suggests revisions to prevent escalation, and NVC-Guide, which analyzes dialogues to uncover users' feelings and needs, fostering self-awareness and perspective-taking. These features were implemented across three progressive intervention modes, each varying in intervention depth and tone: Basic Reminder, Neutral Guide, and Empathetic Guide. We conducted a mixed-methods user study with 18 couples across simulated and real-life conflict settings to evaluate the effectiveness of each mode. Results showed that Empathetic Guide significantly facilitated both behavioral and cognitive changes, while Neutral Guide was effective only for behavioral changes in simulated conflicts. In real-life conflicts, Neutral Guide showed distinct advantages due to lower cognitive load demands. We discuss the mechanisms behind these findings and propose design implications for in-situ interventions in high-stakes communication contexts.

AI.title_translation: SpeakSoftly：通过LLM驱动的即时干预来促进亲密关系中的非暴力沟通
AI.tldr: SpeakSoftly是一个利用大型语言模型（LLM）在亲密关系冲突中提供即时干预的系统，旨在促进非暴力沟通（NVC）。它包含两个主要功能：NVC-Prompt用于检测和修改攻击性语言，NVC-Guide用于分析对话以识别感受和需求。研究发现，‘共情引导’模式在行为和认知上都有效，而‘中性引导’模式在模拟冲突中仅对行为有效，在现实冲突中因认知负荷低而更具优势。
AI.motivation: 亲密关系中的文本沟通常因误解而升级为言语攻击，需要一种方法来促进非暴力沟通（NVC）。
AI.method: 设计了SpeakSoftly系统，包含NVC-Prompt（检测攻击性语言并建议修改）和NVC-Guide（分析对话以识别感受和需求）。系统有三种干预模式：基础提醒、中性引导和共情引导。通过包含18对夫妇的混合方法用户研究来评估这些模式在模拟和现实冲突中的效果。
AI.result: ‘共情引导’模式显著促进了行为和认知改变。‘中性引导’模式在模拟冲突中仅对行为改变有效，但在现实冲突中因认知负荷低而显示出优势。研究还讨论了这些发现背后的机制和对情境干预设计的启示。
AI.conclusion: SpeakSoftly系统，特别是‘共情引导’模式，能够有效地促进亲密关系中冲突沟通的行为和认知改变。‘中性引导’模式在现实冲突场景中更具优势。研究为在高风险沟通情境中进行情境干预提供了设计启示。
AI.translation: 冲突在基于文本的沟通中很常见，尤其是在亲密关系中，误解很容易升级为言语攻击。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了SpeakSoftly，一个应用非暴力沟通（NVC）原则，通过LLM驱动的即时干预来引导夫妻冲突沟通的系统。基于与夫妻的形成性访谈和NVC原则，我们设计了两个核心功能：NVC-Prompt，它检测言语攻击并提出修改建议以防止升级；以及NVC-Guide，它分析对话以揭示用户的感受和需求，从而促进自我意识和换位思考。这些功能被实现在三种渐进的干预模式中，每种模式在干预深度和语气上有所不同：基础提醒、中性引导和共情引导。我们进行了一项混合方法的였다s研究，有18对夫妇参与，在模拟和现实生活冲突场景中评估了每种模式的有效性。结果表明，共情引导模式显著促进了行为和认知改变，而中性引导模式仅在模拟冲突中对行为改变有效。在现实冲突中，中性引导模式由于认知负荷要求较低而显示出独特的优势。我们讨论了这些发现背后的机制，并为高风险沟通情境中的情境干预提出了设计启示。
AI.summary: SpeakSoftly是一个创新的LLM驱动系统，旨在通过即时干预来改善亲密关系中的冲突沟通，并推广非暴力沟通（NVC）原则。该系统通过NVC-Prompt检测和修正攻击性言论，并通过NVC-Guide帮助用户识别感受和需求。用户研究表明，‘共情引导’模式在行为和认知层面均有效，而‘中性引导’模式在现实冲突中因其较低的认知负荷而表现出优势，为在高风险沟通环境中设计有效的干预措施提供了宝贵的见解。
AI.keywords: 非暴力沟通, LLM, 亲密关系, 冲突沟通, 即时干预
AI.comments: 这项研究提出了一个非常有前景的系统SpeakSoftly，它利用LLM来支持亲密关系中的非暴力沟通。该研究设计了两种核心功能（NVC-Prompt和NVC-Guide）和三种不同的干预模式，并通过用户研究进行了全面的评估。研究结果具有实际意义，特别是关于不同干预模式在不同冲突情境下的有效性差异。然而，研究可以进一步探讨长期效果、用户接受度的个体差异以及潜在的伦理问题。

title: Towards Effective In-context Cross-domain Knowledge Transfer via Domain-invariant-neurons-based Retrieval
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have made notable progress in logical reasoning, yet still fall short of human-level performance. Current boosting strategies rely on expert-crafted in-domain demonstrations, limiting their applicability in expertise-scarce domains, such as specialized mathematical reasoning, formal logic, or legal analysis. In this work, we demonstrate the feasibility of leveraging cross-domain demonstrating examples to boost the LLMs' reasoning performance. Despite substantial domain differences, many reusable implicit logical structures are shared across domains. In order to effectively retrieve cross-domain examples for unseen domains under investigation, in this work, we further propose an effective retrieval method, called domain-invariant neurons-based retrieval (\textbf{DIN-Retrieval}). Concisely, DIN-Retrieval first summarizes a hidden representation that is universal across different domains. Then, during the inference stage, we use the DIN vector to retrieve structurally compatible cross-domain demonstrations for the in-context learning. Experimental results in multiple settings for the transfer of mathematical and logical reasoning demonstrate that our method achieves an average improvement of 1.8 over the state-of-the-art methods \footnote{Our implementation is available at https://github.com/Leon221220/DIN-Retrieval}.

AI.title_translation: 通过基于领域不变神经元的检索实现有效的上下文跨领域知识迁移
AI.tldr: 通过提取领域通用的隐层表征（DIN向量），实现跨领域示例检索，有效提升大模型在专家数据稀缺领域的推理性能。
AI.motivation: 当前提升大模型推理能力的策略过度依赖特定领域的专家示例，导致在专家数据稀缺的领域（如法律、专业数学）应用受限。作者旨在探索利用跨领域示例来提升大模型推理性能的可行性。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为 DIN-Retrieval 的方法。首先通过分析总结出跨领域通用的隐层表征，构建“领域不变神经元”（DIN）向量；在推理阶段，利用该向量检索结构上兼容的跨领域示例作为上下文学习的演示。
AI.result: 在数学和逻辑推理的跨领域迁移设置中，DIN-Retrieval 相比现有最先进方法平均提升了 1.8 个性能点。
AI.conclusion: DIN-Retrieval 证明了跨领域推理知识的可迁移性，为在缺乏专家数据的领域提升大模型推理能力提供了一种高效的检索策略。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLMs）在逻辑推理方面取得了显著进展，但仍未达到人类水平。当前的提升策略依赖于专家精心制作的领域内演示，限制了它们在专家稀缺领域（如专门的数学推理、形式逻辑或法律分析）的适用性。在这项工作中，我们证明了利用跨领域演示示例来提升大模型推理性能的可行性。尽管领域差异很大，但许多可重用的隐式逻辑结构在不同领域间是共享的。为了有效地为所研究的未见领域检索跨领域示例，我们进一步提出了一种有效的检索方法，称为基于领域不变神经元的检索（DIN-Retrieval）。简单来说，DIN-Retrieval 首先总结出一个在不同领域通用的隐层表征。然后，在推理阶段，我们使用 DIN 向量为上下文学习检索结构兼容的跨领域演示。在数学和逻辑推理迁移的多种设置下的实验结果表明，我们的方法比最先进的方法平均提高了 1.8。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为 DIN-Retrieval 的方法，旨在通过跨领域示例增强大模型的推理能力。通过提取领域不变的神经元（DIN）向量来识别不同领域间共享的隐式逻辑结构，该方法能够从不同领域检索到结构兼容的演示示例，从而在专家数据稀缺的领域有效提升大模型的推理表现。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 上下文学习, 跨领域知识迁移, 领域不变神经元, 提示工程
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地利用跨领域知识迁移来解决专家数据稀缺问题，通过识别领域不变的逻辑结构（DIN向量）来提升LLM推理能力，为少样本学习提供了新思路。限制在于该方法依赖于对模型内部表征的分析，可能对不同架构的模型通用性有待验证。

title: Transient Non-Use: How People in Migration Experience Digital Disconnection
summary: People experiencing migration endure many transitions across borders, technologies, and social systems. While HCI research often emphasizes this community's adoption of technology, less attention has been paid to practices of technological non-use. This paper investigates how information and communication technologies (ICTs) are intentionally and unintentionally avoided, withheld, or not used during migration. Drawing on interviews with 32 people experiencing migration in the border city of El Paso, Texas, USA between February and May 2025, we identify a range of non-use experiences, including device, informational, and protective non-use. We extend the concept of non-use by situating it within the three phases of transitions: understanding, negotiating, and resolving. We show how ICT non-use shifts with time, risk, and institutional demands. Our analysis demonstrates that non-use functions both as a protective strategy and as a response to systemic exclusion, and concludes with design principles that anticipate non-use as both intentional and unintentional design conditions rather than as punitive failure.

AI.title_translation: 瞬时非使用：移民人群如何经历数字断联
AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了移民人群在经历边境、技术和社会系统过渡时，如何有意或无意地避免、拒绝或不使用信息通信技术（ICTs），并提出了考虑非使用作为设计条件的原则。
AI.motivation: HCI研究通常侧重于移民社区对技术的采纳，但对技术非使用实践的关注较少。本研究旨在填补这一空白，调查移民过程中ICTs被避免、拒绝或不使用的原因和方式。
AI.method: 在2025年2月至5月期间，对美国德克萨斯州边境城市埃尔帕索的32名移民进行了访谈。通过访谈，识别了一系列非使用体验，并将非使用概念置于过渡的三个阶段（理解、协商、解决）中进行扩展。
AI.result: 研究识别了包括设备、信息和保护性非使用在内的一系列非使用体验。结果表明，ICT非使用随时间、风险和机构需求而变化。分析显示，非使用既是一种保护策略，也是对系统性排斥的回应。
AI.conclusion: 非使用既可以作为一种保护策略，也可以是对系统性排斥的回应。研究最后提出了设计原则，将非使用视为有意和无意的设计条件，而非惩罚性失败。
AI.translation: 经历移民的人们在跨越边境、技术和社会系统时会经历许多转变。虽然人机交互（HCI）研究通常强调这个群体对技术的采纳，但对技术非使用实践的关注较少。本文调查了在移民过程中信息和通信技术（ICTs）是如何被有意和无意地避免、拒绝或不使用的。我们对2025年2月至5月期间在美国德克萨斯州边境城市埃尔帕索的32名经历移民的人进行了访谈，并在此基础上识别了一系列非使用体验，包括设备、信息和保护性非使用。我们通过将非使用置于过渡的三个阶段：理解、协商和解决中来扩展非使用概念。我们展示了ICT非使用如何随时间、风险和机构需求而变化。我们的分析表明，非使用既是一种保护策略，也是对系统性排斥的回应，并以设计原则作结，这些原则将非使用视为有意和无意的设计条件，而非惩罚性失败。
AI.summary: 本研究探讨了移民人群在边境、技术和社会系统过渡期间的数字断联体验，即信息通信技术（ICTs）的有意或无意非使用。通过对美国埃尔帕索32名移民的访谈，论文识别了设备、信息和保护性非使用等多种非使用形式，并将其置于理解、协商和解决的过渡阶段中。研究发现ICT非使用随时间、风险和机构需求变化，既是保护策略也是对系统性排斥的回应，并提出了将非使用视为设计条件的设计原则。
AI.keywords: 移民, 数字断联, 非使用, ICT, 人机交互
AI.comments: 本研究通过关注移民群体的“非使用”而非“采纳”技术，为HCI领域提供了新的视角。其创新之处在于将非使用置于过渡阶段的语境中，并揭示了非使用作为保护策略和对系统性排斥回应的双重功能，对未来设计具有重要指导意义。

title: Data-Driven Function Calling Improvements in Large Language Model for Online Financial QA
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have been incorporated into numerous industrial applications. Meanwhile, a vast array of API assets is scattered across various functions in the financial domain. An online financial question-answering system can leverage both LLMs and private APIs to provide timely financial analysis and information. The key is equipping the LLM model with function calling capability tailored to a financial scenario. However, a generic LLM requires customized financial APIs to call and struggles to adapt to the financial domain. Additionally, online user queries are diverse and contain out-of-distribution parameters compared with the required function input parameters, which makes it more difficult for a generic LLM to serve online users. In this paper, we propose a data-driven pipeline to enhance function calling in LLM for our online, deployed financial QA, comprising dataset construction, data augmentation, and model training. Specifically, we construct a dataset based on a previous study and update it periodically, incorporating queries and an augmentation method named AugFC. The addition of user query-related samples will \textit{exploit} our financial toolset in a data-driven manner, and AugFC explores the possible parameter values to enhance the diversity of our updated dataset. Then, we train an LLM with a two-step method, which enables the use of our financial functions. Extensive experiments on existing offline datasets, as well as the deployment of an online scenario, illustrate the superiority of our pipeline. The related pipeline has been adopted in the financial QA of YuanBao\footnote{https://yuanbao.tencent.com/chat/}, one of the largest chat platforms in China.

AI.title_translation: 大型语言模型在线金融问答中数据驱动的函数调用改进
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种数据驱动的流水线，通过数据集构建、数据增强和模型训练，改进了大型语言模型在在线金融问答中的函数调用能力，并在实际应用中取得了显著效果。
AI.motivation: 通用大型语言模型难以适应定制化的金融API，并且难以处理在线用户查询中多样化和分布外（out-of-distribution）的参数，这使得它们难以服务在线金融用户。
AI.method: 提出了一种数据驱动的流水线，包括数据集构建、数据增强和模型训练。具体而言，基于现有研究构建并定期更新数据集，融合用户查询和名为AugFC的数据增强方法，以探索可能的参数值并增强数据集多样性。随后，采用两步法训练大型语言模型，使其能够使用金融函数。
AI.result: 在现有离线数据集和在线部署场景中进行的广泛实验表明，该流水线具有优越性。相关流水线已应用于中国最大的聊天平台之一元宝（YuanBao）的金融问答系统。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的数据驱动流水线能有效增强大型语言模型在在线金融问答中的函数调用能力，并在实际应用中展现出优越性和实用性。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）已被整合到众多工业应用中。同时，大量的API资产分散在金融领域的各种功能中。在线金融问答系统可以利用大型语言模型和私有API提供及时的金融分析和信息。关键在于为大型语言模型配备针对金融场景定制的函数调用能力。然而，通用大型语言模型需要定制化的金融API才能调用，并且难以适应金融领域。此外，在线用户查询是多样化的，并且包含与所需函数输入参数相比的分布外参数，这使得通用大型语言模型更难服务在线用户。在本文中，我们提出了一种数据驱动的流水线，以增强大型语言模型在我们在线部署的金融问答系统中的函数调用能力，该流水线包括数据集构建、数据增强和模型训练。具体而言，我们基于先前的研究构建了一个数据集并定期更新，其中包含了查询和一种名为AugFC的增强方法。用户查询相关样本的增加将以数据驱动的方式“利用”我们的金融工具集，而AugFC则探索可能的参数值以增强我们更新数据集的多样性。然后，我们通过两步法训练大型语言模型，使其能够使用我们的金融函数。在现有离线数据集以及在线场景部署上的广泛实验表明了我们流水线的优越性。相关流水线已应用于中国最大的聊天平台之一元宝（https://yuanbao.tencent.com/chat/）的金融问答系统。
AI.summary: 本文针对大型语言模型在在线金融问答中函数调用能力不足的问题，提出了一种数据驱动的改进流水线。该流水线包含数据集构建、AugFC数据增强和两步模型训练，旨在解决通用LLM对定制金融API和多样化用户查询的适应性问题。实验证明，该方法显著提升了LLM的函数调用性能，并已成功应用于实际金融问答产品。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 函数调用, 金融问答, 数据驱动, 数据增强
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于提出了一种专门针对金融领域、数据驱动的函数调用增强流水线，有效地解决了大型语言模型在处理定制化金融API和多样化在线用户查询时的挑战。其在数据集构建、数据增强（AugFC）和两步训练方法上的设计，展现了将通用LLM适应特定复杂领域实践的有效途径。成功部署于元宝金融问答系统，进一步验证了其在实际应用中的重要性和实用价值。

title: LUMOS: Universal Semi-Supervised OCT Retinal Layer Segmentation with Hierarchical Reliable Mutual Learning
comments: 5 pages, 2 figures. Accepted to IEEE ISBI 2026. \c{opyright} 2026 IEEE. Personal use of this material is permitted. Permission from IEEE must be obtained for all other uses
summary: Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT) layer segmentation faces challenges due to annotation scarcity and heterogeneous label granularities across datasets. While semi-supervised learning helps alleviate label scarcity, existing methods typically assume a fixed granularity, failing to fully exploit cross-granularity supervision. This paper presents LUMOS, a semi-supervised universal OCT retinal layer segmentation framework based on a Dual-Decoder Network with a Hierarchical Prompting Strategy (DDN-HPS) and Reliable Progressive Multi-granularity Learning (RPML). DDN-HPS combines a dual-branch architecture with a multi-granularity prompting strategy to effectively suppress pseudo-label noise propagation. Meanwhile, RPML introduces region-level reliability weighing and a progressive training approach that guides the model from easier to more difficult tasks, ensuring the reliable selection of cross-granularity consistency targets, thereby achieving stable cross-granularity alignment. Experiments on six OCT datasets demonstrate that LUMOS largely outperforms existing methods and exhibits exceptional cross-domain and cross-granularity generalization capability.

AI.title_translation: LUMOS：基于分层可靠互学习的通用半监督OCT视网膜层分割方法
AI.tldr: LUMOS通过一种新的分层提示和多粒度学习机制，解决了OCT影像分割中标签稀缺与粒度不一致的问题，实现了更稳健、通用的分割性能。
AI.motivation: 解决OCT视网膜层分割中存在的标注稀缺问题，以及现有半监督方法难以处理不同数据集间标签粒度不一致（异构性）的局限。
AI.method: 提出了LUMOS框架，包含双解码器网络与分层提示策略（DDN-HPS）以及可靠的渐进式多粒度学习（RPML）方法，通过区域可靠性加权和从易到难的训练策略实现跨粒度对齐。
AI.result: 在六个OCT数据集上的实验表明，LUMOS显著优于现有方法，并具备出色的跨域和跨粒度泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: LUMOS框架在处理多粒度标注的OCT视网膜层分割任务中表现优异，证明了跨粒度监督学习在提升半监督分割性能方面的有效性。
AI.translation: 光学相干断层扫描（OCT）层分割面临着标注稀缺和跨数据集标签粒度异构性的挑战。虽然半监督学习有助于缓解标签稀缺，但现有方法通常假设粒度固定，未能充分利用跨粒度监督。本文提出了LUMOS，一个基于双解码器网络和分层提示策略（DDN-HPS）以及可靠渐进式多粒度学习（RPML）的半监督通用OCT视网膜层分割框架。DDN-HPS结合了双分支架构和多粒度提示策略，以有效抑制伪标签噪声传播。同时，RPML引入了区域级可靠性加权和渐进式训练方法，引导模型从简单任务向困难任务学习，确保了跨粒度一致性目标的可靠选择，从而实现稳定的跨粒度对齐。在六个OCT数据集上的实验表明，LUMOS在很大程度上优于现有方法，并展现出卓越的跨域和跨粒度泛化能力。
AI.summary: LUMOS是一个用于OCT视网膜层分割的通用半监督框架。它利用双解码器结构和分层提示策略来抑制噪声，并通过渐进式多粒度学习方法，从不同粒度的标签中提取可靠信息，实现了稳定的跨数据集分割。
AI.keywords: 光学相干断层扫描 (OCT), 半监督学习, 视网膜层分割, 多粒度学习, 层次化提示策略
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入分层提示策略和可靠的多粒度学习机制，巧妙解决了OCT医学影像中因标注稀缺和标签粒度不一致导致的分割难题，具有很强的实用价值和泛化能力。

title: Beyond Semantic Search: Towards Referential Anchoring in Composed Image Retrieval
comments: Accepted to CVPR 2026. Project page, dataset, and code are available at: https://hahajun1101.github.io/OACIR/
summary: Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) has demonstrated significant potential by enabling flexible multimodal queries that combine a reference image and modification text. However, CIR inherently prioritizes semantic matching, struggling to reliably retrieve a user-specified instance across contexts. In practice, emphasizing concrete instance fidelity over broad semantics is often more consequential. In this work, we propose Object-Anchored Composed Image Retrieval (OACIR), a novel fine-grained retrieval task that mandates strict instance-level consistency. To advance research on this task, we construct OACIRR (OACIR on Real-world images), the first large-scale, multi-domain benchmark comprising over 160K quadruples and four challenging candidate galleries enriched with hard-negative instance distractors. Each quadruple augments the compositional query with a bounding box that visually anchors the object in the reference image, providing a precise and flexible way to ensure instance preservation. To address the OACIR task, we propose AdaFocal, a framework featuring a Context-Aware Attention Modulator that adaptively intensifies attention within the specified instance region, dynamically balancing focus between the anchored instance and the broader compositional context. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AdaFocal substantially outperforms existing compositional retrieval models, particularly in maintaining instance-level fidelity, thereby establishing a robust baseline for this challenging task while opening new directions for more flexible, instance-aware retrieval systems.
comment: Accepted to CVPR 2026. Project page, dataset, and code are available at: https://hahajun1101.github.io/OACIR/

AI.title_translation: 超越语义搜索：迈向组合图像检索中的参照锚定
AI.tldr: 现有组合图像检索（CIR）侧重语义匹配，难以保持实例一致性。本文提出目标锚定组合图像检索（OACIR）新任务和OACIRR基准，以及AdaFocal框架，通过自适应注意力显著提升了实例级检索性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的组合图像检索（CIR）虽然潜力巨大，但过度侧重于语义匹配，导致在不同上下文中难以可靠地检索用户指定的具体实例。在实践中，强调具体实例的忠实度往往比广泛的语义更重要，因此需要一种能严格保持实例级一致性的检索方法。
AI.method: 本文提出了目标锚定组合图像检索（OACIR）这一新的细粒度检索任务，要求严格的实例级一致性。为此，构建了首个大规模、多领域的OACIRR（基于真实世界图像的OACIR）基准，包含超过16万个四元组和挑战性的候选图库，并通过边界框视觉锚定参考图像中的对象。为解决OACIR任务，提出了AdaFocal框架，其特点是包含一个上下文感知注意力调节器，能自适应地加强指定实例区域内的注意力，动态平衡锚定实例与更广泛组合上下文之间的焦点。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，AdaFocal显著优于现有的组合检索模型，尤其在保持实例级忠实度方面表现出色，为这项具有挑战性的任务建立了强大的基线。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功提出了目标锚定组合图像检索（OACIR）任务和AdaFocal框架，有效解决了现有组合图像检索在实例级一致性上的不足，为更灵活、实例感知的检索系统开辟了新方向。
AI.translation: 组合图像检索（CIR）通过结合参考图像和修改文本的灵活多模态查询展现出巨大潜力。然而，CIR本质上优先考虑语义匹配，难以在不同上下文中可靠地检索用户指定的实例。在实践中，强调具体实例的忠实度而非广泛的语义往往更具意义。在这项工作中，我们提出了目标锚定组合图像检索（OACIR），这是一项新的细粒度检索任务，它要求严格的实例级一致性。为了推进这项任务的研究，我们构建了OACIRR（基于真实世界图像的OACIR），这是第一个大规模、多领域基准，包含超过16万个四元组和四个具有挑战性的候选图库，这些图库富含难负实例干扰项。每个四元组都通过一个边界框来增强组合查询，该边界框在参考图像中视觉锚定对象，提供了一种精确而灵活的方式来确保实例的保留。为解决OACIR任务，我们提出了AdaFocal，这是一个框架，其特点是包含一个上下文感知注意力调节器，该调节器自适应地加强指定实例区域内的注意力，动态平衡锚定实例和更广泛组合上下文之间的焦点。广泛的实验表明，AdaFocal显著优于现有的组合检索模型，尤其在保持实例级忠实度方面，从而为这项具有挑战性的任务建立了强大的基线，同时为更灵活、实例感知的检索系统开辟了新方向。
AI.summary: 本文针对现有组合图像检索（CIR）在实例级一致性上的不足，提出了目标锚定组合图像检索（OACIR）新任务，要求严格保持实例忠实度。为此，构建了首个大规模OACIRR基准数据集，并引入了AdaFocal框架，该框架通过上下文感知注意力调节器，自适应地聚焦于指定实例区域。实验证明，AdaFocal在实例级检索方面显著优于现有模型，为未来的实例感知检索系统奠定了基础。
AI.keywords: 组合图像检索, 实例级一致性, 参照锚定, AdaFocal, OACIRR
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过引入OACIR任务和OACIRR基准，创新性地解决了现有组合图像检索中实例一致性不足的关键痛点。AdaFocal框架利用上下文感知注意力机制，提供了一个有效且灵活的解决方案，显著提升了检索的精细度。这项工作不仅为细粒度图像检索领域建立了新的基线，也为未来开发更实用、更注重用户意图的检索系统提供了重要方向。其对“参照锚定”的强调，预示着图像检索将从宽泛的语义匹配转向更精确、更具上下文意识的实例识别。

title: Neural Assistive Impulses: Synthesizing Exaggerated Motions for Physics-based Characters
summary: Physics-based character animation has become a fundamental approach for synthesizing realistic, physically plausible motions. While current data-driven deep reinforcement learning (DRL) methods can synthesize complex skills, they struggle to reproduce exaggerated, stylized motions, such as instantaneous dashes or mid-air trajectory changes, which are required in animation but violate standard physical laws. The primary limitation stems from modeling the character as an underactuated floating-base system, in which internal joint torques and momentum conservation strictly govern motion. Direct attempts to enforce such motions via external wrenches often lead to training instability, as velocity discontinuities produce sparse, high-magnitude force spikes that prevent policy convergence. We propose Assistive Impulse Neural Control, a framework that reformulates external assistance in impulse space rather than force space to ensure numerical stability. We decompose the assistive signal into an analytic high-frequency component derived from Inverse Dynamics and a learned low-frequency residual correction, governed by a hybrid neural policy. We demonstrate that our method enables robust tracking of highly agile, dynamically infeasible maneuvers that were previously intractable for physics-based methods.

AI.title_translation: 神经辅助脉冲：为基于物理的角色合成夸张动作
AI.tldr: 通过将外力控制转化为脉冲控制，该研究实现了在物理仿真中生成符合动画需求的夸张、非物理动作，解决了传统方法中的训练不稳定性问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于物理的深度强化学习方法难以合成动画中所需的夸张、风格化动作（如瞬间冲刺或空中轨迹改变），因为这些动作往往违反物理定律，且直接施加外力会导致训练不稳定。
AI.method: 提出辅助脉冲神经控制（Assistive Impulse Neural Control）框架，将外部辅助从力空间重构为脉冲空间以保证稳定性；结合基于逆动力学的解析高频分量与学习到的低频残差校正，由混合神经策略进行控制。
AI.result: 实验证明该方法能够稳定且鲁棒地跟踪高度敏捷、在物理上不可行的动作，克服了以往物理仿真方法在处理此类任务时的局限性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架成功实现了在物理仿真中生成高度敏捷且动态不可行的动作，解决了传统方法难以平衡物理真实性与艺术夸张性的矛盾。
AI.translation: 基于物理的角色动画已成为合成逼真、物理上合理的运动的基本方法。尽管当前的数据驱动深度强化学习（DRL）方法可以合成复杂的技能，但它们难以重现动画中所需的夸张、风格化动作，例如瞬间冲刺或空中轨迹改变，这些动作往往违反标准物理定律。主要限制在于将角色建模为欠驱动的浮动基系统，其中内部关节扭矩和动量守恒严格控制运动。直接尝试通过外部扳手（external wrenches）强制实现此类运动往往会导致训练不稳定，因为速度不连续性会产生稀疏、高幅度的力尖峰，从而阻碍策略收敛。我们提出了辅助脉冲神经控制（Assistive Impulse Neural Control）框架，该框架将外部辅助在脉冲空间而非力空间中进行重构，以确保数值稳定性。我们将辅助信号分解为源自逆动力学的解析高频分量和由混合神经策略控制的学习到的低频残差校正。我们证明了我们的方法能够稳健地跟踪高度敏捷、动态不可行的动作，而这些动作对于以往基于物理的方法来说是难以实现的。
AI.summary: 本文针对基于物理的角色动画中难以实现夸张动作的问题，提出了一种辅助脉冲神经控制框架。通过在脉冲空间而非力空间建模外部辅助，并结合逆动力学解析计算与神经网络学习，实现了在保证数值稳定性的前提下，合成复杂且动态不可行的风格化动作。
AI.keywords: 物理仿真, 深度强化学习, 动作夸张, 辅助脉冲控制, 运动合成
AI.comments: 该研究巧妙地通过改变控制空间的表述方式（从力空间转变为脉冲空间），解决了物理模拟中追求“夸张动作”导致的数值不稳定问题。这种将解析动力学与深度强化学习相结合的混合方法，为物理仿真中的动作风格化提供了新的思路，具有很高的实用价值。

title: Reason Analogically via Cross-domain Prior Knowledge: An Empirical Study of Cross-domain Knowledge Transfer for In-Context Learning
summary: Despite its success, existing in-context learning (ICL) relies on in-domain expert demonstrations, limiting its applicability when expert annotations are scarce. We posit that different domains may share underlying reasoning structures, enabling source-domain demonstrations to improve target-domain inference despite semantic mismatch. To test this hypothesis, we conduct a comprehensive empirical study of different retrieval methods to validate the feasibility of achieving cross-domain knowledge transfer under the in-context learning setting. Our results demonstrate conditional positive transfer in cross-domain ICL. We identify a clear example absorption threshold: beyond it, positive transfer becomes more likely, and additional demonstrations yield larger gains. Further analysis suggests that these gains stem from reasoning structure repair by retrieved cross-domain examples, rather than semantic cues. Overall, our study validates the feasibility of leveraging cross-domain knowledge transfer to improve cross-domain ICL performance, motivating the community to explore designing more effective retrieval approaches for this novel direction.\footnote{Our implementation is available at https://github.com/littlelaska/ICL-TF4LR}

AI.title_translation: 通过跨领域先验知识进行类比推理：上下文学习中跨领域知识迁移的实证研究
AI.tldr: 研究表明ICL可以通过跨领域示例实现知识迁移，核心在于学习通用的推理结构而非依赖语义匹配。
AI.motivation: 现有的ICL严重依赖领域内专家标注数据，在数据稀缺场景下应用受限，作者旨在验证跨领域共享的推理结构是否能促进不同领域间的知识迁移。
AI.method: 通过开展全面的实证研究，对比不同检索方法在跨领域ICL设置下的表现，并分析示例数量与性能的关系，以及通过深入分析验证推理结构在知识迁移中的作用。
AI.result: 研究证实了跨领域ICL中存在条件性正向迁移；发现了明确的示例吸收阈值，超过该阈值后正向迁移概率增加且收益扩大；证实了迁移增益主要源于对推理结构的修复，而非语义线索。
AI.conclusion: 跨领域知识迁移在ICL中是可行的，且其核心机制在于通过跨领域示例修复模型的推理结构，而非简单的语义匹配。
AI.translation: 尽管取得了成功，但现有的上下文学习（ICL）依赖于领域内的专家演示，这限制了其在专家标注稀缺时的适用性。我们假设不同的领域可能共享底层的推理结构，从而使源领域演示能够在语义不匹配的情况下改善目标领域的推理。为了验证这一假设，我们对不同的检索方法进行了全面的实证研究，以验证在上下文学习设置下实现跨领域知识迁移的可行性。我们的结果证明了跨领域ICL中存在条件性正向迁移。我们确定了一个明确的示例吸收阈值：超过该阈值，正向迁移的可能性增加，且额外的演示会产生更大的收益。进一步的分析表明，这些收益源于通过检索到的跨领域示例修复了推理结构，而不是语义线索。总的来说，我们的研究验证了利用跨领域知识迁移来提高跨领域ICL性能的可行性，促使社区探索为这一新方向设计更有效的检索方法。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了在上下文学习（ICL）中利用跨领域先验知识的可行性。研究通过实证分析表明，即使在语义不匹配的情况下，跨领域示例也能通过修复推理结构来提升目标领域的推理能力，并揭示了正向迁移存在的特定阈值条件。
AI.keywords: 上下文学习, 知识迁移, 跨领域推理, 推理结构, 示例检索
AI.comments: 该研究挑战了ICL仅依赖领域内数据的传统范式，揭示了模型可以通过跨领域示例学习通用的推理结构。其创新点在于从“推理结构修复”的角度解释了跨领域知识迁移的机制，为解决标注数据稀缺问题提供了新思路。局限性在于研究主要关注经验性分析，尚未提出一种通用的、最优的跨领域检索算法。

title: Confidence Should Be Calibrated More Than One Turn Deep
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly applied in high-stakes domains such as finance, healthcare, and education, where reliable multi-turn interactions with users are essential. However, existing work on confidence estimation and calibration, a major approach to building trustworthy LLM systems, largely focuses on single-turn settings and overlooks the risks and potential of multi-turn conversations. In this work, we introduce the task of multi-turn calibration to reframe calibration from a static property into a dynamic challenge central to reliable multi-turn conversation, where calibrating model confidence at each turn conditioned on the conversation history is required. We first reveal the risks of this setting: using Expected Calibration Error at turn T (ECE@T), a new metric that tracks calibration dynamics over turns, we show that user feedback (e.g., persuasion) can degrade multi-turn calibration. To address this, we propose MTCal, which minimises ECE@T via a surrogate calibration target, and further leverage calibrated confidence in ConfChat, a decoding strategy that improves both factuality and consistency of the model response in multi-turn interactions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MT-Cal achieves outstanding and consistent performance in multi-turn calibration, and ConfChat preserves and even enhances model performance in multi-turn interactions. Our results mark multi-turn calibration as one missing link for scaling LLM calibration toward safe, reliable, and real-world use.

AI.title_translation: 置信度应当在多轮交互中进行更深层次的校准
AI.tldr: 本文提出了多轮校准任务，通过MTCal和ConfChat方法解决了大语言模型在多轮对话中的置信度偏差问题，显著提升了交互的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有的大模型置信度校准研究大多局限于单轮设置，忽视了在金融、医疗等高风险领域中，多轮对话交互可能带来的置信度偏差及风险。
AI.method: 1. 提出多轮校准任务，引入ECE@T指标监控对话过程中的校准动态；2. 提出MTCal方法，通过代理校准目标最小化ECE@T；3. 开发ConfChat解码策略，利用已校准的置信度提升多轮回复的事实准确性和一致性。
AI.result: 实验表明，MTCal在多轮校准中表现出色且稳定，ConfChat策略在提升多轮交互中模型回复的事实性和一致性方面效果显著。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的多轮校准任务及相应的MTCal和ConfChat方法，有效地解决了大语言模型在多轮交互中置信度校准不足的问题，提升了模型在复杂对话场景下的可靠性。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）正越来越多地应用于金融、医疗和教育等高风险领域，在这些领域中，与用户进行可靠的多轮交互至关重要。然而，现有的关于置信度估计和校准（构建可信LLM系统的主要方法）的工作，很大程度上集中在单轮设置，忽略了多轮对话的风险和潜力。在这项工作中，我们引入了多轮校准任务，将校准从一种静态属性重新定义为可靠多轮对话的核心动态挑战，要求在对话历史的条件下对每一轮的模型置信度进行校准。我们首先揭示了该设置的风险：通过使用T轮预期校准误差（ECE@T，一种跟踪多轮校准动态的新指标），我们发现用户反馈（例如说服）可能会降低多轮校准的效果。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了MTCal，通过代理校准目标最小化ECE@T，并进一步在ConfChat中利用校准后的置信度，这是一种在多轮交互中提高模型响应的事实性和一致性的解码策略。大量实验表明，MTCal在多轮校准中实现了出色且一致的性能，而ConfChat保持甚至增强了模型在多轮交互中的表现。我们的结果表明，多轮校准是将LLM校准扩展到安全、可靠和现实世界应用中的关键环节。
AI.summary: 本文针对大语言模型在多轮对话中的置信度校准问题进行了深入研究。作者定义了多轮校准任务，引入ECE@T指标揭示了对话历史对校准的影响，并提出了MTCal方法与ConfChat解码策略，实现了在多轮交互中对模型置信度的有效校准，从而提升了系统的整体可靠性。
AI.keywords: 多轮校准, 大语言模型, 置信度估计, 可靠性, 交互式对话
AI.comments: 本文创新性地将模型置信度校准从静态的单轮任务扩展到了动态的多轮对话场景中，填补了当前研究在多轮交互中缺乏鲁棒性评估的空白。通过引入ECE@T指标和MTCal方法，为构建更可信的LLM系统提供了切实可行的路径。

title: PROMISE: Proof Automation as Structural Imitation of Human Reasoning
summary:
Automated proof generation for formal software verification remains largely unresolved despite advances in large language models (LLMs). While LLMs perform well in NLP, vision, and code generation, formal verification still requires substantial human effort. Interactive theorem proving (ITP) demands manual proof construction under strict logical constraints, limiting scalability; for example, verifying the seL4 microkernel required decades of effort.
  Existing LLM-based approaches attempt to automate this process but remain limited. Most rely on single-shot generation or shallow retrieval, which may work for small proofs but fail to scale to large, interdependent verification tasks with deep structural dependencies.
  We present PROMISE (PROof MIning via Structural Embeddings), a structure-aware framework that reframes proof generation as a stateful search over proof-state transitions. Instead of surface-level retrieval, PROMISE mines structural patterns from proof states and tactic transitions, enabling retrieval and adaptation of compatible proof fragments during iterative search.
  We evaluate PROMISE on the seL4 benchmark across multiple LLM backends and compare it with prior systems such as Selene and Rango. PROMISE consistently outperforms prior methods, achieving up to +26 point improvements (186% relative gain) while maintaining robustness across models, demonstrating the effectiveness of structure-aware proof mining for scalable theorem proving.

AI.title_translation: PROMISE：作为人类推理结构模仿的证明自动化方法
AI.tldr: PROMISE通过结构化证明挖掘而非简单的文本生成，显著提升了LLM在复杂形式化验证任务中的自动化证明能力。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM在形式化验证中依赖单步生成或浅层检索，难以处理具有深层结构依赖的大规模验证任务，导致自动化程度低。
AI.method: 提出PROMISE框架，将证明生成重构为状态空间搜索问题，通过对证明状态和策略转换进行结构化挖掘，实现证明片段的检索与自适应。
AI.result: 在seL4基准测试中，PROMISE在多个LLM后端上均优于Selene和Rango等系统，最高提升了26个百分点（相对增幅186%）。
AI.conclusion: PROMISE通过利用结构化嵌入进行证明挖掘，显著提升了形式化验证的自动化程度，优于现有的单步生成或浅层检索方法，在复杂任务（如seL4）上表现出优越的鲁棒性和性能。
AI.translation: 尽管大语言模型（LLM）取得了显著进展，但形式化软件验证的自动化证明生成仍未得到有效解决。虽然LLM在NLP、视觉和代码生成方面表现出色，但形式化验证仍需要大量的人工投入。交互式定理证明（ITP）需要在严格的逻辑约束下进行手动证明构建，限制了可扩展性；例如，验证seL4微内核就需要数十年的努力。现有的基于LLM的方法试图自动化这一过程，但仍然受到限制。大多数方法依赖于单次生成或浅层检索，这可能适用于简单的证明，但在面对具有深层结构依赖的大规模、相互依存的验证任务时则会失败。我们提出了PROMISE（通过结构嵌入进行证明挖掘），这是一个结构感知的框架，将证明生成重构为证明状态转换的搜索过程。PROMISE不是进行表面级的检索，而是从证明状态和策略转换中挖掘结构模式，从而在迭代搜索过程中实现兼容证明片段的检索和适配。我们在seL4基准测试中评估了PROMISE在多个LLM后端上的表现，并将其与Selene和Rango等现有系统进行了比较。PROMISE的表现持续优于先前的方法，最高提升了26个百分点（相对增长186%），同时在不同模型间保持了鲁棒性，证明了结构感知证明挖掘对于可扩展定理证明的有效性。
AI.summary: PROMISE是一个针对形式化验证的结构感知框架，它通过挖掘证明状态和策略转换的结构化模式，取代传统的浅层检索，从而在迭代搜索过程中实现更精准的证明片段适配，提高了大规模验证任务的自动化效率。
AI.keywords: 形式化验证, 交互式定理证明, 大语言模型, 结构化嵌入, 证明自动化
AI.comments: 该研究通过将形式化验证从简单的文本生成转化为基于结构化嵌入的状态空间搜索，有效解决了LLM在处理复杂逻辑依赖时的局限性。其创新点在于强调了证明状态的结构挖掘，而非简单的语义匹配，为大规模软件验证自动化提供了新思路。

title: HYVE: Hybrid Views for LLM Context Engineering over Machine Data
summary:
Machine data is central to observability and diagnosis in modern computing systems, appearing in logs, metrics, telemetry traces, and configuration snapshots. When provided to large language models (LLMs), this data typically arrives as a mixture of natural language and structured payloads such as JSON or Python/AST literals. Yet LLMs remain brittle on such inputs, particularly when they are long, deeply nested, and dominated by repetitive structure.
  We present HYVE (HYbrid ViEw), a framework for LLM context engineering for inputs containing large machine-data payloads, inspired by database management principles. HYVE surrounds model invocation with coordinated preprocessing and postprocessing, centered on a request-scoped datastore augmented with schema information. During preprocessing, HYVE detects repetitive structure in raw inputs, materializes it in the datastore, transforms it into hybrid columnar and row-oriented views, and selectively exposes only the most relevant representation to the LLM. During postprocessing, HYVE either returns the model output directly, queries the datastore to recover omitted information, or performs a bounded additional LLM call for SQL-augmented semantic synthesis.
  We evaluate HYVE on diverse real-world workloads spanning knowledge QA, chart generation, anomaly detection, and multi-step network troubleshooting. Across these benchmarks, HYVE reduces token usage by 50-90% while maintaining or improving output quality. On structured generation tasks, it improves chart-generation accuracy by up to 132% and reduces latency by up to 83%. Overall, HYVE offers a practical approximation to an effectively unbounded context window for prompts dominated by large machine-data payloads.

AI.title_translation: HYVE：用于机器学习数据上LLM上下文工程的混合视图
AI.tldr: HYVE是一个框架，通过数据库管理原理，对包含大量机器数据输入的LLM进行上下文工程，以减少token使用量并提高输出质量。
AI.motivation: LLM在处理包含大量、嵌套、重复结构机器数据（如日志、指标、追踪、配置）时表现不佳，导致输入易碎。
AI.method: HYVE通过在模型调用前后进行协调的预处理和后处理来实现，利用一个带有模式信息的请求范围数据存储。预处理阶段，HYVE检测并物化重复结构，将其转换为混合的列式和行式视图，并选择性地向LLM呈现相关信息。后处理阶段，HYVE直接返回模型输出，或查询数据存储恢复信息，或进行额外的LLM调用进行语义合成。
AI.result: HYVE在各种真实世界的工作负载中，将token使用量减少了50-90%，同时保持或提高了输出质量。在结构化生成任务中，图表生成准确率提高了132%，延迟降低了83%。
AI.conclusion: HYVE为以大型机器数据负载为主的提示提供了一个有效的近似无限上下文窗口的实用解决方案。
AI.translation:
机器数据是现代计算系统中可观察性和诊断的核心，出现在日志、指标、遥测追踪和配置快照中。当提供给大型语言模型（LLM）时，这些数据通常以自然语言和结构化有效负载（如JSON或Python/AST文字）的混合形式出现。然而，LLM在处理此类输入时仍然很脆弱，特别是当它们很长、深度嵌套且以重复结构为主时。
我们提出了HYVE（HYbrid ViEw），一个用于LLM上下文工程的框架，用于处理包含大型机器数据有效负载的输入，其灵感来自数据库管理原理。HYVE通过协调的预处理和后处理围绕模型调用，以一个带模式信息的请求范围数据存储为中心。在预处理期间，HYVE检测原始输入中的重复结构，在数据存储中物化它，将其转换为混合的列式和行式视图，并有选择地只向LLM暴露最相关的表示。在后处理期间，HYVE要么直接返回模型输出，查询数据存储以恢复遗漏的信息，要么进行一次有界的额外LLM调用来进行SQL增强的语义合成。
我们在跨越知识QA、图表生成、异常检测和多步网络故障排除的各种真实世界工作负载上评估了HYVE。在这些基准测试中，HYVE将token使用量减少了50-90%，同时保持或提高了输出质量。在结构化生成任务上，它将图表生成准确率提高了132%，并将延迟降低了83%。总的来说，HYVE为以大型机器数据负载为主的提示提供了一个有效的无限上下文窗口的实用近似方案。
AI.summary: HYVE是一个创新的LLM上下文工程框架，它借鉴数据库管理原理来处理包含大量机器数据输入的LLM。通过智能的预处理和后处理机制，HYVE能够显著减少token使用量（高达90%），同时保持甚至提高输出质量，特别是在结构化数据生成任务中表现出色，如提高图表生成准确率高达132%并降低延迟高达83%，为解决LLM上下文长度限制问题提供了一个实用的解决方案。
AI.keywords: LLM上下文工程, 机器数据, HYVE, 数据库原理, 上下文窗口
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种名为HYVE的创新框架，用于解决大型语言模型在处理包含大量机器数据输入时的效率和准确性问题。HYVE借鉴数据库管理原理，通过预处理和后处理机制，有效地压缩和表示数据，显著减少了token使用量，并提高了在特定任务上的性能。该方法具有很高的实际应用价值，尤其是在日志分析、系统监控和故障排除等领域。未来的工作可以探索HYVE在更多样化的数据类型和更复杂的LLM任务上的适用性。

title: LSGS-Loc: Towards Robust 3DGS-Based Visual Localization for Large-Scale UAV Scenarios
comments: This paper is under reviewed by RA-L. The copyright might be transferred upon acceptance
summary: Visual localization in large-scale UAV scenarios is a critical capability for autonomous systems, yet it remains challenging due to geometric complexity and environmental variations. While 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has emerged as a promising scene representation, existing 3DGS-based visual localization methods struggle with robust pose initialization and sensitivity to rendering artifacts in large-scale settings. To address these limitations, we propose LSGS-Loc, a novel visual localization pipeline tailored for large-scale 3DGS scenes. Specifically, we introduce a scale-aware pose initialization strategy that combines scene-agnostic relative pose estimation with explicit 3DGS scale constraints, enabling geometrically grounded localization without scene-specific training. Furthermore, in the pose refinement, to mitigate the impact of reconstruction artifacts such as blur and floaters, we develop a Laplacian-based reliability masking mechanism that guides photometric refinement toward high-quality regions. Extensive experiments on large-scale UAV benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art accuracy and robustness for unordered image queries, significantly outperforming existing 3DGS-based approaches. Code is available at: https://github.com/xzhang-z/LSGS-Loc
comment: This paper is under reviewed by RA-L. The copyright might be transferred upon acceptance

AI.title_translation: LSGS-Loc：面向大规模无人机场景的鲁棒3DGS视觉定位研究
AI.tldr: 本研究提出了LSGS-Loc，一种用于大规模3DGS场景的视觉定位新方法，通过尺度感知初始化和基于拉普拉斯的可靠性掩码来提高定位的鲁棒性和准确性，尤其适用于无序图像查询。
AI.motivation: 大规模无人机场景下的视觉定位对于自主系统至关重要，但由于几何复杂性和环境变化而面临挑战。现有的基于3DGS的视觉定位方法在鲁棒的姿态初始化和对渲染伪影的敏感性方面存在不足。
AI.method: 提出了一种尺度感知的姿态初始化策略，结合了场景无关的相对姿态估计和显式的3DGS尺度约束。在姿态精炼阶段，开发了一种基于拉普拉斯的可靠性掩码机制，以减轻重建伪影（如模糊和漂浮物）的影响。
AI.result: 在大型UAV基准测试中的广泛实验表明，该方法在无序图像查询方面实现了最先进的精度和鲁棒性，显著优于现有的基于3DGS的方法。
AI.conclusion: LSGS-Loc通过其新颖的尺度感知姿态初始化和基于拉普拉斯的可靠性掩码机制，有效解决了大规模3DGS场景下视觉定位的鲁棒性问题，并在实际应用中取得了优异的性能。
AI.translation: 大规模无人机场景下的视觉定位是自主系统的关键能力，但由于几何复杂性和环境变化，它仍然具有挑战性。尽管3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）已成为一种有前途的场景表示，但现有的基于3DGS的视觉定位方法在大规模场景中难以实现鲁棒的姿态初始化和对渲染伪影的敏感性。为了解决这些限制，我们提出了LSGS-Loc，一种针对大规模3DGS场景的新型视觉定位流程。具体来说，我们引入了一种尺度感知的姿态初始化策略，该策略结合了场景无关的相对姿态估计和显式的3DGS尺度约束，从而能够在没有场景特定训练的情况下进行几何约束的定位。此外，在姿态精炼中，为了减轻模糊和漂浮物等重建伪影的影响，我们开发了一种基于拉普拉斯的可靠性掩码机制，以引导光度精炼朝着高质量区域进行。在大型UAV基准测试中的广泛实验表明，我们的方法在无序图像查询方面实现了最先进的精度和鲁棒性，显著优于现有的基于3DGS的方法。代码可在：https://github.com/xzhang-z/LSGS-Loc 获取。
AI.summary: LSGS-Loc是一种新颖的视觉定位方法，旨在解决大规模3DGS场景中无人机自主系统的定位挑战。该方法通过结合场景无关的相对姿态估计和3DGS尺度约束来实现尺度感知的姿态初始化，无需场景特定训练。此外，利用基于拉普拉斯的可靠性掩码机制来处理重建伪影，从而提高姿态精炼的质量。实验证明，LSGS-Loc在大型UAV数据集上实现了领先的精度和鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 3D高斯泼溅, 视觉定位, 无人机场景, 尺度感知初始化, 可靠性掩码
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种针对大规模3DGS场景的视觉定位新方法LSGS-Loc，通过引入尺度感知初始化和基于拉普拉斯的可靠性掩码机制，有效解决了现有方法的不足，并在实验中取得了优异的性能。该方法在处理无序图像查询和减轻渲染伪影方面具有重要意义。

title: Beyond Accuracy: Unveiling Inefficiency Patterns in Tool-Integrated Reasoning
summary: In real-world Tool-Integrated Reasoning (TIR) scenarios, where LLMs interleave reasoning with external tool calls, a major source of inefficiency is that the toolcalls create pauses between LLM requests and cause KV-Cache eviction, forcing recomputation. Also, the long, unfiltered response returned by external tools inflates the KV-Cache, so each decode step spends more time loading the growing cache and thus becomes steadily slower as context length increases. However, existing efficiency metrics like token counts and toolcall counts fail to capture the real model inference latency. To address this, we introduce PTE (Prefill Token Equivalents), a hardware-aware TIR-efficiency metric that unifies internal reasoning and external tool-use costs while explicitly accounting for non-reusable KV-Cache and long-tool-response scenarios. Validation in a high-concurrency industrial setting indicates that PTE aligns significantly better with wall-clock latency than standard token counts, while maintaining consistent efficiency rankings across diverse hardware profiles. We conduct extensive experiments across five TIR benchmarks, quantify their PTE costs, and identify four inefficiency patterns that appear in TIR. We also discover that trajectories with higher PTE costs tend to have lower reasoning correctness, indicating that simply using more tools does not improve the quality of the answer.

AI.title_translation: 超越准确性：揭示工具集成推理中的低效模式
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为PTE的新指标，用于准确量化工具集成推理的实际延迟，并发现工具使用效率低下与模型推理准确性下降之间存在关联。
AI.motivation: 现有的效率指标（如Token计数和工具调用次数）无法准确反映工具集成推理（TIR）在实际生产环境中的真实推理延迟，且未考虑工具调用导致的KV-Cache失效和冗余数据带来的计算开销。
AI.method: 提出了一种硬件感知的TIR效率指标——PTE（Prefill Token Equivalents），该指标统一了内部推理和外部工具使用的成本，并显式考量了不可重用的KV-Cache和长工具响应的影响。
AI.result: 实验表明PTE与实际墙上时钟延迟（wall-clock latency）高度相关，并识别出四种TIR效率低下模式；同时发现高PTE成本的推理路径往往伴随着较低的准确性。
AI.conclusion: PTE指标能有效量化TIR的真实推理延迟，揭示了工具使用效率与推理准确性之间的负相关关系，为未来优化推理策略提供了理论依据。
AI.translation: 在现实世界的工具集成推理（TIR）场景中，大语言模型（LLM）将推理与外部工具调用交织在一起，效率低下的一个主要来源是工具调用在LLM请求之间造成了暂停，并导致KV-Cache被驱逐，从而迫使系统进行重计算。此外，外部工具返回的长且未经筛选的响应会膨胀KV-Cache，使得每个解码步骤在加载不断增长的缓存上花费更多时间，随着上下文长度的增加，推理速度逐渐变慢。然而，现有的效率指标（如Token计数和工具调用计数）无法捕捉到真实的模型推理延迟。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了PTE（预填充Token等价物），这是一种硬件感知的TIR效率指标，它统一了内部推理和外部工具使用的成本，同时明确考虑了不可重用的KV-Cache和长工具响应场景。在高并发工业环境中的验证表明，PTE与墙上时钟延迟的对齐程度明显优于标准Token计数，同时在不同硬件配置下保持了一致的效率排名。我们在五个TIR基准测试中进行了广泛的实验，量化了它们的PTE成本，并识别了TIR中出现的四种低效模式。我们还发现，具有更高PTE成本的轨迹往往具有较低的推理准确性，这表明仅仅使用更多的工具并不能提高答案的质量。
AI.summary: 本文针对工具集成推理（TIR）中存在的效率评估偏差，提出了一种名为PTE的硬件感知评估指标。PTE通过统一考量推理计算与KV-Cache管理成本，能更准确地预测实际推理延迟，并揭示了工具过度使用与推理效率及准确性下降之间的联系。
AI.keywords: 工具集成推理, 推理延迟, KV-Cache, 性能度量, 大语言模型
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入PTE指标，成功揭示了工具集成推理（TIR）中被忽视的效率瓶颈，特别是KV-Cache管理和工具输出冗余带来的性能损耗，为大模型推理优化提供了更贴近实际生产环境的度量标准。

title: Weather-Conditioned Branch Routing for Robust LiDAR-Radar 3D Object Detection
summary: Robust 3D object detection in adverse weather is highly challenging due to the varying reliability of different sensors. While existing LiDAR-4D radar fusion methods improve robustness, they predominantly rely on fixed or weakly adaptive pipelines, failing to dy-namically adjust modality preferences as environmental conditions change. To bridge this gap, we reformulate multi-modal perception as a weather-conditioned branch routing problem. Instead of computing a single fused output, our framework explicitly maintains three parallel 3D feature streams: a pure LiDAR branch, a pure 4D radar branch, and a condition-gated fusion branch. Guided by a condition token extracted from visual and semantic prompts, a lightweight router dynamically predicts sample-specific weights to softly aggregate these representations. Furthermore, to prevent branch collapse, we introduce a weather-supervised learning strategy with auxiliary classification and diversity regularization to enforce distinct, condition-dependent routing behaviors. Extensive experiments on the K-Radar benchmark demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance. Furthermore, it provides explicit and highly interpretable insights into modality preferences, transparently revealing how adaptive routing robustly shifts reliance between LiDAR and 4D radar across diverse adverse-weather scenarios. The source code with be released.

AI.title_translation: 用于鲁棒LiDAR-雷达3D目标检测的天气条件分支路由方法
AI.tldr: 提出了一种动态分支路由框架，通过根据天气条件自适应调整LiDAR和4D雷达的融合权重，显著提升了恶劣天气下的3D目标检测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的LiDAR-雷达融合方法多采用固定或弱自适应管道，无法根据环境天气变化动态调整传感器模态的偏好，导致在恶劣天气下鲁棒性不足。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含纯LiDAR、纯4D雷达及条件门控融合的三分支架构，利用视觉和语义提示提取条件Token，通过轻量级路由器动态预测样本特异性权重进行融合，并引入天气监督学习策略防止分支坍塌。
AI.result: 在K-Radar基准测试中达到了最先进的性能，并提供了直观的模态偏好解释，证明了该方法在不同恶劣天气场景下能有效切换对LiDAR和雷达的依赖。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过动态路由机制实现了对恶劣天气下LiDAR与4D雷达的自适应融合，显著提升了3D目标检测的鲁棒性和可解释性。
AI.translation: 在恶劣天气下进行鲁棒的3D目标检测极具挑战性，因为不同传感器的可靠性会发生变化。虽然现有的LiDAR-4D雷达融合方法提高了鲁棒性，但它们主要依赖于固定或弱自适应的流水线，无法随着环境条件的变化动态调整模态偏好。为了弥补这一差距，我们将多模态感知重新定义为天气条件下的分支路由问题。我们的框架不再计算单一的融合输出，而是明确维护三个并行的3D特征流：纯LiDAR分支、纯4D雷达分支和条件门控融合分支。在视觉和语义提示提取的条件Token的引导下，轻量级路由器动态预测样本特异性权重，以软聚合这些表示。此外，为了防止分支坍塌，我们引入了一种天气监督学习策略，结合辅助分类和多样性正则化，以强制执行不同的、依赖于条件的路由行为。在K-Radar基准测试上的大量实验表明，我们的方法达到了最先进的性能。此外，它提供了关于模态偏好的明确且高度可解释的见解，透明地揭示了自适应路由如何在不同的恶劣天气场景中稳健地转移对LiDAR和4D雷达的依赖。源代码将会发布。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种天气条件下的分支路由框架，旨在解决恶劣天气下LiDAR与4D雷达融合的鲁棒性问题。通过并行处理三路特征流，并利用基于天气条件的动态路由器进行加权聚合，该方法实现了感知模态的自适应调整。实验证明其在K-Radar数据集上表现卓越，且具备良好的可解释性。
AI.keywords: 3D目标检测, 传感器融合, 恶劣天气, 分支路由, 自适应感知
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于将多模态感知转化为“天气条件下的分支路由”问题，通过动态权重分配和天气监督学习策略，有效解决了恶劣天气下传感器可靠性波动的问题。这不仅提升了性能，还增强了模型的可解释性，是多模态融合领域的一个重要进展。

title: CODESTRUCT: Code Agents over Structured Action Spaces
summary: LLM-based code agents treat repositories as unstructured text, applying edits through brittle string matching that frequently fails due to formatting drift or ambiguous patterns. We propose reframing the codebase as a structured action space where agents operate on named AST entities rather than text spans. Our framework, CODESTRUCT, provides readCode for retrieving complete syntactic units and editCode for applying syntax-validated transformations to semantic program elements. Evaluated on SWE-Bench Verified across six LLMs, CODESTRUCT improves Pass@1 accuracy by 1.2-5.0% while reducing token consumption by 12-38% for most models. Models that frequently fail to produce valid patches under text-based interfaces benefit most: GPT-5-nano improves by 20.8% as empty-patch failures drop from 46.6% to 7.2%. On CodeAssistBench, we observe consistent accuracy gains (+0.8-4.4%) with cost reductions up to 33%. Our results show that structure-aware interfaces offer a more reliable foundation for code agents.

AI.title_translation: CODESTRUCT：基于结构化动作空间的代码代理
AI.tldr: CODESTRUCT 通过让代码代理在 AST 级别而非文本级别进行编辑，提升了代码修复的成功率并降低了 Token 成本。
AI.motivation: 基于 LLM 的代码代理通常将代码库视为无结构文本，依赖容易出错的字符串匹配进行编辑，导致格式漂移和补丁生成失败。
AI.method: 提出 CODESTRUCT 框架，将代码库建模为结构化动作空间；引入 readCode 接口用于检索语法单元，以及 editCode 接口用于执行经过语法验证的语义级代码转换。
AI.result: 在 SWE-Bench Verified 上 Pass@1 准确率提升 1.2-5.0%，Token 消耗降低 12-38%；在 CodeAssistBench 上准确率提升 0.8-4.4%，成本降低高达 33%；显著减少了空补丁错误。
AI.conclusion: CODESTRUCT 证明了在代码代理中采用结构化操作空间不仅能显著提高代码生成任务的成功率，还能有效降低 Token 消耗，是构建更健壮代码辅助工具的有效途径。
AI.translation: 基于 LLM 的代码代理将存储库视为无结构文本，通过脆弱的字符串匹配应用编辑，这经常因格式漂移或模糊模式而失败。我们建议将代码库重构为一种结构化的动作空间，代理在该空间中操作命名 AST 实体而非文本跨度。我们的框架 CODESTRUCT 提供了用于检索完整语法单元的 readCode 和用于对语义程序元素应用语法验证转换的 editCode。在六个 LLM 的 SWE-Bench Verified 评估中，CODESTRUCT 将 Pass@1 准确率提高了 1.2-5.0%，同时大多数模型的 Token 消耗减少了 12-38%。那些在基于文本的界面下经常无法产生有效补丁的模型获益最大：GPT-5-nano 的准确率提高了 20.8%，空补丁失败率从 46.6% 降至 7.2%。在 CodeAssistBench 上，我们观察到一致的准确率提升（+0.8-4.4%）和高达 33% 的成本降低。我们的结果表明，结构感知界面为代码代理提供了更可靠的基础。
AI.summary: CODESTRUCT 是一个针对代码代理的框架，它将代码库从无结构文本重构为结构化的动作空间。该框架允许代理操作命名 AST 实体而非文本片段，通过提供 readCode 和 editCode 接口实现语法验证的转换，从而在提升代码修复准确性的同时降低了成本。
AI.keywords: 代码代理, 抽象语法树, 结构化动作空间, 代码编辑, 大语言模型
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入结构化代码操作（AST级别）取代传统的基于文本的编辑，解决了代码代理在处理大型代码库时常见的格式漂移和补丁生成失败问题。这种从“文本空间”向“结构化动作空间”的转变是代码智能体领域的一个重要范式优化，显著提升了可靠性和效率。

title: CRISP: Rank-Guided Iterative Squeezing for Robust Medical Image Segmentation under Domain Shift
summary: Distribution shift in medical imaging remains a central bottleneck for the clinical translation of medical AI. Failure to address it can lead to severe performance degradation in unseen environments and exacerbate health inequities. Existing methods for domain adaptation are inherently limited by exhausting predefined possibilities through simulated shifts or pseudo-supervision. Such strategies struggle in the open-ended and unpredictable real world, where distribution shifts are effectively infinite. To address this challenge, we introduce an empirical law called ``Rank Stability of Positive Regions'', which states that the relative rank of predicted probabilities for positive voxels remains stable under distribution shift. Guided by this principle, we propose CRISP, a parameter-free and model-agnostic framework requiring no target-domain information. CRISP is the first framework to make segmentation based on rank rather than probabilities. CRISP simulates model behavior under distribution shift via latent feature perturbation, where voxel probability rankings exhibit two stable patterns: regions that consistently retain high probabilities (destined positives according to the principle) and those that remain low-probability (can be safely classified as negatives). Based on these patterns, we construct high-precision (HP) and high-recall (HR) priors and recursively refine them under perturbation. We then design an iterative training framework, making HP and HR progressively ``squeeze'' to the final segmentation. Extensive evaluations on multi-center cardiac MRI and CT-based lung vessel segmentation demonstrate CRISP's superior robustness, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art methods with striking HD95 reductions of up to 0.14 (7.0\% improvement), 1.90 (13.1\% improvement), and 8.39 (38.9\% improvement) pixels across multi-center, demographic, and modality shifts, respectively.

AI.title_translation: CRISP：面向域偏移下鲁棒医学图像分割的秩引导迭代挤压方法
AI.tldr: CRISP通过利用预测概率的“秩稳定性”原则，提出了一种无需目标域数据的迭代挤压框架，有效提升了医学图像分割在面对未知分布偏移时的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有的领域自适应方法依赖于预定义的分布偏移或伪监督，无法应对现实世界中无限且不可预测的分布偏移问题，导致医学AI在临床应用中性能大幅下降。
AI.method: 提出“正区域秩稳定性”原则；通过潜在特征扰动模拟分布偏移；基于预测概率的秩稳定性构建高精度（HP）和高召回（HR）先验；采用迭代训练框架，通过HP和HR的交替挤压实现最终分割。
AI.result: 在多中心心脏MRI和基于CT的肺血管分割任务中，CRISP显著优于现有最先进方法，在多中心、人口统计学和模态偏移方面分别实现了高达0.14、1.90和8.39像素的HD95指标提升。
AI.conclusion: CRISP通过利用“正区域秩稳定性”原则，在无需目标域信息的情况下，通过迭代挤压策略有效解决了医学图像分割中的域偏移问题，显著提升了模型在多中心、多模态数据下的泛化能力。
AI.translation: 医学成像中的分布偏移仍然是医学人工智能临床转化的核心瓶颈。未能解决这一问题可能导致在未见环境中的性能严重下降，并加剧健康不平等。现有的领域自适应方法受到通过模拟偏移或伪监督来穷尽预定义可能性的固有局限。此类策略在开放且不可预测的现实世界中举步维艰，因为分布偏移实际上是无限的。为了应对这一挑战，我们引入了一个名为“正区域秩稳定性”的经验定律，该定律指出，正体素的预测概率的相对秩在分布偏移下保持稳定。在此原则的指导下，我们提出了CRISP，这是一个无需目标域信息、参数无关且模型不可知的框架。CRISP是第一个基于秩而不是概率进行分割的框架。CRISP通过潜在特征扰动模拟模型在分布偏移下的行为，其中体素概率秩表现出两种稳定模式：始终保持高概率的区域（根据该原则，这些区域是确定的正样本）和保持低概率的区域（可以安全地分类为负样本）。基于这些模式，我们构建了高精度（HP）和高召回（HR）先验，并在扰动下递归地细化它们。然后，我们设计了一个迭代训练框架，使HP和HR逐渐“挤压”到最终的分割结果。在多中心心脏MRI和基于CT的肺血管分割上的广泛评估证明了CRISP的卓越鲁棒性，在多中心、人口统计学和模态偏移方面，HD95指标分别显著降低了0.14（7.0%提升）、1.90（13.1%提升）和8.39（38.9%提升）像素，显著优于现有最先进的方法。
AI.summary: 本文提出了CRISP框架，旨在解决医学图像分割中因分布偏移导致的性能下降问题。该框架基于“正区域秩稳定性”原则，即正样本的预测概率秩在分布偏移下保持稳定。通过利用潜在特征扰动，CRISP构建并迭代细化高精度与高召回先验，实现无需目标域信息的鲁棒分割，在多项实验中表现出优于现有方法的性能。
AI.keywords: 医学图像分割, 域偏移, 秩稳定性, 无监督领域自适应, 鲁棒性
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的“秩稳定性”假设，将医学图像分割问题从基于绝对概率阈值的预测转化为基于相对秩的预测，这种方法论上的创新极大地提高了模型在面对未知分布偏移时的鲁棒性。其无需目标域数据且模型不可知的特性，使其在临床部署中具有极高的实用价值。

title: Training Without Orthogonalization, Inference With SVD: A Gradient Analysis of Rotation Representations
summary: Recent work has shown that removing orthogonalization during training and applying it only at inference improves rotation estimation in deep learning, with empirical evidence favoring 9D representations with SVD projection. However, the theoretical understanding of why SVD orthogonalization specifically harms training, and why it should be preferred over Gram-Schmidt at inference, remains incomplete. We provide a detailed gradient analysis of SVD orthogonalization specialized to $3 \times 3$ matrices and $SO(3)$ projection. Our central result derives the exact spectrum of the SVD backward pass Jacobian: it has rank $3$ (matching the dimension of $SO(3)$) with nonzero singular values $2/(s_i + s_j)$ and condition number $κ= (s_1 + s_2)/(s_2 + s_3)$, creating quantifiable gradient distortion that is most severe when the predicted matrix is far from $SO(3)$ (e.g., early in training when $s_3 \approx 0$). We further show that even stabilized SVD gradients introduce gradient direction error, whereas removing SVD from the training loop avoids this tradeoff entirely. We also prove that the 6D Gram-Schmidt Jacobian has an asymmetric spectrum: its parameters receive unequal gradient signal, explaining why 9D parameterization is preferable. Together, these results provide the theoretical foundation for training with direct 9D regression and applying SVD projection only at inference.

AI.title_translation: 无需正交化的训练与基于SVD的推理：旋转表示的梯度分析
AI.tldr: 通过数学分析证明了在旋转估计训练中移除SVD正交化可避免梯度失真，并从理论上解释了为何9D表示配合推理时SVD投影是最佳实践。
AI.motivation: 尽管实验表明训练时移除正交化并仅在推理时应用SVD能改善旋转估计，但缺乏明确的理论解释说明为何SVD会损害训练过程以及为何其优于Gram-Schmidt方法。
AI.method: 通过对3x3矩阵和SO(3)投影的SVD反向传播进行详细的雅可比矩阵谱分析，推导了奇异值的导数，并对比了SVD与Gram-Schmidt方法在梯度信号传递上的差异。
AI.result: 导出了SVD反向传播雅可比矩阵的精确谱，证明了其会导致梯度失真，尤其是在训练初期；同时证明了Gram-Schmidt方法会导致梯度信号不均，解释了为何9D参数化更优。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明，在训练期间移除SVD正交化可避免梯度失真和方向误差，而9D表示配合推理时的SVD投影是实现最优旋转估计的理论最优解。
AI.translation: 最近的研究表明，在训练期间移除正交化并仅在推理时应用它，可以改善深度学习中的旋转估计，且经验证据支持使用带有SVD投影的9D表示。然而，关于为何SVD正交化会特别损害训练，以及为何在推理时它应优于Gram-Schmidt的理论理解仍不完整。我们对专门针对3x3矩阵和SO(3)投影的SVD正交化进行了详细的梯度分析。我们的核心结果推导出了SVD反向传播雅可比矩阵的精确谱：其秩为3（与SO(3)的维度匹配），非零奇异值为2/(s_i + s_j)，条件数为κ=(s_1 + s_2)/(s_2 + s_3)，这会产生可量化的梯度失真，在预测矩阵远离SO(3)时（例如训练初期s_3 ≈ 0时）最为严重。我们进一步表明，即使是稳定的SVD梯度也会引入梯度方向误差，而从训练循环中移除SVD则完全避免了这种权衡。我们还证明了6D Gram-Schmidt雅可比矩阵具有不对称的谱：其参数接收的梯度信号不相等，这解释了为何9D参数化更可取。总之，这些结果为直接进行9D回归训练并在推理时应用SVD投影提供了理论基础。
AI.summary: 本文分析了旋转表示学习中正交化操作的影响。通过对SVD反向传播雅可比矩阵进行数学分析，作者揭示了训练期间应用SVD会导致梯度失真和误差。研究表明，训练阶段应避免正交化，而采用9D回归，仅在推理阶段使用SVD进行投影，并从理论上论证了9D参数化优于6D Gram-Schmidt表示的原因。
AI.keywords: 旋转估计, SVD正交化, 梯度分析, SO(3)投影, 9D表示
AI.comments: 该论文通过严谨的数学推导，揭示了深度学习中旋转表示训练的底层机制。其创新之处在于通过对SVD反向传播雅可比矩阵的谱分析，量化了梯度失真，为“训练时不进行正交化，仅在推理时投影”这一经验性策略提供了坚实的理论支撑。这对于优化三维视觉任务中的旋转估计具有重要的指导意义。

title: Learning to Synergize Semantic and Geometric Priors for Limited-Data Wheat Disease Segmentation
summary: Wheat disease segmentation is fundamental to precision agriculture but faces severe challenges from significant intra-class temporal variations across growth stages. Such substantial appearance shifts make collecting a representative dataset for training from scratch both labor-intensive and impractical. To address this, we propose SGPer, a Semantic-Geometric Prior Synergization framework that treats wheat disease segmentation under limited data as a coupled task of disease-specific semantic perception and disease boundary localization. Our core insight is that pretrained DINOv2 provides robust category-aware semantic priors to handle appearance shifts, which can be converted into coarse spatial prompts to guide SAM for the precise localization of disease boundaries. Specifically, SGPer designs disease-sensitive adapters with multiple disease-friendly filters and inserts them into both DINOv2 and SAM to align their pretrained representations with disease-specific characteristics. To operationalize this synergy, SGPer transforms DINOv2-derived features into dense, category-specific point prompts to ensure comprehensive spatial coverage of all disease regions. To subsequently eliminate prompt redundancy and ensure highly accurate mask generation, it dynamically filters these dense candidates by cross-referencing SAM's iterative mask confidence with the category-specific semantic consistency derived from DINOv2. Ultimately, SGPer distills a highly informative set of prompts to activate SAM's geometric priors, achieving precise and robust segmentation that remains strictly invariant to temporal appearance changes. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that SGPer consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance on wheat disease and organ segmentation benchmarks, especially in data-constrained scenarios.

AI.title_translation: 学习协同语义和几何先验以用于有限数据下的麦类病害分割
AI.tldr: 本文提出SGPer框架，通过协同大模型DINOv2的语义特征与SAM的几何定位能力，实现了在少量标注数据下鲁棒且精确的麦类病害分割。
AI.motivation: 麦类病害随生长阶段外观变化剧烈，导致标注数据收集困难，现有方法在数据受限场景下难以实现准确的病害分割。
AI.method: 提出SGPer框架，通过设计疾病敏感适配器将DINOv2的语义先验转化为密集点提示，引导SAM进行病害边界定位，并引入动态过滤机制以消除提示冗余并提升掩码质量。
AI.result: 实验表明，SGPer在麦类病害和器官分割基准测试中均达到了最先进的性能，特别是在数据受限场景下表现卓越。
AI.conclusion: SGPer框架通过协同语义和几何先验，成功在数据受限情况下实现了鲁棒的麦类病害分割，显著优于现有方法。
AI.translation: 麦类病害分割是精准农业的基础，但面临着不同生长阶段类内外观差异巨大的严峻挑战。这种显著的外观变化使得从零开始收集代表性训练数据集既费力又不切实际。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了SGPer，一个语义-几何先验协同框架，将有限数据下的麦类病害分割视为疾病特定语义感知与病害边界定位的耦合任务。我们的核心见解是，预训练的DINOv2提供了鲁棒的类别感知语义先验来处理外观变化，这些先验可以转换为粗略的空间提示，引导SAM进行病害边界的精确定位。具体而言，SGPer设计了带有多个疾病友好滤波器的疾病敏感适配器，并将它们插入到DINOv2和SAM中，以使其预训练表示与疾病特定特征对齐。为了实现这种协同，SGPer将DINOv2导出的特征转换为密集的、类别特定的点提示，以确保所有病害区域的全面空间覆盖。随后，为了消除提示冗余并确保高精度的掩码生成，它通过交叉引用SAM的迭代掩码置信度与DINOv2导出的类别特定语义一致性，动态过滤这些密集候选点。最终，SGPer提炼出一组高信息量的提示来激活SAM的几何先验，实现了在时间外观变化下保持严格不变的精确鲁棒分割。广泛的评估表明，SGPer在麦类病害和器官分割基准测试中始终达到最先进的性能，特别是在数据受限的场景下。
AI.summary: 本文提出了SGPer框架，旨在解决数据受限下的麦类病害分割问题。该方法结合了DINOv2的语义先验与SAM的几何先验，通过疾病敏感适配器将语义特征转化为动态点提示，引导SAM精确分割病害，实现了对时间外观变化的鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 麦类病害分割, 语义先验, 几何先验, 协同学习, 数据受限
AI.comments: 该研究巧妙地利用了预训练大模型（DINOv2和SAM）的互补优势，通过语义先验引导几何定位，有效解决了农业场景中数据稀缺及病害外观随生长阶段剧烈变化的问题。其创新点在于将语义特征转化为动态点提示，实现了高精度的病害分割。

title: Multi-Agent Pathfinding with Non-Unit Integer Edge Costs via Enhanced Conflict-Based Search and Graph Discretization
comments: 16 pages, 7 figures, submitted to cs.AI, Multi-Agent Systems, Pathfinding Optimization
summary: Multi-Agent Pathfinding (MAPF) plays a critical role in various domains. Traditional MAPF methods typically assume unit edge costs and single-timestep actions, which limit their applicability to real-world scenarios. MAPFR extends MAPF to handle non-unit costs with real-valued edge costs and continuous-time actions, but its geometric collision model leads to an unbounded state space that compromises solver efficiency. In this paper, we propose MAPFZ, a novel MAPF variant on graphs with non-unit integer costs that preserves a finite state space while offering improved realism over classical MAPF. To solve MAPFZ efficiently, we develop CBS-NIC, an enhanced Conflict-Based Search framework incorporating time-interval-based conflict detection and an improved Safe Interval Path Planning (SIPP) algorithm. Additionally, we propose Bayesian Optimization for Graph Design (BOGD), a discretization method for non-unit edge costs that balances efficiency and accuracy with a sub-linear regret bound. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach outperforms state-of-the-art methods in runtime and success rate across diverse benchmark scenarios.
