title: Understanding Uncertainty Sampling via Equivalent Loss
comments: An updated version of the previous paper titled "Understanding Uncertainty Sampling". Added a major result of sample complexity and other theoretical results; cut the experiment part
summary: Uncertainty sampling is a prevalent active learning algorithm that queries sequentially the annotations of data samples which the current prediction model is uncertain about. However, the usage of uncertainty sampling has been largely heuristic: There is no consensus on the proper definition of ``uncertainty'' for a specific task under a specific loss, nor a theoretical guarantee that prescribes a standard protocol to implement the algorithm. In this work, we systematically examine uncertainty sampling algorithms in the binary classification problem via a notion of equivalent loss which depends on the used uncertainty measure and the original loss function, and establish that an uncertainty sampling algorithm is optimizing against such an equivalent loss. The perspective verifies the properness of existing uncertainty measures from two aspects: surrogate property and loss convexity. When the convexity is preserved, we give a sample complexity result for the equivalent loss, and later translate it into a binary loss guarantee via the surrogate link function. We prove the asymptotic superiority of the uncertainty sampling against the passive learning via this approach under mild conditions. We also discuss some potential extensions, including pool-based setting and potential generalization to the multi-class classification as well as the regression problems.

title: On the success probability of the quantum algorithm for the short DLP
comments: This revision adds material on using random-walk techniques to perform the limited search, and a number of minor corrections and improvements
summary: Ekerå and Håstad have introduced a variation of Shor's algorithm for the discrete logarithm problem (DLP). Unlike Shor's original algorithm, Ekerå-Håstad's algorithm solves the short DLP in groups of unknown order. In this work, we prove a lower bound on the probability of Ekerå-Håstad's algorithm recovering the short logarithm $d$ in a single run. By our bound, the success probability can easily be pushed as high as $1 - 10^{-10}$ for any short $d$. A key to achieving such a high success probability is to efficiently perform a limited search in the classical post-processing by leveraging meet-in-the-middle or random-walk techniques. These techniques may be generalized to speed up other related classical post-processing algorithms. Asymptotically, in the limit as the bit length $m$ of $d$ tends to infinity, the success probability tends to one if the limits on the search space are parameterized in $m$. Our results are directly applicable to Diffie-Hellman in safe-prime groups with short exponents, and to RSA via a reduction from the RSA integer factoring problem (IFP) to the short DLP.

title: CROSS-Net: Region-Agnostic Taxi-Demand Prediction Using Feature Disentanglement
comments: An accepted journal article on IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation System
summary: The growing demand for ride-hailing services has led to an increasing need for accurate taxi demand prediction. Existing systems are limited to specific regions, lacking generality to unseen areas. This paper presents a novel taxi demand prediction system, harnessing the strengths of multiview graph neural networks to capture spatial-temporal dependencies and patterns in urban environments. Additionally, the proposed system CROSS-Net employs a spatially transferable approach, enabling it to train a model that can be deployed to previously unseen regions. To achieve this, the framework incorporates the power of a Variational Autoencoder to disentangle the input features into region-specific and region-agnostic components. The region-agnostic features facilitate cross-region taxi demand predictions, allowing the model to generalize well across different urban areas. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of CROSS-Net in accurately forecasting taxi demand, even in previously unobserved regions, thus showcasing its potential for optimizing taxi services and improving transportation efficiency on a broader scale.

title: CC-VPSTO: Chance-Constrained Via-Point-Based Stochastic Trajectory Optimisation for Online Robot Motion Planning under Uncertainty
comments: 23 pages, 12 figures, submitted to International Journal of Robotics Research
summary: Reliable robot autonomy hinges on decision-making systems that account for uncertainty without imposing overly conservative restrictions on the robot's action space. We introduce Chance-Constrained Via-Point-Based Stochastic Trajectory Optimisation (CC-VPSTO), a real-time capable framework for generating task-efficient robot trajectories that satisfy constraints with high probability by formulating stochastic control as a chance-constrained optimisation problem. Since such problems are generally intractable, we propose a deterministic surrogate formulation based on Monte Carlo sampling, solved efficiently with gradient-free optimisation. To address bias in naïve sampling approaches, we quantify approximation error and introduce padding strategies to improve reliability. We focus on three challenges: (i) sample-efficient constraint approximation, (ii) conditions for surrogate solution validity, and (iii) online optimisation. Integrated into a receding-horizon MPC framework, CC-VPSTO enables reactive, task-efficient control under uncertainty, balancing constraint satisfaction and performance in a principled manner. The strengths of our approach lie in its generality, i.e. no assumptions on the underlying uncertainty distribution, system dynamics, cost function, or the form of inequality constraints; and its applicability to online robot motion planning. We demonstrate the validity and efficiency of our approach in both simulation and on a Franka Emika robot.

title: Decoding News Narratives: A Critical Analysis of Large Language Models in Framing Detection
summary: The growing complexity and diversity of news coverage have made framing analysis a crucial yet challenging task in computational social science. Traditional approaches, including manual annotation and fine-tuned models, remain limited by high annotation costs, domain specificity, and inconsistent generalisation. Instruction-based large language models (LLMs) offer a promising alternative, yet their reliability for framing analysis remains insufficiently understood. In this paper, we conduct a systematic evaluation of several LLMs, including GPT-3.5/4, FLAN-T5, and Llama 3, across zero-shot, few-shot, and explanation-based prompting settings. Focusing on domain shift and inherent annotation ambiguity, we show that model performance is highly sensitive to prompt design and prone to systematic errors on ambiguous cases. Although LLMs, particularly GPT-4, exhibit stronger cross-domain generalisation, they also display systematic biases, most notably a tendency to conflate emotional language with framing. To enable principled evaluation under real-world topic diversity, we introduce a new dataset of out-of-domain news headlines covering diverse subjects. Finally, by analysing agreement patterns across multiple models on existing framing datasets, we demonstrate that cross-model consensus provides a useful signal for identifying contested annotations, offering a practical approach to dataset auditing in low-resource settings.

title: Towards Better Statistical Understanding of Watermarking LLMs
summary: In this paper, we study the problem of watermarking large language models (LLMs). We consider the trade-off between model distortion and detection ability and formulate it as a constrained optimization problem based on the red-green list watermarking algorithm. We show that the optimal solution to the optimization problem enjoys a nice analytical property which provides a better understanding and inspires the algorithm design for the watermarking process. We develop an online dual gradient ascent watermarking algorithm in light of this optimization formulation and prove its asymptotic Pareto optimality between model distortion and detection ability. Such a result guarantees an averaged increased green list probability and henceforth detection ability explicitly (in contrast to previous results). Moreover, we provide a systematic discussion on the choice of the model distortion metrics for the watermarking problem. We justify our choice of KL divergence and present issues with the existing criteria of ``distortion-free'' and perplexity. Finally, we empirically evaluate our algorithms on extensive datasets against benchmark algorithms.

title: Controllable Image Generation with Composed Parallel Token Prediction
comments: 8 pages + references, 7 figures, accepted to CVPR Workshops 2026 (LoViF)
summary: Conditional discrete generative models struggle to faithfully compose multiple input conditions. To address this, we derive a theoretically-grounded formulation for composing discrete probabilistic generative processes, with masked generation (absorbing diffusion) as a special case. Our formulation enables precise specification of novel combinations and numbers of input conditions that lie outside the training data, with concept weighting enabling emphasis or negation of individual conditions. In synergy with the richly compositional learned vocabulary of VQ-VAE and VQ-GAN, our method attains a $63.4\%$ relative reduction in error rate compared to the previous state-of-the-art, averaged across 3 datasets (positional CLEVR, relational CLEVR and FFHQ), simultaneously obtaining an average absolute FID improvement of $-9.58$. Meanwhile, our method offers a $2.3\times$ to $12\times$ real-time speed-up over comparable methods, and is readily applied to an open pre-trained discrete text-to-image model for fine-grained control of text-to-image generation.

title: A space-time variational formulation for the many-body electronic Schr{ö}dinger evolution equation
summary: We prove in this paper that the solution of the time-dependent Schr{ö}dinger equation can be expressed as the solution of a global space-time quadratic minimization problem that is amenable to Galerkin time-space discretization schemes, using an appropriate least-square formulation. The present analysis can be applied to the electronic many-body time-dependent Schr{ö}dinger equation with an arbitrary number of electrons and interaction potentials with Coulomb singularities. We motivate the interest of the present approach with two goals: first, the design of Galerkin space-time discretization methods; second, the definition of dynamical low-rank approximations following a variational principle different from the classical Dirac-Frenkel principle, and for which it is possible to prove the global-in-time existence of solutions.

title: Solving a Stackelberg Game on Transportation Networks in a Dynamic Crime Scenario: A Mixed Approach on Multi-Layer Networks
summary: Interdicting a criminal with limited police resources is a challenging task as the criminal changes location over time. The size of the large transportation network further adds to the difficulty of this scenario. To tackle this issue, we consider the concept of a layered graph. At each time stamp, we create a copy of the entire transportation network to track the possible movements of both players, the attacker and the defenders. We consider a Stackelberg game in a dynamic crime scenario where the attacker changes location over time while the defenders attempt to interdict the attacker on his escape route. Given a set of defender strategies, the optimal attacker strategy is determined by applying Dijkstra's algorithm on the layered networks. Here, the attacker aims to minimize while the defenders aim to maximize the probability of interdiction. We develop an approximation algorithm on the layered networks to find near-optimal strategy for defenders. The efficacy of the developed approach is compared with the adopted MILP approach. We compare the results in terms of computational time and solution quality. The quality of the results demonstrates the need for the developed approach, as it effectively solves the complex problem within a short amount of time.

AI.title_translation: 动态犯罪场景下交通网络Stackelberg博弈的求解：一种多层网络混合方法
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于分层图的近似算法，能高效解决大型交通网络中警方拦截动态移动犯罪分子的Stackelberg博弈问题。
AI.motivation: 在大型交通网络中，由于犯罪分子位置随时间变化且警方资源有限，传统的拦截策略难以高效实施，因此需要一种能处理动态场景并降低计算复杂度的博弈模型。
AI.method: 利用分层图（Layered Graph）构建时空网络，将动态博弈转化为路径规划；通过Dijkstra算法确定攻击者最优策略；设计一种针对防御者的近似算法，并与混合整数线性规划（MILP）方法进行对比。
AI.result: 与MILP方法相比，所开发的近似算法在计算时间上具有显著优势，且能提供高质量的近优拦截策略。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出的近似算法在处理大规模交通网络下的动态Stackelberg博弈问题时，表现出比传统MILP方法更优的计算性能和良好的解质量。
AI.translation: 在资源有限的情况下拦截移动犯罪分子是一项艰巨的任务，因为犯罪分子的位置会随时间变化。大型交通网络的规模进一步增加了该场景的难度。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了分层图的概念。在每个时间戳，我们创建整个交通网络的一个副本，以跟踪攻击者和防御者双方的可能移动。我们考虑了一个动态犯罪场景下的Stackelberg博弈，其中攻击者随时间改变位置，而防御者试图在其逃跑路线上拦截攻击者。给定一组防御者策略，攻击者的最优策略通过在分层网络上应用Dijkstra算法来确定。在这里，攻击者的目标是最小化被拦截的概率，而防御者的目标是最大化这一概率。我们开发了一种分层网络上的近似算法，以寻找防御者的近优策略。我们将所开发方法的有效性与所采用的MILP方法进行了比较。我们从计算时间和解质量方面比较了结果。结果的质量证明了开发该方法的必要性，因为它能在短时间内有效解决这一复杂问题。
AI.summary: 本文针对大型交通网络中的动态犯罪拦截问题，提出了一种基于分层图的Stackelberg博弈模型。通过将时间维度引入图结构，研究者将动态博弈转化为路径规划问题，并开发了一种高效的近似算法，在保证拦截效果的同时大幅缩短了计算时间。
AI.keywords: Stackelberg博弈, 分层网络, 犯罪拦截, 近似算法, 交通网络
AI.comments: 该研究通过分层图（Layered Graph）有效地将动态博弈问题转化为静态路径规划问题，并在保持解质量的同时显著提升了计算效率，对于实时应急响应场景具有重要参考价值。

title: Sim-CLIP: Unsupervised Siamese Adversarial Fine-Tuning for Robust and Semantically-Rich Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) rely heavily on pretrained vision encoders to support downstream tasks such as image captioning, visual question answering, and zero-shot classification. Despite their strong performance, these encoders remain highly vulnerable to imperceptible adversarial perturbations, which can severely degrade both robustness and semantic quality in multimodal reasoning. In this work, we introduce Sim-CLIP, an unsupervised adversarial fine-tuning framework that enhances the robustness of the CLIP vision encoder while preserving overall semantic representations. Sim-CLIP adopts a Siamese training architecture with a cosine similarity objective and a symmetric stop-gradient mechanism to enforce semantic alignment between clean and adversarial views. This design avoids large-batch contrastive learning and additional momentum encoders, enabling robust training with low computational overhead. We evaluate Sim-CLIP across multiple Vision-Language Models and tasks under both targeted and untargeted adversarial attacks. Experimental results demonstrate that Sim-CLIP consistently outperforms state-of-the-art robust CLIP variants, achieving stronger adversarial robustness while maintaining or improving semantic fidelity. These findings highlight the limitations of existing adversarial defenses and establish Sim-CLIP as an effective and scalable solution for robust vision-language representation learning.

AI.title_translation: Sim-CLIP：无监督的暹罗对抗微调，用于鲁棒且富含语义的视觉-语言模型
AI.tldr: Sim-CLIP是一种无监督的对抗微调方法，通过暹罗架构和余弦相似性目标来提高CLIP视觉编码器的鲁棒性，同时保持语义表示，实验证明其优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉-语言模型（VLMs）虽然性能强大，但其预训练的视觉编码器容易受到微弱的对抗性扰动，从而严重影响多模态推理的鲁棒性和语义质量。
AI.method: Sim-CLIP采用一种无监督的对抗微调框架，利用暹罗训练架构、余弦相似性目标和对称的停止梯度机制，强制对干净视图和对抗性视图之间的语义进行对齐。
AI.result: Sim-CLIP在多种视觉-语言模型和任务上，在目标和非目标对抗攻击下均表现出色，其对抗鲁棒性优于最先进的鲁棒CLIP变体，同时保持或提高了语义保真度。
AI.conclusion: Sim-CLIP是一种有效且可扩展的解决方案，用于鲁棒的视觉-语言表示学习，突显了现有对抗防御的局限性。
AI.translation: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）严重依赖预训练的视觉编码器来支持图像字幕、视觉问答和零样本分类等下游任务。尽管性能强大，但这些编码器仍然极易受到难以察觉的对抗性扰动的影响，这会严重降低多模态推理的鲁棒性和语义质量。在这项工作中，我们引入了Sim-CLIP，一个无监督的对抗微调框架，它增强了CLIP视觉编码器的鲁棒性，同时保持了整体的语义表示。Sim-CLIP采用了具有余弦相似性目标和对称停止梯度机制的暹罗训练架构，以强制对干净视图和对抗性视图之间的语义进行对齐。这种设计避免了大的批次对比学习和额外的动量编码器，从而能够以较低的计算开销进行鲁棒训练。我们在目标和非目标对抗攻击下，在多种视觉-语言模型和任务上评估了Sim-CLIP。实验结果表明，Sim-CLIP在鲁棒性方面持续优于最先进的鲁棒CLIP变体，同时保持或提高了语义保真度。这些发现突显了现有对抗防御的局限性，并确立了Sim-CLIP作为一种有效的、可扩展的鲁棒视觉-语言表示学习解决方案。
AI.summary: Sim-CLIP是一种新颖的无监督对抗微调框架，旨在提高CLIP视觉编码器的鲁棒性，同时保持其语义表示。它采用暹罗架构和余弦相似性目标，通过强制对干净和对抗性视图进行语义对齐来工作，无需大规模对比学习或动量编码器，从而实现了低计算开销的鲁棒训练。实验证明，Sim-CLIP在各种下游任务和攻击场景下，其性能优于现有的最先进方法。
AI.keywords: Sim-CLIP,对抗鲁棒性,视觉-语言模型,无监督微调,语义表示
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种名为Sim-CLIP的创新方法，通过无监督的对抗微调显著提高了视觉-语言模型的鲁棒性。其利用暹罗架构和巧妙的训练机制，在保持语义完整性的同时有效抵御了对抗性攻击，为开发更可靠的多模态AI系统提供了有价值的见解。然而，该方法在实际应用中的可扩展性和对不同类型对抗攻击的泛化能力仍有待进一步研究。

title: Structure-preserving approximations of the Serre-Green-Naghdi equations in standard and hyperbolic form
summary: We develop structure-preserving numerical methods for the Serre-Green-Naghdi equations, a model for weakly dispersive free-surface waves. We consider both the classical form, requiring the inversion of a non-linear elliptic operator, and a hyperbolic approximation of the equations, allowing fully explicit time stepping. Systems for both flat and variable topography are studied. Our novel numerical methods conserve both the total water mass and the total energy. In addition, the methods for the original Serre-Green-Naghdi equations conserve the total momentum for flat bathymetry. For variable topography, all the methods proposed are well-balanced for the lake-at-rest state. We provide a theoretical setting allowing us to construct schemes of any kind (finite difference, finite element, discontinuous Galerkin, spectral, etc.) as long as summation-by-parts operators are available in the chosen setting. Energy-stable variants are proposed by adding a consistent high-order artificial viscosity term. The proposed methods are validated through a large set of benchmarks to verify all the theoretical properties. Whenever possible, comparisons with exact, reference numerical, or experimental data are carried out. The impressive advantage of structure preservation, and in particular energy preservation, to resolve accurately dispersive wave propagation on very coarse meshes is demonstrated by several of the tests.

AI.title_translation: Serre-Green-Naghdi方程在标准形式和双曲形式下的保结构近似
AI.tldr: 本文开发了一套通用的保结构数值方法，通过分部求和算子确保Serre-Green-Naghdi方程的能量和质量守恒，显著提升了粗网格下色散波模拟的精度。
AI.motivation: 为了解决Serre-Green-Naghdi方程在模拟弱色散自由面波时，传统数值方法在粗网格下精度不足的问题，并同时满足物理守恒律（质量、能量、动量）和良好的平衡特性。
AI.method: 基于分部求和（SBP）算子框架，开发了针对经典形式（涉及非线性椭圆算子求逆）和双曲近似形式的数值方法；通过引入高阶人工粘性项实现能量稳定，并确保了质量、能量和动量守恒以及静水平衡特性。
AI.result: 数值实验证明，所提方法在多种基准测试中表现优异，能够准确捕捉色散波传播，即使在非常粗的网格上也能保持极高的计算精度，且验证了所有理论上的保结构性质。
AI.conclusion: 该文成功构建了一套适用于Serre-Green-Naghdi方程的保结构数值方法体系，在保证质量、能量守恒及良好平衡特性的同时，显著提升了粗网格下的数值模拟精度。
AI.translation: 我们为Serre-Green-Naghdi方程（一种弱色散自由面波模型）开发了保结构数值方法。我们考虑了需要反转非线性椭圆算子的经典形式，以及允许完全显式时间步进的方程双曲近似。研究了平坦地形和可变地形下的系统。我们提出的新型数值方法同时守恒了总水质量和总能量。此外，用于原始Serre-Green-Naghdi方程的方法在平坦测深下守恒总动量。对于可变地形，所提出的所有方法对于静水状态都是良好平衡的。我们提供了一个理论框架，允许我们构建任何类型（有限差分、有限元、间断伽辽金、谱方法等）的方案，只要在所选设置中可以使用分部求和算子。通过添加一致的高阶人工粘性项，提出了能量稳定变体。所提出的方法通过大量的基准测试进行了验证，以验证所有理论性质。在可能的情况下，与精确数据、参考数值数据或实验数据进行了比较。通过几项测试证明了保结构（特别是能量守恒）在粗网格上准确解析色散波传播的显著优势。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一类通用的保结构数值方法，用于求解描述弱色散自由面波的Serre-Green-Naghdi方程。该方法通过分部求和算子构建，适用于多种离散方案，在平坦和复杂地形下均能实现质量、能量和动量守恒，并保持静水状态的平衡，有效提升了粗网格下的模拟精度。
AI.keywords: Serre-Green-Naghdi方程, 保结构数值方法, 能量守恒, 双曲近似, 分部求和算子
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入保结构特性（特别是能量守恒），解决了Serre-Green-Naghdi方程在粗网格下模拟色散波时的精度问题。其通用性框架（基于分部求和算子）使得该方法可以灵活适配多种数值离散格式，具有很高的实用价值和理论意义。

title: The DeepSpeak Dataset
summary: Deepfakes represent a growing concern across domains such as disinformation, fraud, and non-consensual media. In particular, the rise of video conference and identity-driven attacks in high-stakes scenarios--such as impostor hiring--demands new forensic resources. Despite significant efforts to develop robust detection classifiers to distinguish the real from the fake, commonly used training datasets remain inadequate: relying on low-quality and outdated deepfake generators, consisting of content scraped from online repositories without participant consent, lacking in multimodal coverage, and rarely employing identity-matching protocols to ensure realistic fakes. To overcome these limitations, we present the DeepSpeak dataset, a diverse and multimodal dataset comprising over 100 hours of authentic and deepfake audiovisual content, specifically focused on the challenging and diverse talking heads context. We contribute: i) more than 50 hours of real, self-recorded data collected from 500 diverse and consenting participants, ii) more than 50 hours of state-of-the-art audio and visual deepfakes generated using 14 video synthesis engines and three voice cloning engines, and iii) an embedding-based, identity-matching approach to ensure the creation of convincing, high-quality identity face swaps that realistically simulate adversarial deepfake attacks. We also perform large-scale evaluations of state-of-the-art deepfake detectors and show that, without retraining, these detectors fail to generalize to this DeepSpeak dataset, highlighting the importance of a large and diverse dataset containing deepfakes from the latest generative-AI tools.

AI.title_translation: DeepSpeak数据集
AI.tldr: 为了解决现有深度伪造数据集的局限性，本文推出了DeepSpeak数据集，通过高质量、多样化的真实与伪造内容，揭示了现有检测模型在面对最新生成技术时的泛化能力缺陷。
AI.motivation: 现有的深度伪造检测数据集存在质量低、过时、缺乏用户授权、模态单一以及缺乏身份匹配协议等问题，无法有效模拟高风险场景下的真实对抗攻击。
AI.method: 构建了包含100多小时音视频内容的DeepSpeak数据集，利用14种视频合成引擎和3种语音克隆引擎生成伪造内容，并采用基于嵌入的身份匹配方法来确保生成内容的真实性。
AI.result: 研究表明，现有的最先进深度伪造检测器在未经过重新训练的情况下，无法有效识别DeepSpeak数据集中的伪造内容，证明了现有模型在面对最新生成技术时泛化能力不足。
AI.conclusion: DeepSpeak数据集通过提供高质量、多样化且具有身份匹配的深度伪造内容，暴露了现有检测器在面对最新生成技术时的局限性，并为未来的深度伪造检测研究提供了关键的基准资源。
AI.translation: 深度伪造在虚假信息、欺诈和非自愿媒体等领域引起了越来越多的关注。特别是在视频会议和高风险场景（如冒充招聘）中，身份驱动的攻击手段不断增加，这迫切需要新的取证资源。尽管在开发鲁棒的检测分类器以区分真伪方面做出了巨大努力，但常用的训练数据集仍然不足：它们依赖于低质量和过时的深度伪造生成器，内容是从未经参与者同意的在线存储库中抓取的，缺乏多模态覆盖，并且很少采用身份匹配协议来确保伪造的真实性。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了DeepSpeak数据集，这是一个多样化的多模态数据集，包含超过100小时的真实和深度伪造音视频内容，特别关注具有挑战性和多样性的“说话头像”场景。我们的贡献包括：i) 从500名多样化且知情同意的参与者中收集了超过50小时的真实、自录数据；ii) 使用14种视频合成引擎和3种语音克隆引擎生成了超过50小时的最先进音视频深度伪造内容；iii) 采用了一种基于嵌入的身份匹配方法，以确保创建令人信服的高质量身份人脸交换，从而真实地模拟对抗性深度伪造攻击。我们还对最先进的深度伪造检测器进行了大规模评估，结果表明，在未经重新训练的情况下，这些检测器无法泛化到DeepSpeak数据集，这突显了拥有一个包含最新生成式AI工具产生的深度伪造的大规模多样化数据集的重要性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了DeepSpeak数据集，这是一个涵盖100多小时真实及深度伪造音视频内容的大规模多模态数据集。该数据集通过500名参与者的真实数据采集、14种先进生成引擎的应用以及身份匹配技术的实施，旨在解决现有数据集在质量、多样性和真实性方面的缺陷，并用于评估当前深度伪造检测器的性能。
AI.keywords: 深度伪造, 数据集, 对抗攻击, 身份匹配, 多模态
AI.comments: 该数据集通过解决现有数据集数据质量低、缺乏多模态覆盖、缺乏身份匹配协议等痛点，为深度伪造检测领域提供了一个高质量的基准。其创新点在于采用了大规模、多样化的真实数据采集，以及基于嵌入的身份匹配生成技术，这对于提升检测算法在真实对抗场景下的鲁棒性具有重要意义。

title: Evaluating LLM-based Personal Information Extraction and Countermeasures
summary: Automatically extracting personal information -- such as name, phone number, and email address -- from publicly available profiles at a large scale is a stepstone to many other security attacks including spear phishing. Traditional methods -- such as regular expression, keyword search, and entity detection -- achieve limited success at such personal information extraction. In this work, we perform a systematic measurement study to benchmark large language model (LLM) based personal information extraction and countermeasures. Towards this goal, we present a framework for LLM-based extraction attacks; collect four datasets including a synthetic dataset generated by GPT-4 and three real-world datasets with manually labeled eight categories of personal information; introduce a novel mitigation strategy based on prompt injection; and systematically benchmark LLM-based attacks and countermeasures using ten LLMs and five datasets. Our key findings include: LLM can be misused by attackers to accurately extract various personal information from personal profiles; LLM outperforms traditional methods; and prompt injection can defend against strong LLM-based attacks, reducing the attack to less effective traditional ones.

AI.title_translation: 评估基于大语言模型的个人信息提取及其对抗措施
AI.tldr: 该研究评估了大语言模型（LLM）在个人信息提取方面的能力及其对抗措施，发现LLM在提取个人信息方面优于传统方法，但可通过提示注入进行有效防御。
AI.motivation: 大规模从公开个人资料中提取个人信息（如姓名、电话、邮箱）是网络钓鱼等安全攻击的关键步骤。传统方法效果有限，需要评估LLM在此任务上的表现及防御能力。
AI.method: 提出一个基于LLM的提取攻击框架，收集了包括GPT-4生成和真实世界数据在内的四个数据集，引入基于提示注入的新型缓解策略，并使用十个LLM和五个数据集系统地评估了LLM攻击和对抗措施。
AI.result: LLM可被攻击者滥用以精确提取个人信息，且优于传统方法。提示注入可有效防御LLM攻击，将其效果降低到传统方法的水平。
AI.conclusion: LLM在个人信息提取方面具有强大能力，但也易受攻击，但提示注入是一种有效的防御策略。
AI.translation: 自动从公开的个人资料中大规模提取个人信息——例如姓名、电话号码和电子邮件地址——是许多其他安全攻击（包括鱼叉式网络钓鱼）的基石。传统的提取个人信息的方法——例如正则表达式、关键词搜索和实体检测——在这方面取得的成功有限。在本研究中，我们进行了系统的测量研究，以评估基于大语言模型（LLM）的个人信息提取及其对抗措施。为此，我们提出了一个基于LLM的提取攻击框架；收集了四个数据集，包括一个由GPT-4生成的合成数据集和三个包含手动标注的八类个人信息的真实世界数据集；引入了一种基于提示注入的新型缓解策略；并使用十个LLM和五个数据集系统地评估了基于LLM的攻击和对抗措施。我们的主要发现包括：LLM可能被攻击者滥用，以精确地从个人资料中提取各种个人信息；LLM的性能优于传统方法；并且提示注入可以防御强大的基于LLM的攻击，将攻击效果降低到类似传统方法的水平。
AI.summary: 本研究系统地评估了基于大语言模型（LLM）的个人信息提取能力及其对抗措施。研究人员提出了一个LLM提取攻击框架，收集了合成和真实世界数据，并引入了基于提示注入的防御策略。实验结果表明，LLM在提取个人信息方面比传统方法更有效，但提示注入能够显著降低LLM攻击的有效性，使其接近传统方法的水平。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 个人信息提取, 安全攻击, 提示注入, 对抗措施
AI.comments: 该研究在个人信息提取领域具有重要意义，它不仅揭示了LLM潜在的安全风险，还提供了一种有效的防御手段。研究方法系统全面，数据集的构建也兼顾了多样性。未来的工作可以进一步探索更复杂的攻击场景和更具鲁棒性的防御机制。

title: Recent Advances in Multimodal Affective Computing: An NLP Perspective
summary: Multimodal affective computing has gained increasing attention due to its broad applications in understanding human behavior and intentions, particularly in text-centric multimodal scenarios. Existing research spans diverse tasks, modalities, and modeling paradigms, yet lacks a unified perspective. In this survey, we systematically review recent advances from an NLP perspective, focusing on four representative tasks: multimodal sentiment analysis (MSA), multimodal emotion recognition in conversation (MERC), multimodal aspect-based sentiment analysis (MABSA), and multimodal multi-label emotion recognition (MMER). We present a unified view by comparing task formulations, benchmark datasets, and evaluation protocols, and by organizing representative methods into key paradigms, including multitask learning, pre-trained models, knowledge enhancement, and contextual modeling. We further extend the discussion to related directions, such as facial, acoustic, and physiological modalities, as well as emotion cause analysis. Finally, we highlight key challenges and outline promising future directions. To facilitate further research, we release a curated repository of relevant works and resources \footnote{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Multimodal-Affective-Computing-Survey-9819}.

AI.title_translation: 多模态情感计算的最新进展：NLP视角
AI.tldr: 本文从NLP视角系统梳理了多模态情感计算的四大核心任务及主流建模范式，并提供资源库以推动领域研究。
AI.motivation: 多模态情感计算领域研究碎片化，缺乏统一的视角来整合不同任务、模态及建模范式，因此需要从NLP视角进行系统梳理。
AI.method: 系统综述法：通过对比任务定义、基准数据集和评估协议，将代表性方法归纳为多任务学习、预训练模型、知识增强及上下文建模四大范式。
AI.result: 构建了一个统一的多模态情感计算研究框架，涵盖四大核心任务（MSA, MERC, MABSA, MMER），并整理了相关方法、资源及未来挑战。
AI.conclusion: 本文系统总结了多模态情感计算的现状，明确了核心任务与主流技术范式，并为该领域的未来研究指明了方向。
AI.translation: 多模态情感计算因其在理解人类行为和意图（特别是在以文本为中心的多模态场景）中的广泛应用而受到越来越多的关注。现有研究涵盖了多样的任务、模态和建模范式，但缺乏统一的视角。在本综述中，我们从NLP的角度系统地回顾了近期的进展，重点关注四个代表性任务：多模态情感分析（MSA）、多模态对话情感识别（MERC）、多模态基于方面的情感分析（MABSA）和多模态多标签情感识别（MMER）。我们通过比较任务定义、基准数据集和评估协议，并将代表性方法组织成关键范式（包括多任务学习、预训练模型、知识增强和上下文建模），提出了一个统一的视角。我们进一步将讨论扩展到相关方向，如面部、声学和生理模态，以及情感原因分析。最后，我们强调了关键挑战并概述了有前景的未来方向。为了促进进一步研究，我们发布了一个相关工作和资源的精选存储库。
AI.summary: 本文从自然语言处理（NLP）的角度对多模态情感计算进行了系统性综述。文章重点分析了多模态情感分析、对话情感识别等四大核心任务，通过对比任务定义和数据集，将现有方法归纳为多任务学习、预训练模型等主流范式，并探讨了相关模态及未来研究方向。
AI.keywords: 多模态情感计算, 自然语言处理, 多模态情感分析, 情感识别, 模型范式
AI.comments: 该综述填补了多模态情感计算领域缺乏统一视角的空白，特别从NLP视角出发，系统地梳理了复杂的任务范式和方法论，对于研究人员快速构建知识图谱具有重要价值。

title: Global and Distributed Reproduction Numbers of a Multilayer SIR Model with an Infrastructure Network
summary: In this paper, we propose an SIR spread model in a population network coupled with an infrastructure network that has a pathogen spreading in it. We develop a threshold condition to characterize the monotonicity and peak time of a weighted average of the infection states in terms of the global (network-wide) effective reproduction number. We further define the distributed reproduction numbers (DRNs) of each node in the multilayer network which are used to provide local threshold conditions for the dynamical behavior of each entity. Furthermore, we leverage the DRNs to predict the global behavior based on the node-level assumptions. We use both analytical and simulation results to illustrate that the DRNs allow a more accurate analysis of the networked spreading process than the global effective reproduction number.

AI.title_translation: 一种具有基础设施网络的多层SIR模型的全局与分布式再生数研究
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种多层SIR模型，通过引入分布式再生数（DRNs）来精准刻画复杂网络中各节点的局部传播动力学，并证明其在预测全局传播趋势上优于传统的全局再生数。
AI.motivation: 现有的传染病传播模型往往依赖全局再生数来评估整体传播态势，但在复杂多层网络中，这种全局指标难以准确反映各节点或局部区域的差异化传播风险及动力学行为。
AI.method: 提出了一种耦合人口网络与基础设施网络的多层SIR传播模型；推导了基于全局有效再生数的阈值条件；定义了分布式再生数（DRNs）并建立局部阈值条件，通过解析推导与仿真实验进行验证。
AI.result: 研究表明，所提出的分布式再生数（DRNs）能够更准确地反映网络传播过程，且基于节点级假设的DRNs能有效预测全局行为，优于传统的全局有效再生数。
AI.conclusion: 分布式再生数（DRNs）不仅能够刻画多层网络中单个节点的传播特征，而且在预测整体网络传播行为方面表现出比单一全局再生数更高的准确性和灵活性。
AI.translation: 在本文中，我们提出了一个在人口网络与基础设施网络耦合环境下的SIR传播模型，其中包含病原体的传播。我们推导了一个阈值条件，通过全局（网络范围）有效再生数来刻画感染状态加权平均值的单调性和峰值时间。我们进一步定义了多层网络中每个节点的分布式再生数（DRNs），用于提供每个实体动力学行为的局部阈值条件。此外，我们利用DRNs基于节点级假设来预测全局行为。我们通过解析和仿真结果说明，与全局有效再生数相比，DRNs能够对网络传播过程进行更准确的分析。
AI.summary: 本文构建了一个耦合人口与基础设施的多层SIR传播模型。通过定义全局有效再生数和各节点的分布式再生数（DRNs），研究者建立了刻画网络传播阈值、单调性和峰值时间的分析框架，证明了DRNs在捕捉局部动态及预测全局传播行为方面具有更高的精度。
AI.keywords: SIR模型, 多层网络, 基础设施网络, 再生数, 网络传播动力学
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入“分布式再生数”（DRNs）这一创新概念，突破了传统仅依赖全局再生数分析多层网络传播的局限性。其重要性在于能够实现从局部节点行为到全局传播态势的精确预测，为复杂耦合网络的疾病防控提供了更细粒度的分析工具。局限性在于模型可能未充分考虑节点间的异质性动态演化或更复杂的社会行为。

title: TransAgent: Enhancing LLM-Based Code Translation via Fine-Grained Execution Alignment
summary: Code translation transforms code between programming languages while preserving functionality, which is critical in software development and maintenance. While traditional learning-based code translation methods have limited effectiveness due to the lack of sufficient parallel training data, Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently advanced this field with their strong code generation and comprehension capabilities. However, code translated by LLMs still suffers from diverse quality issues, such as syntax and semantic errors. In this work, we propose TransAGENT, a novel multi-agent system that eliminates the errors during LLM-based code translation. The main insight of TransAGENT is to localize error-prone code blocks via fine-grained execution alignment between source and target code. We evaluate TransAGENT on a newly constructed benchmark of recent programming tasks to mitigate data leakage. TransAGENT outperforms the latest UniTrans by up to 33.3% in translation accuracy and achieves an average improvement of 56.7% over Agentless in program repair performance. We also conduct an ablation study and evaluate TransAGENT across different LLMs, demonstrating its effectiveness and strong generalizability.

AI.title_translation: TransAgent：通过细粒度执行对齐增强基于 LLM 的代码翻译
AI.tldr: TransAGENT 是一个利用多智能体协作和执行对齐技术，显著提升 LLM 代码翻译准确率与纠错能力的系统。
AI.motivation: 传统代码翻译方法受限于平行数据不足，而现有的 LLM 翻译方法常出现语法和语义错误，缺乏有效的自动纠错机制。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为 TransAGENT 的多智能体系统，核心在于通过源语言和目标语言代码之间的细粒度执行对齐（fine-grained execution alignment）来定位并消除翻译过程中的错误。
AI.result: 在自建基准测试中，TransAGENT 的翻译准确率较 UniTrans 提升高达 33.3%，程序修复性能平均提升 56.7%。此外，实验验证了其在不同 LLM 上的有效性和泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: TransAGENT 通过细粒度执行对齐机制有效提升了 LLM 在代码翻译中的准确性和程序修复能力，证明了多智能体协作在解决复杂代码转换任务中的潜力。
AI.translation: 代码翻译在保持功能不变的前提下实现编程语言间的转换，这对软件开发和维护至关重要。虽然传统的基于学习的代码翻译方法由于缺乏足够的平行训练数据而效果有限，但大语言模型（LLMs）凭借其强大的代码生成和理解能力，最近推动了该领域的发展。然而，LLM 翻译的代码仍存在语法和语义错误等多种质量问题。在这项工作中，我们提出了 TransAGENT，一个旨在消除 LLM 代码翻译过程中错误的新型多智能体系统。TransAGENT 的主要见解是通过源代码和目标代码之间的细粒度执行对齐来定位易错代码块。我们在一个为缓解数据泄露而新构建的近期编程任务基准上评估了 TransAGENT。结果显示，TransAGENT 在翻译准确率上比最新的 UniTrans 高出 33.3%，在程序修复性能上平均比 Agentless 提高了 56.7%。我们还进行了消融研究，并评估了 TransAGENT 在不同 LLM 上的表现，证明了其有效性和强大的通用性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 TransAGENT，一个旨在提升 LLM 代码翻译质量的多智能体系统。该系统通过细粒度执行对齐技术定位翻译中的错误代码块并进行修复，有效解决了代码转换中的语法和语义问题，并在多项指标上大幅超越了现有先进方法。
AI.keywords: 代码翻译, 大语言模型, 多智能体系统, 执行对齐, 程序修复
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的多智能体框架，通过细粒度执行对齐来解决大模型在代码翻译中常见的语义和语法错误问题。其优势在于不依赖大规模平行语料库，而是通过运行时反馈进行自我纠错，在评估中表现出显著的性能提升和良好的通用性。

title: ForgeryGPT: A Multimodal LLM for Interpretable Image Forgery Detection and Localization
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), such as GPT4o, have shown strong capabilities in visual reasoning and explanation generation. However, despite these strengths, they face significant challenges in the increasingly critical task of Image Forgery Detection and Localization (IFDL). Moreover, existing IFDL methods are typically limited to the learning of low-level semantic-agnostic clues and merely provide a single outcome judgment. To tackle these issues, we propose ForgeryGPT, a novel framework that advances the IFDL task by capturing high-order forensics knowledge correlations of forged images from diverse linguistic feature spaces, while enabling explainable generation and interactive dialogue through a newly customized Large Language Model (LLM) architecture. Specifically, ForgeryGPT enhances traditional LLMs by integrating the Mask-Aware Forgery Extractor, which enables the excavating of precise forgery mask information from input images and facilitating pixel-level understanding of tampering artifacts. The Mask-Aware Forgery Extractor consists of a Forgery Localization Expert (FL-Expert) and a Mask Encoder, where the FL-Expert is augmented with an Object-agnostic Forgery Prompt and a Vocabulary-enhanced Vision Encoder, allowing for effectively capturing of multi-scale fine-grained forgery details. To enhance its performance, we implement a three-stage training strategy, supported by our designed Mask-Text Alignment and IFDL Task-Specific Instruction Tuning datasets, which align vision-language modalities and improve forgery detection and instruction-following capabilities. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

AI.title_translation: ForgeryGPT：一种用于可解释图像篡改检测与定位的多模态大语言模型
AI.tldr: ForgeryGPT利用多模态大模型和掩码感知提取器，实现了具有高可解释性和交互能力的图像篡改检测与定位。
AI.motivation: 现有图像篡改检测方法多依赖低级语义线索，缺乏可解释性，且无法提供交互式分析，难以应对复杂的篡改检测任务。
AI.method: 提出ForgeryGPT框架，包含Mask-Aware Forgery Extractor（由篡改定位专家和掩码编码器组成），并采用三阶段训练策略及专门设计的对齐与指令微调数据集。
AI.result: 实验表明，ForgeryGPT能有效捕捉细粒度篡改细节，实现了像素级的篡改理解，并在检测与定位性能上表现优异。
AI.conclusion: ForgeryGPT通过多模态融合与专门的篡改检测架构，实现了具有高可解释性的图像篡改检测与定位，证明了MLLM在数字取证领域的巨大潜力。
AI.translation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs），如GPT4o，在视觉推理和解释生成方面表现出强大的能力。然而，尽管有这些优势，它们在日益关键的图像篡改检测与定位（IFDL）任务中面临巨大挑战。此外，现有的IFDL方法通常局限于学习低级、与语义无关的线索，且仅仅提供单一的判断结果。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了ForgeryGPT，这是一个新颖的框架，通过从不同的语言特征空间捕捉篡改图像的高阶取证知识关联，并通过一种新定制的大语言模型（LLM）架构实现可解释生成和交互式对话，从而推进了IFDL任务。具体而言，ForgeryGPT通过整合掩码感知篡改提取器（Mask-Aware Forgery Extractor）增强了传统LLM，该提取器能够从输入图像中挖掘精确的篡改掩码信息，并促进对篡改伪影的像素级理解。掩码感知篡改提取器由篡改定位专家（FL-Expert）和掩码编码器组成，其中FL-Expert通过对象无关篡改提示（Object-agnostic Forgery Prompt）和词汇增强视觉编码器进行了增强，从而能够有效地捕捉多尺度细粒度的篡改细节。为了提高其性能，我们实施了三阶段训练策略，并辅以我们设计的掩码-文本对齐和IFDL任务特定指令微调数据集，这些数据集对齐了视觉-语言模态，并提高了篡改检测和指令遵循能力。大量实验证明了该方法的有效性。
AI.summary: ForgeryGPT是一个创新的多模态大模型框架，旨在通过整合掩码感知篡改提取器和定制化LLM架构，实现图像篡改的精准定位、可解释性分析及交互式对话。
AI.keywords: 多模态大模型, 图像篡改检测, 可解释性, 取证分析, 视觉语言对齐
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将多模态大模型（MLLM）引入图像篡改检测与定位领域，解决了传统方法仅提供单一判断结果且缺乏可解释性的局限。其引入的Mask-Aware Forgery Extractor和三阶段训练策略，有效提升了模型对篡改痕迹的理解和定位能力。

title: Interpreting Temporal Graph Neural Networks with Koopman Theory
summary: Spatiotemporal graph neural networks (STGNNs) have shown promising results in many domains, from forecasting to epidemiology. However, understanding the dynamics learned by these models and explaining their behaviour is significantly more difficult than for models that deal with static data. Inspired by Koopman theory, which allows a simple description of intricate, nonlinear dynamical systems, we introduce new explainability approaches for temporal graphs. Specifically, we present two methods to interpret the STGNN's decision process and identify the most relevant spatial and temporal patterns in the input for the task at hand. The first relies on dynamic mode decomposition (DMD), a Koopman-inspired dimensionality reduction method. The second relies on sparse identification of nonlinear dynamics (SINDy), a popular method for discovering governing equations of dynamical systems, which we use for the first time as a general tool for explainability. On semi-synthetic dissemination datasets, our methods correctly identify interpretable features such as the times at which infections occur and the infected nodes. We also validate the methods qualitatively on a real-world human motion dataset, where the explanations highlight the body parts most relevant for action recognition.

AI.title_translation: 利用柯普曼理论解释时空图神经网络
AI.tldr: 本文通过引入柯普曼理论中的DMD和SINDy方法，为时空图神经网络提供了两种新的可解释性方案，有效识别了模型决策中的关键时空模式。
AI.motivation: 现有的时空图神经网络（STGNN）虽然表现出色，但其学习到的动态过程和决策机制缺乏透明度，难以像静态数据模型那样进行解释。
AI.method: 提出了两种基于柯普曼理论的方法：一是利用动态模式分解（DMD）进行降维以解释决策过程；二是利用非线性动力系统稀疏识别（SINDy）发现支配方程，从而识别输入数据中关键的空间和时间模式。
AI.result: 在半合成传播数据集上，该方法能准确识别感染时间和节点；在真实人体动作识别数据集上，定性验证了其能有效突出关键身体部位。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功地将柯普曼理论应用于STGNN的可解释性，证明了利用动力系统方法识别时空关键模式的有效性，为理解复杂的时空图模型行为提供了新的理论框架。
AI.translation: 时空图神经网络（STGNN）在从预测到流行病学等许多领域都显示出了良好的结果。然而，理解这些模型学习到的动态过程并解释其行为，比处理静态数据的模型要困难得多。受允许对复杂非线性动力系统进行简单描述的柯普曼理论的启发，我们引入了针对时间图的新的可解释性方法。具体来说，我们提出了两种方法来解释STGNN的决策过程，并识别输入中与手头任务最相关的空间和时间模式。第一种方法依赖于动态模式分解（DMD），这是一种受柯普曼启发的方法。第二种方法依赖于非线性动力系统稀疏识别（SINDy），这是一种用于发现动力系统控制方程的流行方法，我们首次将其作为可解释性的通用工具使用。在半合成传播数据集上，我们的方法正确识别了可解释的特征，例如感染发生的时间和受感染的节点。我们还在现实世界的人体运动数据集上对这些方法进行了定性验证，其中的解释突出了与动作识别最相关的身体部位。
AI.summary: 本文针对时空图神经网络（STGNN）缺乏可解释性的问题，提出了两种基于柯普曼理论的新方法：利用动态模式分解（DMD）和非线性动力系统稀疏识别（SINDy）。这些方法通过识别关键的空间和时间模式，有效解析了STGNN的决策过程，并在合成及真实数据集上验证了其准确性和有效性。
AI.keywords: 时空图神经网络, 可解释性, 柯普曼理论, 动态模式分解, 非线性动力系统
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将柯普曼算子理论（Koopman Theory）引入时空图神经网络（STGNN）的可解释性研究，填补了动态图模型解释性领域的空白。通过结合DMD和SINDy两种动力系统方法，不仅提供了模型决策的解释，还揭示了潜在的动态模式，具有很高的学术价值和实际应用潜力。

title: Exploring Continual Fine-Tuning for Enhancing Language Ability in Large Language Model
comments: 19 pages, 6 tables, 4 figures, Accepted to ACL 2026 Findings
summary: A common challenge towards the adaptability of Large Language Models (LLMs) is their ability to learn new languages over time without hampering the model's performance on languages in which the model is already proficient (usually English). Continual fine-tuning (CFT) is the process of sequentially fine-tuning an LLM to enable the model to adapt to downstream tasks with varying data distributions and time shifts. This paper focuses on the language adaptability of LLMs through CFT. We study a two-phase CFT process in which an English-only end-to-end fine-tuned LLM from Phase 1 (predominantly Task Ability) is sequentially fine-tuned on a multilingual dataset -- comprising task data in new languages -- in Phase 2 (predominantly Language Ability). We observe that the ``similarity'' of Phase 2 tasks with Phase 1 determines the LLM's adaptability. For similar phase-wise datasets, the LLM after Phase 2 does not show deterioration in task ability. In contrast, when the phase-wise datasets are not similar, the LLM's task ability deteriorates. We test our hypothesis on the open-source \mis\ and \llm\ models with multiple phase-wise dataset pairs. To address the deterioration, we analyze tailored variants of two CFT methods: layer freezing and generative replay. Our findings demonstrate their effectiveness in enhancing the language ability of LLMs while preserving task performance, in comparison to relevant baselines.
comment: 19 pages, 6 tables, 4 figures, Accepted to ACL 2026 Findings

AI.title_translation: 探索用于增强大型语言模型语言能力的持续微调方法
AI.tldr: 研究发现通过层冻结和生成式重放，可以在持续微调大型语言模型以学习新语言时，有效避免对原有任务性能的损害。
AI.motivation: 解决大型语言模型在学习新语言时，如何在不损害原有（英语）任务性能的前提下，实现持续的语言适应性。
AI.method: 提出两阶段持续微调（CFT）过程：第一阶段侧重任务能力，第二阶段侧重多语言能力；引入层冻结（layer freezing）和生成式重放（generative replay）技术来解决阶段间任务不相似导致的性能劣化问题。
AI.result: 实验表明，当两阶段数据分布相似时，模型性能保持稳定；当不相似时，任务能力会下降。使用层冻结和生成式重放方法能有效提升多语言能力并保留原任务性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过合理选择持续微调策略（如层冻结和生成式重放），可以在增强大型语言模型多语言能力的同时，有效缓解因任务分布差异导致的性能衰退。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）适应性的一个常见挑战是它们在不断学习新语言的同时，不损害模型在已有熟练语言（通常是英语）上的表现。持续微调（CFT）是一个将LLM进行顺序微调，使其能够适应具有不同数据分布和时间偏移的下游任务的过程。本文重点研究了通过CFT实现的LLM语言适应性。我们研究了一个两阶段的CFT过程：第一阶段（主要侧重任务能力）对一个仅支持英语的端到端微调LLM进行处理，第二阶段（主要侧重语言能力）在包含新语言任务数据的多语言数据集上进行顺序微调。我们观察到，第二阶段任务与第一阶段任务的“相似性”决定了LLM的适应性。对于相似的阶段性数据集，LLM在第二阶段后不会表现出任务能力的下降。相反，当阶段性数据集不相似时，LLM的任务能力会下降。我们在开源的Mistral和LLaMA模型上，结合多组阶段性数据集对该假设进行了测试。为了解决这种性能衰退，我们分析了两种CFT方法的变体：层冻结和生成式重放。研究结果表明，与相关基线相比，这些方法在增强LLM语言能力的同时，能有效保持任务性能。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了大型语言模型（LLM）在持续微调（CFT）过程中的语言适应性问题。研究发现，两阶段微调中任务数据的相似度直接影响模型表现，不相似的数据分布会导致任务能力衰退。为此，作者通过引入层冻结和生成式重放技术，成功实现了在提升多语言能力的同时保持模型原有任务性能。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 持续微调, 多语言能力, 灾难性遗忘, 任务相似度
AI.comments: 该研究深刻揭示了大型语言模型在持续微调过程中的“灾难性遗忘”问题与任务相似度之间的内在联系。其创新之处在于提出并验证了通过层冻结（layer freezing）和生成式重放（generative replay）等方法来平衡语言扩展与原任务性能，为LLM的跨语言能力增强提供了实用的工程指导。

title: Cobblestone: A Divide-and-Conquer Approach for Automating Formal Verification
comments: 11 pages, 13 figures, Appearing at ICSE '26, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
summary: Formal verification using proof assistants, such as Coq, is an effective way of improving software quality, but requires significant effort and expertise. Machine learning can automatically synthesize proofs, but such tools are able to prove only a fraction of desired software properties. We introduce Cobblestone, a divide-and-conquer approach for proof synthesis. Cobblestone uses a large language model (LLM) to generate potential proofs, uses those proofs to break the problem into simpler parts, automatically identifies which of those parts were successfully proven, and iterates on the remaining parts to build a correct proof that is guaranteed to be sound, despite the reliance on unsound LLMs. We evaluate Cobblestone on four benchmarks of open-source Coq projects, controlling for training data leakage. Fully automatically, Cobblestone outperforms state-of-the-art non-LLM tools, and proves many theorems that other LLM-based tools cannot, and on many benchmarks, outperforms them. Each Cobblestone run costs only $1.25 and takes 14.7 minutes, on average. Cobblestone can also be used with external input, from a user or another tool, providing a proof structure or relevant lemmas. Evaluated with such an oracle, Cobblestone proves up to 58% of theorems. Overall, our research shows that tools can make use of partial progress and external input to more effectively automate formal verification.
comment: 11 pages, 13 figures, Appearing at ICSE '26, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

AI.title_translation: Cobblestone：一种用于自动化形式化验证的分治方法
AI.tldr: Cobblestone通过将复杂的证明任务拆解为可迭代处理的子任务，利用LLM辅助证明，实现了低成本、高效率且可靠的自动化形式化验证。
AI.motivation: 现有的形式化验证工具（如Coq证明助手）需要高昂的人力与专业知识，而现有的机器学习证明合成工具在证明覆盖率上存在局限性，难以处理复杂软件属性。
AI.method: 提出一种基于分治策略的证明合成框架。利用大语言模型（LLM）生成潜在证明，将复杂问题分解为更简单的子任务；通过自动识别已验证部分并迭代处理未完成部分，构建出逻辑严密且有保障的最终证明。
AI.result: 在四个开源Coq基准测试中，Cobblestone在全自动模式下优于现有非LLM工具及主流LLM工具。平均每次运行仅需1.25美元，耗时14.7分钟。在结合外部输入（Oracle）的情况下，其定理证明率最高可达58%。
AI.conclusion: Cobblestone通过分治策略和迭代式证明合成，实现了高效、可靠的自动形式化验证，显著优于现有工具，并展现了在人机协作模式下的巨大潜力。
AI.translation: 使用Coq等证明助手进行形式化验证是提高软件质量的有效方法，但需要投入大量的人力和专业知识。机器学习可以自动合成证明，但这些工具只能证明目标软件属性的一小部分。我们引入了Cobblestone，一种用于证明合成的分治方法。Cobblestone利用大语言模型（LLM）生成潜在证明，利用这些证明将问题分解为更简单的部分，自动识别成功证明的部分，并对剩余部分进行迭代，从而构建出保证可靠（Sound）的正确证明，尽管其依赖于不可靠的LLM。我们在四个开源Coq项目基准测试上评估了Cobblestone，并控制了训练数据泄露。在全自动模式下，Cobblestone的表现优于最先进的非LLM工具，证明了许多其他基于LLM的工具无法证明的定理，并且在许多基准测试中表现优于它们。平均而言，每次Cobblestone运行仅需1.25美元，耗时14.7分钟。Cobblestone还可以结合来自用户或其他工具的外部输入，提供证明结构或相关引理。在这样的预言机（Oracle）评估下，Cobblestone证明了高达58%的定理。总的来说，我们的研究表明，工具可以利用部分进展和外部输入来更有效地自动化形式化验证。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了Cobblestone，一种用于自动形式化验证的分治证明合成方法。该方法通过大语言模型分解复杂的证明任务，通过迭代处理子任务并利用自动化验证确保结果的正确性，有效克服了传统工具人力成本高和现有ML工具覆盖率低的瓶颈。实验证明，该方法在效率、成功率和经济性上均表现优异。
AI.keywords: 形式化验证, 证明合成, 分治策略, 大语言模型, Coq
AI.comments: Cobblestone的创新之处在于将分治策略引入形式化验证，有效缓解了单一LLM生成完整证明的困难。该方法通过迭代式分解证明任务，不仅提高了证明成功率，还通过自动化验证机制保证了证明的可靠性（Soundness），解决了LLM可能产生幻觉的问题。该研究在保持低成本的同时，显著提升了形式化验证的自动化程度，具有很高的实用价值。

title: From Cool Demos to Production-Ready FMware: Core Challenges and a Technology Roadmap
summary: The rapid expansion of foundation models (FMs), such as large language models (LLMs), has given rise to FMware, software systems that integrate FM(s) as core components. While building demonstration-level FMware is relatively straightforward, transitioning to production-ready systems presents numerous challenges, including reliability, high implementation costs, scalability, and compliance with privacy regulations. Our paper conducts a semi-structured thematic synthesis to identify key challenges in productionizing FMware across diverse data sources, including our industry experience developing FMArts, a FMware lifecycle engineering platform, and its integration into Huawei Cloud; grey literature; academic publications; hands-on involvement in the Open Platform for Enterprise AI (OPEA); organizing the AIware conference and bootcamp; and co-leading the ISO SPDX SBOM working group on AI and datasets. We identify critical issues in FM(s) selection, data and model alignment, prompt engineering, agent orchestration, system testing, and deployment, alongside cross-cutting concerns such as memory management, observability, and feedback integration. We discuss necessary technologies and strategies to address these challenges and offer guidance to enable the transition from demonstration systems to scalable, production-ready FMware solutions. Our findings underscore the importance of continued research and multi-industry collaboration to advance the development of production-ready FMware.

AI.title_translation: 从酷炫演示到生产级FMware：核心挑战与技术路线图
AI.tldr: 本文系统梳理了将基础模型应用从Demo推向生产环境的工程挑战，并提出了涵盖模型选择、编排、运维及合规性的技术路线图。
AI.motivation: 当前基础模型应用多停留在演示阶段，在向生产环境迁移时面临可靠性、成本、扩展性和合规性等严峻挑战，缺乏系统性的工程指导。
AI.method: 通过半结构化主题综合分析法，结合华为云FMArts平台开发经验、学术文献、灰皮书、OPEA开源实践以及ISO标准制定工作，总结出FMware生产化的核心挑战与技术路线。
AI.result: 识别了模型选择、数据对齐、提示工程、智能体编排及系统测试等关键挑战，并提出了涵盖内存管理、可观测性及反馈循环的技术路线与策略。
AI.conclusion: FMware的生产化需要跨学科的协作，从模型选择到系统运维的全生命周期管理是实现可扩展、可靠AI应用的关键。
AI.translation: 基础模型（FM，如大语言模型）的快速扩张催生了FMware，即以FM为核心组件的软件系统。虽然构建演示级的FMware相对容易，但过渡到生产就绪的系统面临诸多挑战，包括可靠性、高实现成本、可扩展性以及对隐私法规的合规性。本文通过半结构化主题综合分析，识别了生产化FMware的关键挑战，涵盖了来自华为云FMArts生命周期工程平台开发经验、灰皮书、学术出版物、参与企业AI开放平台（OPEA）、组织AIware会议及牵头ISO SPDX AI与数据集工作组的实践。我们识别了模型选择、数据与模型对齐、提示工程、智能体编排、系统测试及部署方面的关键问题，以及内存管理、可观测性和反馈集成等交叉领域关注点。我们讨论了应对这些挑战所需的技术和策略，并为实现从演示系统到可扩展、生产级FMware解决方案的过渡提供了指导。我们的研究结果强调了持续研究和多行业协作对于推动生产级FMware发展的重要性。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了从基础模型演示系统转向生产级FMware（以基础模型为核心的软件系统）所面临的工程挑战。作者通过多维度的行业实践与研究，梳理了FMware全生命周期中的关键痛点，并提出了相应的技术路线，旨在为构建可扩展、高可靠的生产级AI系统提供指导。
AI.keywords: 基础模型(FM), FMware, 生产化, 系统工程, 软件生命周期
AI.comments: 本文非常有意义，因为它将关注点从模型本身的研究转向了工业界落地最关心的工程化问题（FMware）。作者结合了华为云及OPEA等实际工业经验，使得提出的挑战和路线图具有很高的实践参考价值。

title: Why CNN Features Are not Gaussian: A Statistical Anatomy of Deep Representations
summary: Deep convolutional neural networks (CNNs) are commonly analyzed through geometric and linear-algebraic perspectives, yet the statistical distribution of their internal feature activations remains poorly understood. In many applications, deep features are implicitly treated as Gaussian when modeling densities. In this work, we empirically examine this assumption and show that it does not accurately describe the distribution of CNN feature activations. Through a systematic study across multiple architectures and datasets, we find that the feature activations deviate substantially from Gaussian and are better characterized by Weibull and related long-tailed distributions. We further introduce a novel Discretized Characteristic Function Copula (DCF-Copula) method to model multivariate feature dependencies. We find that tail-length increases with network depth and that upper-tail dependence emerges between feature pairs. These statistical findings are not consistent with the Central Limit Theorem, and are instead indicative of a Matthew process that progressively concentrates semantic signal within the tails. These statistical findings suggest that CNNs are excellent at noise reduction, yet poor at outlier removal tasks. We recommend the use of long-tailed upper-tail-dependent priors as opposed to Gaussian priors for accurately CNN deep feature density. Code available at https://github.com/dchapman-prof/DCF-Copula

AI.title_translation: 为什么CNN特征不是高斯分布：深度表征的统计剖析
AI.tldr: CNN特征并非高斯分布，而是具有长尾和上尾依赖的分布，建模时应使用长尾先验。
AI.motivation: 现有的深度学习分析多集中于几何和线性代数视角，而对内部特征的统计分布理解不足。许多应用中错误地将深度特征假设为高斯分布，作者旨在通过实证研究揭示其真实分布规律。
AI.method: 通过跨多种架构和数据集的实证分析，对比高斯分布与Weibull等长尾分布的拟合效果；引入离散特征函数Copula（DCF-Copula）方法来建模多元特征依赖关系。
AI.result: 研究发现CNN特征激活显著偏离高斯分布，更符合Weibull等长尾分布；特征尾部长度随网络深度增加而增长，且特征对之间存在上尾依赖性；这些发现符合Matthew过程，即语义信号在尾部集中。
AI.conclusion: CNN特征激活并非高斯分布，而是呈现出长尾特性和上尾依赖性。研究建议在建模CNN特征密度时，应采用长尾分布先验以取代传统的高斯先验。
AI.translation: 深度卷积神经网络（CNN）通常通过几何和线性代数的视角进行分析，但其内部特征激活的统计分布仍知之甚少。在许多应用中，深度特征在建模密度时被隐式地视为高斯分布。在这项工作中，我们实证检验了这一假设，并表明它并不能准确描述CNN特征激活的分布。通过对多种架构和数据集的系统研究，我们发现特征激活与高斯分布有显著偏离，用Weibull及相关长尾分布能更好地刻画。我们进一步引入了一种新的离散特征函数Copula（DCF-Copula）方法来建模多元特征依赖。我们发现尾部长度随网络深度增加，且特征对之间出现了上尾依赖。这些统计发现与中心极限定理不一致，反而表明存在一种Matthew过程，将语义信号逐步集中在尾部。这些发现表明，CNN在降噪方面表现出色，但在离群值去除任务上表现不佳。我们建议使用长尾上尾依赖先验，而不是高斯先验来准确描述CNN深度特征密度。代码见 https://github.com/dchapman-prof/DCF-Copula。
AI.summary: 本文通过实证研究探讨了CNN内部特征激活的统计分布，发现其并非高斯分布，而是表现出长尾特性。作者提出了DCF-Copula方法来建模特征依赖，并指出这种统计特性是由Matthew过程驱动的，即语义信号随网络加深在尾部聚拢。研究建议在建模CNN特征时应使用长尾先验。
AI.keywords: 卷积神经网络, 特征分布, 长尾分布, DCF-Copula, 统计建模
AI.comments: 该论文通过统计学视角揭示了CNN内部特征分布的本质，挑战了深度学习领域常见的“高斯分布”假设。其创新之处在于引入DCF-Copula方法，并提出了“Matthew过程”来解释特征随网络深度增加而呈现的长尾特性，这对理解深度学习的语义表达机制具有重要意义。

title: Aligned Vector Quantization for Edge-Cloud Collabrative Vision-Language Models
comments: I found a big mistake in the paper that causes significant bias on the results. The residual links are not taken into consideration when computing the transmission. All results about the compressed data size and transmission latency would be affected
summary: Vision Language Models (VLMs) are central to Visual Question Answering (VQA) systems and are typically deployed in the cloud due to their high computational demands. However, this cloud-only approach underutilizes edge computational resources and requires significant bandwidth for transmitting raw images. In this paper, we introduce an edge-cloud collaborative VQA system, called LLaVA-AlignedVQ, which features a novel Aligned Vector Quantization algorithm (AlignedVQ) that efficiently compress intermediate features without compromising accuracy to support partitioned execution. Our experiments demonstrate that LLaVA-AlignedVQ achieves approximately 1365x compression rate of intermediate features, reducing data transmission overhead by 96.8% compared to transmitting JPEG90-compressed images to the cloud. LLaVA-AlignedVQ achieves an inference speedup of 2-15x while maintaining high accuracy, remaining within -2.23% to +1.6% of the original model's accuracy performance across eight VQA datasets, compared to the cloud-only solution.
comment: I found a big mistake in the paper that causes significant bias on the results. The residual links are not taken into consideration when computing the transmission. All results about the compressed data size and transmission latency would be affected

AI.title_translation: 面向边缘云协同视觉语言模型的对齐矢量量化方法
AI.tldr: 通过AlignedVQ算法压缩中间特征，在保持高精度的同时，显著降低了边缘云协同视觉语言模型的传输开销并提升了推理速度。
AI.motivation: 传统的视觉语言模型（VLM）计算需求高，通常部署在云端，导致边缘设备计算资源闲置，且传输原始图像需要占用大量带宽。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为Aligned Vector Quantization (AlignedVQ) 的新算法，用于高效压缩视觉语言模型的中间特征，以支持边缘与云端之间的分区执行。
AI.result: 实现了约1365倍的中间特征压缩率；数据传输开销降低了96.8%；推理速度提升了2-15倍；在八个视觉问答数据集上，精度保持在原模型精度的-2.23%到+1.6%范围内。
AI.conclusion: LLaVA-AlignedVQ有效地实现了边缘云协同推理，在大幅降低传输开销和提高推理速度的同时，几乎保持了与云端独立模型相当的预测精度。
AI.translation: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）是视觉问答（VQA）系统的核心，由于其高计算需求，通常部署在云端。然而，这种纯云端的方案未充分利用边缘计算资源，且传输原始图像需要消耗大量带宽。在本文中，我们介绍了一种名为LLaVA-AlignedVQ的边缘云协同VQA系统，其特点是采用了一种新颖的对齐矢量量化算法（AlignedVQ），该算法能够在不牺牲精度的前提下高效压缩中间特征，以支持分区执行。实验表明，LLaVA-AlignedVQ实现了约1365倍的中间特征压缩率，与传输JPEG90压缩的图像到云端相比，减少了96.8%的数据传输开销。LLaVA-AlignedVQ在保持高精度的同时，实现了2-15倍的推理加速，在八个VQA数据集上，与纯云端解决方案相比，其精度保持在原始模型性能的-2.23%至+1.6%之间。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为LLaVA-AlignedVQ的边缘云协同视觉问答系统。该系统利用创新的AlignedVQ算法对中间特征进行压缩，通过在边缘和云端之间进行分区计算，显著减少了数据传输量并提升了推理速度，同时保持了接近原始模型的高精度。
AI.keywords: 视觉语言模型, 边缘云协同, 矢量量化, 特征压缩, 视觉问答
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入AlignedVQ算法，巧妙地解决了视觉语言模型在边缘云协同部署中面临的带宽与计算瓶颈问题。其核心创新在于实现了高压缩比与高精度保持之间的平衡，为资源受限的边缘设备应用大规模视觉模型提供了切实可行的路径。

title: Retrieval Augmented Time Series Forecasting
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is a central component of modern LLM systems, particularly in scenarios where up-to-date information is crucial for accurately responding to user queries or when queries exceed the scope of the training data. The advent of time-series foundation models (TSFM), such as Chronos, and the need for effective zero-shot forecasting performance across various time-series domains motivates the question: Do benefits of RAG similarly carry over to time series forecasting? In this paper, we advocate that the dynamic and event-driven nature of time-series data makes RAG a crucial component of TSFMs and introduce a principled RAG framework for time-series forecasting, called Retrieval Augmented Forecasting (RAF). Within RAF, we develop efficient strategies for retrieving related time-series examples and incorporating them into forecast. Through experiments and mechanistic studies, we demonstrate that RAF indeed improves the forecasting accuracy across diverse time series domains and the improvement is more significant for larger TSFM sizes.

AI.title_translation: 检索增强时间序列预测
AI.tldr: 将RAG技术引入时间序列预测，通过RAF框架检索相关示例辅助基础模型，显著提升了跨领域预测的准确性。
AI.motivation: 受到大语言模型中RAG技术的启发，探讨检索增强技术是否能提升时间序列基础模型（TSFM）在跨领域零样本预测任务中的表现，以应对时间序列数据的动态和事件驱动特性。
AI.method: 提出了检索增强预测（RAF）框架，包括开发了用于检索相关时间序列示例的高效策略，并将这些示例整合到预测过程中。
AI.result: 实验表明，RAF框架在多个时间序列领域显著提高了预测准确性，且这种提升在更大规模的时间序列基础模型上表现得更为明显。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的RAF框架有效证明了检索增强技术能够显著提升时间序列基础模型的预测准确性，且该提升效果与模型规模呈正相关。
AI.translation: 检索增强生成（RAG）是现代大语言模型系统的核心组件，特别是在需要最新信息以准确响应用户查询或查询超出训练数据范围的场景中。随着Chronos等时间序列基础模型（TSFM）的出现，以及在不同时间序列领域实现有效零样本预测的需求，引发了一个问题：RAG的优势是否同样适用于时间序列预测？在本文中，我们主张时间序列数据的动态和事件驱动特性使得RAG成为TSFM的关键组件，并引入了一个名为检索增强预测（RAF）的时间序列预测原则性RAG框架。在RAF中，我们开发了高效的策略来检索相关的时间序列示例并将它们纳入预测中。通过实验和机制研究，我们证明了RAF确实提高了跨不同时间序列领域的预测准确性，并且这种改进对于较大规模的TSFM更为显著。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了检索增强生成（RAG）在时间序列预测中的应用，提出了检索增强预测（RAF）框架。该框架通过检索相关的历史时间序列示例来辅助基础模型进行预测，从而提升了模型在动态和事件驱动数据场景下的零样本预测性能。
AI.keywords: 检索增强生成, 时间序列预测, 基础模型, 检索增强预测, 零样本预测
AI.comments: 本文创新性地将大语言模型领域的RAG范式迁移至时间序列预测领域，提出了RAF框架。这对于解决时间序列基础模型在零样本预测中的局限性具有重要意义，尤其是在面对动态和事件驱动的数据时。局限性方面，对于不同类型的时间序列数据，检索策略的通用性仍有待进一步验证。

title: Experimental Study of Underwater Acoustic Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces with Synthetic Reflection
summary: This paper presents an underwater acoustic reconfigurable intelligent surface (UA-RIS) designed for long-range, high-speed, and environmentally friendly communication in oceanic environments. The proposed UA-RIS comprises multiple pairs of acoustic reflectors that utilize a synthetic reflection scheme to flexibly control the amplitude and phase of reflected waves. This capability enables precise beam steering to enhance or attenuate sound levels in specific directions. A prototype UA-RIS with 4*6 acoustic reflection units is constructed and tested in both tank and lake environments to evaluate performance. Experimental results using a continuous wave (CW) as the source signal demonstrate that the prototype is capable of effectively pointing reflected waves to targeted directions while minimizing side lobes through synthetic reflection. Field tests reveal that deploying the UA-RIS on the sender side considerably extends communication ranges by 28% in deep water and 46% in shallow waters. Furthermore, with a fixed communication distance, positioning the UA-RIS at the transmitter side substantially boosts the receiving signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), with an average increase of 2.13 dB and peaks up to 2.92 dB. When positioned on the receiver side, the UA-RIS can expand the communication range in shallow and deep water environments by 40.6% and 66%, respectively. Moreover, placing the UA-RIS close to the receiver enhances SNR by an average of 2.56 dB, reaching up to 4.2 dB under certain circumstances.

AI.title_translation: 基于合成反射的水下声学可重构智能表面实验研究
AI.tldr: 本文设计了一种水下声学可重构智能表面（UA-RIS），通过合成反射技术控制声波，显著提升了水下通信的距离和信噪比。
AI.motivation: 针对水下环境长距离、高速率通信的需求，旨在利用可重构智能表面技术克服水下声波传播的复杂性，通过灵活控制声波反射来增强通信性能。
AI.method: 设计并制作了包含4*6个声反射单元的UA-RIS原型机，采用合成反射方案控制反射波的幅度和相位，并通过水箱与湖泊环境下的现场实验，测试了UA-RIS部署在发送端和接收端时的通信距离与信噪比改善情况。
AI.result: 实验表明，UA-RIS能有效实现波束定向指向并抑制旁瓣。部署在发送端可使通信距离提升28%-46%，接收信噪比提升2.13-2.92 dB；部署在接收端可使通信距离提升40.6%-66%，接收信噪比提升2.56-4.2 dB。
AI.conclusion: UA-RIS通过合成反射机制实现了对水声波束的精准控制，显著提升了水下通信的距离和信噪比，证明了其在复杂海洋环境中的巨大应用潜力。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一种用于海洋环境长距离、高速率且环保通信的水下声学可重构智能表面（UA-RIS）。所提出的UA-RIS包含多对声反射器，利用合成反射方案灵活控制反射波的幅度和相位。该能力实现了精确的波束操纵，以增强或衰减特定方向的声级。研究构建了一个包含4*6个声反射单元的UA-RIS原型机，并在水箱和湖泊环境中进行了性能测试。使用连续波（CW）作为源信号的实验结果表明，该原型机能够通过合成反射有效地将反射波指向目标方向，同时最小化旁瓣。现场测试显示，在发送端部署UA-RIS可使深水和浅水的通信距离分别显著增加28%和46%。此外，在固定通信距离下，将UA-RIS放置在发送端可显著提高接收信噪比（SNR），平均提升2.13 dB，峰值达到2.92 dB。当放置在接收端时，UA-RIS可分别将浅水和深水环境的通信距离扩大40.6%和66%。此外，将UA-RIS放置在靠近接收器处可使SNR平均提升2.56 dB，在某些情况下最高可达4.2 dB。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于水下通信的声学可重构智能表面（UA-RIS），通过合成反射方案灵活控制声波的幅度和相位，实现精准波束赋形。原型机实验证明，该技术能显著延长通信距离并提高接收信噪比，为改善海洋环境下的通信质量提供了有效方案。
AI.keywords: 水声通信, 可重构智能表面, 合成反射, 波束赋形, 信噪比增强
AI.comments: 该研究通过实证方法验证了水声领域中可重构智能表面（RIS）的有效性，不仅提出了创新的合成反射方案，还通过水箱和湖泊实验提供了强有力的性能数据支持，为未来长距离、高效能的水下无线通信提供了可行的硬件解决方案。其局限性在于目前主要基于连续波信号进行测试，未来需进一步研究复杂调制信号下的性能表现。

title: Advancing Object-Centric Process Mining with Multi-Dimensional Data Operations
summary: Analyzing process data at varying levels of granularity is important to derive actionable insights and support informed decision-making. Object-Centric Event Data (OCED) enhances process mining by capturing interactions among events and multiple objects, leading to the discovery of more detailed and realistic yet complex process models. The lack of methods to adjust the granularity of the analysis prevents users from leveraging the full potential of Object-Centric Process Mining (OCPM). To address this gap, we propose four operations: drill-down, roll-up, unfold, and fold, which enable analysts to change the granularity of analysis when working with Object-Centric Event Logs (OCEL). These operations allow analysts to seamlessly transition between detailed and aggregated process models, facilitating the discovery of insights that require varying levels of abstraction. We formally define these operations and implement them in an open-source Python library. To validate their utility, we applied the approach to real-world OCEL data extracted from a learning management system, covering a four-year period and approximately 400 students, as a case of object-centric educational process mining. This case study shows significant improvements in the precision and fitness of the discovered models after applying the operations. In addition, we evaluate the scalability of the operators on large, publicly available OCELs derived from the Business Process Intelligence Challenge datasets, demonstrating that the operations remain computationally feasible on industrial-scale event logs. This approach can empower analysts to perform more flexible and comprehensive process exploration, unlocking actionable insights through flexible granularity adjustments.

AI.title_translation: 利用多维数据操作推进以对象为中心的过程挖掘
AI.tldr: 本文提出了四种针对对象中心事件日志的粒度调整操作，通过在不同抽象级别间灵活切换，提升了过程挖掘的洞察能力和模型质量。
AI.motivation: 现有的对象中心过程挖掘（OCPM）缺乏调整分析粒度的方法，限制了用户深入挖掘复杂交互数据中潜在洞察的能力。
AI.method: 提出了四种对象中心事件日志（OCEL）操作：drill-down（下钻）、roll-up（上卷）、unfold（展开）和fold（折叠），用于灵活调整分析粒度，并开发了相应的开源Python库。
AI.result: 通过学习管理系统数据的案例研究证明，这些操作显著提高了发现过程模型的精确度和拟合度；同时，在BPIC数据集上的评估显示，该方法在工业规模的事件日志中具有良好的计算可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的多维数据操作有效解决了OCPM中分析粒度调整的难题，通过在不同抽象层次间灵活切换，显著提升了过程模型的发现质量，且在工业级数据规模下表现出良好的可扩展性。
AI.translation: 在不同粒度水平上分析过程数据对于获取可操作的见解和支持知情决策至关重要。对象中心事件数据（OCED）通过捕捉事件与多个对象之间的交互来增强过程挖掘，从而发现更详细、更真实但更复杂的流程模型。由于缺乏调整分析粒度的方法，用户无法充分发挥对象中心过程挖掘（OCPM）的潜力。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了四种操作：drill-down（下钻）、roll-up（上卷）、unfold（展开）和fold（折叠），使分析人员在处理对象中心事件日志（OCEL）时能够改变分析粒度。这些操作允许分析人员在详细和聚合的过程模型之间无缝转换，有助于发现需要不同抽象水平的见解。我们正式定义了这些操作，并在一个开源Python库中实现了它们。为了验证其效用，我们将该方法应用于从学习管理系统中提取的真实OCEL数据，该数据涵盖了四年期间约400名学生，作为对象中心教育过程挖掘的一个案例。该案例研究表明，在应用这些操作后，发现模型的精确度和拟合度有了显著提高。此外，我们评估了这些算子在从业务流程智能挑战数据集派生的大型、公开可用的OCEL上的可扩展性，证明了这些操作在工业级事件日志上仍然是计算可行的。这种方法可以使分析人员能够进行更灵活、更全面的过程探索，通过灵活的粒度调整解锁可操作的见解。
AI.summary: 本文针对对象中心过程挖掘中粒度调整缺失的问题，提出了四种数据操作方法（drill-down, roll-up, unfold, fold），旨在实现对象中心事件日志在不同抽象层次间的无缝切换，从而提升复杂流程分析的灵活性与洞察深度。
AI.keywords: 对象中心过程挖掘, 事件日志, 数据粒度, 过程模型, 多维数据操作
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地引入了四种数据操作（drill-down, roll-up, unfold, fold），为解决对象中心过程挖掘（OCPM）中分析粒度调整困难的问题提供了切实可行的方案。其贡献在于不仅在理论上定义了这些操作，还通过开源库实现并验证了其在复杂真实数据集上的有效性和可扩展性，对于提升过程模型的准确性和实用性具有重要意义。

title: Perturb and Recover: Fine-tuning for Effective Backdoor Removal from CLIP
summary: Vision-Language models like CLIP have been shown to be highly effective at linking visual perception and natural language understanding, enabling sophisticated image-text capabilities, including strong retrieval and zero-shot classification performance. Their widespread use, as well as the fact that CLIP models are trained on image-text pairs from the web, make them both a worthwhile and relatively easy target for backdoor attacks. As training foundational models, such as CLIP, from scratch is very expensive, this paper focuses on cleaning potentially poisoned models via fine-tuning. We first show that existing cleaning techniques are not effective against simple structured triggers used in Blended or BadNet backdoor attacks, exposing a critical vulnerability for potential real-world deployment of these models. Then, we introduce PAR, Perturb and Recover, a surprisingly simple yet effective mechanism to remove backdoors from CLIP models. Through extensive experiments across different encoders and types of backdoor attacks, we show that PAR achieves high backdoor removal rate while preserving good standard performance. Finally, we illustrate that our approach is effective even only with synthetic text-image pairs, i.e. without access to real training data. The code and models are available on \href{https://github.com/nmndeep/PerturbAndRecover}{GitHub}.

AI.title_translation: 扰动与恢复：用于从CLIP中有效移除后门的微调方法
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为PAR的微调方法，无需原始训练数据即可高效清除CLIP模型中的后门，同时保证模型性能不受损。
AI.motivation: CLIP等视觉-语言模型容易受到后门攻击，而从头重新训练的成本极高。现有清洗技术在对抗结构化后门触发器时效果不佳，因此亟需一种针对CLIP模型的有效且低成本的后门清除方法。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为PAR（Perturb and Recover）的微调机制。该方法通过在模型上进行扰动并随后进行恢复训练，从而清除后门触发器，且无需访问原始训练数据，仅利用合成的文本-图像对即可实施。
AI.result: 实验表明，PAR在多种编码器和不同类型的后门攻击下均能实现高后门清除率，同时保持了良好的模型标准性能，且在仅使用合成数据时依然有效。
AI.conclusion: PAR方法通过微调成功移除了CLIP模型中的后门，在保持模型原始性能的同时实现了高后门清除率，且具备数据高效性，为保障视觉-语言模型安全提供了有效方案。
AI.translation: 像CLIP这样的视觉-语言模型已被证明在连接视觉感知和自然语言理解方面非常有效，实现了包括强大的检索和零样本分类性能在内的复杂图像-文本能力。它们的广泛使用，以及CLIP模型是在来自网络的图像-文本对上训练的事实，使它们成为后门攻击既有价值又相对容易的目标。由于从头开始训练CLIP等基础模型非常昂贵，本文重点研究通过微调来清理潜在的受污染模型。我们首先证明，现有的清洗技术对于Blended或BadNet后门攻击中使用的简单结构化触发器无效，这暴露了这些模型在潜在现实部署中的严重漏洞。然后，我们引入了PAR（Perturb and Recover），这是一种简单而有效的机制，用于从CLIP模型中移除后门。通过跨不同编码器和不同类型后门攻击的广泛实验，我们表明PAR在保持良好标准性能的同时实现了高后门清除率。最后，我们说明了我们的方法即使仅使用合成文本-图像对也是有效的，即无需访问真实的训练数据。代码和模型可在GitHub上获取。
AI.summary: 针对CLIP模型面临的后门攻击威胁，本文提出了PAR（扰动与恢复）方法。该方法通过简单的微调机制，在不依赖原始训练数据的情况下，有效去除了模型中的后门触发器，并维持了模型原有的分类与检索能力。
AI.keywords: CLIP, 后门防御, 模型微调, 视觉-语言模型, 模型安全
AI.comments: 该研究针对CLIP模型易受后门攻击且现有防御手段失效的问题，提出了一种简洁高效的微调修复方法。其创新点在于通过“扰动与恢复”机制，无需原始训练数据即可实现后门清除，具有很强的实用价值和现实意义。

title: Regional climate risk assessment from climate models using probabilistic machine learning
summary: Effective climate risk assessment is hindered by the resolution gap between coarse global climate models and the fine-scale information needed for regional decisions. We introduce GenFocal, an AI framework that generates statistically accurate, fine-scale weather from coarse climate projections, without requiring paired simulated and observed events during training. GenFocal synthesizes complex and long-lived hazards, such as heat waves and tropical cyclones, even when they are not well represented in the coarse climate projections. It also samples high-impact, rare events more accurately than leading methods. By translating large-scale climate projections into actionable, localized information, GenFocal provides a powerful new paradigm to improve climate adaptation and resilience strategies.

AI.title_translation: 基于概率机器学习的气候模型区域气候风险评估
AI.tldr: GenFocal框架利用概率机器学习将粗糙的气候投影转化为高精度的区域天气信息，无需配对训练数据即可准确模拟罕见的极端天气事件。
AI.motivation: 全球气候模型的分辨率过低，无法直接满足区域气候风险评估和决策的需求，存在显著的“分辨率鸿沟”。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为GenFocal的AI框架，该框架利用概率机器学习技术，能够在无需配对模拟和观测事件进行训练的情况下，将粗糙的气候投影转化为统计上准确、精细尺度的天气信息。
AI.result: GenFocal能够合成复杂且持续时间长的极端天气（如热浪和热带气旋），即使这些事件在粗糙的气候投影中表现不佳；同时，该方法在采样高影响、罕见事件方面比现有领先方法更准确。
AI.conclusion: GenFocal框架通过概率机器学习有效弥合了全球气候模型与区域决策所需精细尺度信息之间的鸿沟，为提升气候适应能力提供了一种强有力的新范式。
AI.translation: 有效的气候风险评估受到粗糙的全球气候模型与区域决策所需的精细尺度信息之间的分辨率鸿沟的阻碍。我们引入了GenFocal，这是一个AI框架，它可以在无需在训练期间需要配对模拟和观测事件的情况下，生成统计上准确、精细尺度的天气信息。GenFocal能够合成复杂且持续时间长的危险事件，例如热浪和热带气旋，即使它们在粗糙的气候投影中表现不佳。它还比领先的方法更准确地采样了高影响、罕见的事件。通过将大规模气候投影转化为可操作的、局部化的信息，GenFocal提供了一种强大的新范式，以改善气候适应和恢复力策略。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了GenFocal，这是一个旨在解决气候模型分辨率局限性的AI框架。它能够在缺乏配对训练数据的情况下，将粗糙的全球气候投影转换为高分辨率的区域天气信息，并能更精确地模拟罕见且具有高影响力的极端天气事件，从而支持更有效的区域气候风险评估。
AI.keywords: 气候风险评估, 概率机器学习, 降尺度, 极端天气, 气候适应
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地使用概率机器学习解决了气候模型的分辨率鸿沟问题，特别是不依赖配对训练数据的特性使其在实际应用中更具灵活性。其能够生成极端天气事件的能力对于气候适应策略的制定具有极高的实用价值。

title: Towards Robust and Realistic Human Pose Estimation via WiFi Signals
summary: Robust WiFi-based human pose estimation (HPE) is a challenging task that bridges discrete and subtle WiFi signals to human skeletons. We revisit this problem and reveal two critical yet overlooked issues: 1) cross-domain gap, i.e., due to significant discrepancies in pose distributions between source and target domains; and 2) structural fidelity gap, i.e., predicted skeletal poses manifest distorted topology, usually with misplaced joints and disproportionate bone lengths. This paper fills these gaps by reformulating the task into a novel two-phase framework dubbed DT-Pose: Domain-consistent representation learning and Topology-constrained Pose decoding. Concretely, we first propose a temporal consistency contrastive learning strategy with uniformity regularization, integrated into a self-supervised masked pretraining paradigm. This design facilitates robust learning of domain-consistent and motion-discriminative WiFi representations while mitigating potential mode collapse caused by signal sparsity. Beyond this, we introduce an effective hybrid decoding architecture that incorporates explicit skeletal topology constraints. By compensating for the inherent absence of spatial priors in WiFi semantic vectors, the decoder enables structured modeling of both adjacent and overarching joint relationships, producing more realistic pose predictions. Extensive experiments conducted on various benchmark datasets highlight the superior performance of our method in tackling these fundamental challenges in 2D/3D WiFi-based HPE tasks. The associated code is released at https://github.com/cseeyangchen/DT-Pose.

AI.title_translation: 迈向鲁棒且真实的人体姿态估计：基于WiFi信号的研究
AI.tldr: 本文提出DT-Pose框架，通过自监督对比学习和拓扑约束解码，解决了WiFi人体姿态估计中跨域差异大和骨骼结构畸变的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基于WiFi的人体姿态估计存在两个关键问题：一是源域和目标域之间姿态分布差异导致的跨域鸿沟；二是预测出的骨骼结构常出现关节位置错位或骨骼长度比例失调的结构保真度缺失。
AI.method: 提出DT-Pose两阶段框架：1. 域一致性表示学习：利用带一致性正则化的时序对比学习进行自监督掩码预训练；2. 拓扑约束姿态解码：采用混合解码架构，结合显式骨骼拓扑约束，建模关节间的空间关系。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，DT-Pose在2D/3D WiFi人体姿态估计任务中表现优异，显著提升了姿态预测的鲁棒性和真实性。
AI.conclusion: DT-Pose框架通过域一致性表示学习和拓扑约束姿态解码，有效解决了WiFi信号人体姿态估计中的跨域和结构畸变难题，实现了更鲁棒、更真实的姿态估计。
AI.translation: 鲁棒的基于WiFi的人体姿态估计（HPE）是一项将离散且微妙的WiFi信号与人体骨骼联系起来的挑战性任务。我们重新审视了这个问题，并揭示了两个关键但被忽视的问题：1）跨域鸿沟，即由于源域和目标域之间姿态分布的显著差异；2）结构保真度鸿沟，即预测的骨骼姿态表现出扭曲的拓扑结构，通常伴有错位的关节和不成比例的骨骼长度。本文通过将该任务重新表述为一个名为DT-Pose的新颖两阶段框架来填补这些空白：域一致性表示学习和拓扑约束姿态解码。具体而言，我们首先提出了一种具有均匀性正则化的时序一致性对比学习策略，并将其集成到自监督掩码预训练范式中。这种设计促进了域一致性和运动判别性WiFi表示的鲁棒学习，同时缓解了由信号稀疏性引起的潜在模式坍塌。此外，我们引入了一种结合了显式骨骼拓扑约束的有效混合解码架构。通过补偿WiFi语义向量中固有的空间先验缺失，解码器能够对相邻和整体关节关系进行结构化建模，从而产生更真实的人体姿态预测。在各种基准数据集上进行的广泛实验突显了我们的方法在解决基于WiFi的2D/3D HPE任务中这些基本挑战时的卓越性能。相关代码已在 https://github.com/cseeyangchen/DT-Pose 发布。
AI.summary: 本文提出了DT-Pose框架，旨在解决WiFi信号人体姿态估计中的跨域和结构畸变问题。通过引入时序一致性对比学习实现域一致的特征表示，并利用结合骨骼拓扑约束的混合解码器提高预测姿态的结构真实性。实验证明该方法在2D/3D任务中均具有卓越性能。
AI.keywords: WiFi人体姿态估计, 跨域学习, 拓扑约束, 对比学习, 自监督预训练
AI.comments: 该论文针对基于WiFi的人体姿态估计（HPE）中长期被忽视的跨域差异和结构保真度问题，提出了创新的两阶段框架。通过自监督掩码预训练中的时序一致性对比学习解决域一致性问题，并通过混合解码器引入显式骨骼拓扑约束来提升姿态的真实感，在2D/3D WiFi HPE任务中表现出色，具有重要的学术与应用价值。

title: VarDrop: Enhancing Training Efficiency by Reducing Variate Redundancy in Periodic Time Series Forecasting
summary: Variate tokenization, which independently embeds each variate as separate tokens, has achieved remarkable improvements in multivariate time series forecasting. However, employing self-attention with variate tokens incurs a quadratic computational cost with respect to the number of variates, thus limiting its training efficiency for large-scale applications. To address this issue, we propose VarDrop, a simple yet efficient strategy that reduces the token usage by omitting redundant variate tokens during training. VarDrop adaptively excludes redundant tokens within a given batch, thereby reducing the number of tokens used for dot-product attention while preserving essential information. Specifically, we introduce k-dominant frequency hashing (k-DFH), which utilizes the ranked dominant frequencies in the frequency domain as a hash value to efficiently group variate tokens exhibiting similar periodic behaviors. Then, only representative tokens in each group are sampled through stratified sampling. By performing sparse attention with these selected tokens, the computational cost of scaled dot-product attention is significantly alleviated. Experiments conducted on public benchmark datasets demonstrate that VarDrop outperforms existing efficient baselines.

AI.title_translation: VarDrop：通过减少周期性时间序列预测中的变体冗余来提高训练效率
AI.tldr: VarDrop 通过利用频率相似性自适应减少冗余的变体标记，显著降低了多变量时间序列预测模型中自注意力的计算成本。
AI.motivation: 多元时间序列预测中，基于变体标记的自注意力机制会导致计算成本随变体数量呈二次方增长，限制了大规模应用。
AI.method: 提出 VarDrop 策略，包含 k-dominant frequency hashing (k-DFH) 用于根据周期性行为将变体标记分组，并结合分层采样（stratified sampling）选择代表性标记进行稀疏注意力计算。
AI.result: 实验证明 VarDrop 在保持预测性能的前提下，显著降低了计算成本，并优于现有的高效基线模型。
AI.conclusion: VarDrop 是一种有效的训练策略，通过自适应减少冗余标记，在保持高性能的同时降低了自注意力机制的计算开销。
AI.translation: 变体标记化（Variate tokenization）通过将每个变体独立嵌入为单独的标记，在多元时间序列预测中取得了显著改进。然而，将自注意力机制应用于变体标记会导致计算成本随变体数量呈二次方增长，从而限制了其在大规模应用中的训练效率。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了 VarDrop，这是一种简单而有效的策略，通过在训练期间省略冗余的变体标记来减少标记的使用量。VarDrop 自适应地剔除给定批次内的冗余标记，从而在保留必要信息的同时减少了用于点积注意力计算的标记数量。具体而言，我们引入了 k-主频哈希（k-DFH），它利用频域中排序后的主频作为哈希值，高效地对表现出相似周期行为的变体标记进行分组。随后，仅通过分层采样从每组中选择代表性标记。通过对这些选定的标记执行稀疏注意力计算，缩放点积注意力的计算成本得到了显著缓解。在公共基准数据集上进行的实验表明，VarDrop 优于现有的高效基线方法。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为 VarDrop 的训练策略，旨在降低多元时间序列预测中变体标记带来的计算冗余。通过引入 k-DFH 方法对具有相似周期行为的标记进行分组并分层采样，该方法实现了稀疏注意力计算，从而在保证精度的同时大幅提升了训练效率。
AI.keywords: 多元时间序列预测, 变体标记, 计算效率, 频率哈希, 稀疏注意力
AI.comments: 该论文通过一种直观且高效的策略（VarDrop）解决了多元时间序列预测中变体标记（variate tokens）带来的计算冗余问题。其核心创新点在于利用频率域特性（k-DFH）进行分组采样，而非简单的随机丢弃，这在保证预测精度的同时显著提升了训练效率，具有很强的实用价值。

title: ENTER: Event Based Interpretable Reasoning for VideoQA
summary: In this paper, we present ENTER, an interpretable Video Question Answering (VideoQA) system based on event graphs. Event graphs convert videos into graphical representations, where video events form the nodes and event-event relationships (temporal/causal/hierarchical) form the edges. This structured representation offers many benefits: 1) Interpretable VideoQA via generated code that parses event-graph; 2) Incorporation of contextual visual information in the reasoning process (code generation) via event graphs; 3) Robust VideoQA via Hierarchical Iterative Update of the event graphs. Existing interpretable VideoQA systems are often top-down, disregarding low-level visual information in the reasoning plan generation, and are brittle. While bottom-up approaches produce responses from visual data, they lack interpretability. Experimental results on NExT-QA, IntentQA, and EgoSchema demonstrate that not only does our method outperform existing top-down approaches while obtaining competitive performance against bottom-up approaches, but more importantly, offers superior interpretability and explainability in the reasoning process.

AI.title_translation: ENTER：基于事件的视频问答可解释推理系统
AI.tldr: ENTER通过构建视频事件图并生成解析代码，在提升视频问答鲁棒性的同时，实现了透明、可解释的推理过程。
AI.motivation: 现有的可解释VideoQA系统多为自顶向下，忽略了底层视觉信息且鲁棒性差；而自底向上的方法虽精度较高，但缺乏可解释性。因此，需要一种既能利用底层视觉信息，又能保持推理可解释性的新方法。
AI.method: 提出ENTER系统，将视频转换为包含事件节点与时序/因果/层级关系的事件图；通过解析事件图生成推理代码；利用分层迭代更新（Hierarchical Iterative Update）机制提升推理的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在NExT-QA、IntentQA和EgoSchema数据集上的实验表明，ENTER优于现有自顶向下方法，性能与自底向上方法相当，且在推理过程的可解释性方面表现更优。
AI.conclusion: ENTER证明了基于事件图的结构化表示是实现兼具高精度与高可解释性VideoQA系统的有效途径。
AI.translation: 在本文中，我们提出了ENTER，一个基于事件图的可解释视频问答（VideoQA）系统。事件图将视频转换为图形表示，其中视频事件构成节点，事件间的关系（时序/因果/层级）构成边。这种结构化表示提供了诸多优势：1）通过解析事件图的生成代码实现可解释的VideoQA；2）通过事件图在推理过程（代码生成）中整合上下文视觉信息；3）通过事件图的分层迭代更新实现稳健的VideoQA。现有的可解释VideoQA系统通常是自顶向下的，在推理计划生成时忽略了低层视觉信息，且系统较为脆弱。虽然自底向上的方法从视觉数据中产生响应，但它们缺乏可解释性。在NExT-QA、IntentQA和EgoSchema上的实验结果表明，我们的方法不仅优于现有的自顶向下方法，且在性能上与自底向上方法具有竞争力，更重要的是，在推理过程中提供了卓越的可解释性和说明性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了ENTER系统，一种基于事件图的可解释视频问答框架。通过将视频转化为包含事件及其时序、因果与层级关系的结构化图形，ENTER实现了基于代码生成的推理，并利用分层迭代更新提升了系统鲁棒性，成功平衡了视频问答的精度与可解释性。
AI.keywords: VideoQA, 事件图, 可解释性, 代码生成, 视频理解
AI.comments: ENTER通过引入事件图（Event Graphs）有效桥接了自顶向下（可解释性强但缺乏细节）和自底向上（精度高但缺乏可解释性）两种方法。其核心创新在于将视频结构化为事件图，利用代码生成实现可解释的推理，并结合分层迭代更新机制，在复杂数据集上表现稳健。

title: How Humans Help LLMs: Assessing and Incentivizing Human Preference Annotators
summary: Human-annotated preference data play an important role in aligning large language models (LLMs). In this paper, we study two connected questions: how to monitor the quality of human preference annotators and how to incentivize them to provide high-quality annotations. In current practice, expert-based monitoring is a natural workhorse for quality control, but it performs poorly in preference annotation because annotators are heterogeneous and downstream model performance is an indirect and noisy proxy for annotation quality. We therefore propose a self-consistency monitoring scheme tailored to preference annotation, and analyze the statistical sample complexity of both methods. This practitioner-facing analysis identifies how many inspected samples are needed to reliably assess an annotator and shows when self-consistency monitoring can outperform expert-based monitoring. We then use the resulting monitoring signal as the performance measure in a principal-agent model, which lets us study a second sample-complexity question: how many monitored samples are needed before simple contracts perform close to the ideal benchmark in which annotation quality is perfectly observable. Under this continuous action space, we show that this shortfall scales as $Θ(1/\sqrt{\mathcal{I} n \log n})$ for binary contracts and $Θ(1/(\mathcal{I}n))$ for linear contracts, where $\mathcal{I}$ is the Fisher information and $n$ is the number of samples; we further show that the linear contracts are rate-optimal among general contracts. This contrasts with the known result that binary contracts are optimal and of $\exp(-Θ(n))$ when the action space is discrete \citep{frick2023monitoring}.

AI.title_translation: 人类如何帮助大语言模型：评估与激励人类偏好标注者
AI.tldr: 本文通过自洽性检测和委托代理模型，为大模型标注者的质量评估与最优合同设计提供了理论框架，证明了线性合同在标注激励中的最优性。
AI.motivation: 当前大模型对齐依赖人类反馈标注，但标注者质量参差不齐，且现有的专家监测方法在偏好标注场景下效果不佳，缺乏有效的标注者质量监测与激励机制。
AI.method: 提出了基于自洽性（self-consistency）的标注质量监测方案，并利用委托代理模型（principal-agent model）分析了在不同样本量下，二元合同与线性合同的性能表现及样本复杂度。
AI.result: 分析发现，在连续动作空间下，二元合同的性能差距随样本量缩放为 $\Theta(1/\sqrt{\mathcal{I} n \log n})$，而线性合同为 $\Theta(1/(\mathcal{I}n))$；证明了线性合同在一般合同中具有速率最优性。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，在偏好标注的连续动作空间下，线性合同是速率最优的。自洽性监测在特定条件下优于专家监测，且通过合理的样本监测，简单的激励合同即可接近理想的完全信息基准。
AI.translation: 人类标注的偏好数据在大语言模型（LLM）的对齐过程中起着重要作用。在本文中，我们研究了两个相关问题：如何监测人类偏好标注者的质量，以及如何激励他们提供高质量的标注。在目前的实践中，基于专家的监测是质量控制的常用手段，但在偏好标注中表现不佳，因为标注者具有异质性，且下游模型性能是标注质量的一个间接且嘈杂的代理指标。因此，我们提出了一种针对偏好标注的自洽性监测方案，并分析了两种方法的统计样本复杂度。这种面向从业者的分析确定了需要多少检查样本才能可靠地评估标注者，并展示了自洽性监测在何时可以优于基于专家的监测。然后，我们将所得的监测信号作为委托代理模型中的绩效衡量标准，这使我们能够研究第二个样本复杂度问题：在标注质量可以被完美观察到的理想基准下，需要多少监测样本才能使简单合同的表现接近该基准。在连续动作空间下，我们证明了这种差距对于二元合同按 $\Theta(1/\sqrt{\mathcal{I} n \log n})$ 缩放，对于线性合同按 $\Theta(1/(\mathcal{I}n))$ 缩放，其中 $\mathcal{I}$ 是费舍尔信息量，$n$ 是样本数量；我们进一步证明线性合同在一般合同中是速率最优的。这与已知的结果形成对比，即当动作空间是离散时，二元合同是最优的且为 $\exp(-\Theta(n))$。
AI.summary: 本文研究了如何评估和激励大模型的人类偏好标注者。作者提出了一种针对偏好标注的自洽性监测方案，并利用委托代理理论分析了标注质量评估的样本复杂度，证明了线性激励合同在连续动作空间下优于二元合同，并具备速率最优性。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 人类反馈对齐, 机制设计, 标注质量评估, 激励合同
AI.comments: 该研究通过机制设计理论（委托代理模型）解决了大模型人类反馈强化学习（RLHF）中标注者质量评估与激励的难题。其创新点在于将自洽性（self-consistency）监测引入标注质量控制，并从理论上推导了不同合同形式下的样本复杂度和最优性，为工业界设计标注者激励机制提供了严格的数学指导。

title: MultiFileTest: A Multi-File-Level LLM Unit Test Generation Benchmark and Impact of Error Fixing Mechanisms
summary: Unit test generation has become a promising and important Large Language Model (LLM) use case. However, existing evaluation benchmarks for LLM unit test generation focus on function- or class-level code (single-file) rather than more practical and challenging multi-file-level codebases. To address such a limitation, we propose MultiFileTest, a multi-file-level benchmark for unit test generation covering Python, Java, and JavaScript. MultiFileTest features 20 moderate-sized and high-quality projects per language. We evaluate eleven frontier LLMs on MultiFileTest, and the results show that most frontier LLMs tested exhibit moderate performance on MultiFileTest, highlighting the difficulty of MultiFileTest. We also conduct a thorough error analysis, which shows that even advanced LLMs, such as Gemini-3.0-Pro, exhibit basic yet critical errors, including executability and cascade errors. Motivated by this observation, we further evaluate all frontier LLMs under manual error-fixing and self-error-fixing scenarios to assess their potential when equipped with error-fixing mechanisms. Our code and dataset is available at \href{https://github.com/YiboWANG214/ProjectTest}{MultiFileTest}.

AI.title_translation: MultiFileTest：一种多文件级LLM单元测试生成基准及错误修复机制的影响研究
AI.tldr: 本文推出了MultiFileTest基准，专门用于评估大模型在多文件项目中的单元测试生成能力，并研究了错误修复机制对提升生成质量的作用。
AI.motivation: 现有单元测试生成基准主要局限于函数或类级别（单文件），无法满足现实中多文件代码库的复杂需求。
AI.method: 提出了MultiFileTest基准，涵盖Python、Java、JavaScript三种语言共60个项目；评估了11个前沿LLM的性能；通过人工修复和自修复两种场景分析了模型的错误修复能力。
AI.result: 大多数前沿LLM在MultiFileTest上表现一般；分析发现模型存在严重的执行错误和级联错误；实验证明错误修复机制能有效提升模型的测试生成能力。
AI.conclusion: MultiFileTest证明了多文件单元测试生成的复杂性与挑战，现有的LLM在处理跨文件依赖时仍存在显著的错误率，需引入更有效的错误修复机制。
AI.translation: 单元测试生成已成为大语言模型（LLM）一个极具前景且重要的应用场景。然而，现有的LLM单元测试生成评估基准主要集中在函数或类级别（单文件）的代码，而非更实际且具有挑战性的多文件代码库。为了解决这一局限，我们提出了MultiFileTest，这是一个涵盖Python、Java和JavaScript的多文件级单元测试生成基准。MultiFileTest为每种语言提供了20个中等规模且高质量的项目。我们对11个前沿LLM进行了评估，结果显示大多数模型在MultiFileTest上的表现平平，凸显了该基准的难度。我们还进行了深入的错误分析，发现即使是先进的LLM（如Gemini-3.0-Pro）也会出现基础但关键的错误，包括可执行性错误和级联错误。基于此观察，我们进一步评估了所有前沿LLM在人工错误修复和自我错误修复场景下的表现，以评估其在配备错误修复机制后的潜力。我们的代码和数据集可在 https://github.com/YiboWANG214/ProjectTest 获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了MultiFileTest，这是一个针对多文件代码库的单元测试生成基准。通过对11个前沿LLM进行评估，研究发现模型在处理多文件依赖时表现欠佳，并分析了常见的执行和级联错误，进一步验证了错误修复机制对提升模型性能的重要性。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 单元测试生成, 多文件基准, 错误修复, 代码智能
AI.comments: 该研究通过从单文件转向多文件代码库，显著提升了单元测试生成基准的现实意义。其对错误修复机制的深入探讨为后续提升LLM编码能力的路径提供了实证依据。

title: A Systematic Survey of Semantic Role Labeling in the Era of Pretrained Language Models
summary: Semantic role labeling (SRL) is a central natural language processing task for understanding predicate-argument structures within texts and enabling downstream applications. Despite extensive research, comprehensive surveys that critically synthesize the field from a unified perspective remain lacking. This survey makes several contributions beyond organizing existing work. We propose a unified four-dimensional taxonomy that categorizes SRL research along model architectures, syntax feature modeling, application scenarios, and multimodal extensions. We provide a critical analysis of when and why syntactic features help, identifying conditions under which syntax-aided approaches provide consistent gains over syntax-free counterparts. We offer the first systematic treatment of SRL in the era of large language models, examining the complementary roles of LLMs and specialized SRL systems and identifying directions for hybrid approaches. We extend the scope of SRL surveys to cover multimodal settings including visual, video, and speech modalities, and analyze structural differences in evaluation across these modalities.
