title: Poison Once, Exploit Forever: Environment-Injected Memory Poisoning Attacks on Web Agents
summary: Memory makes LLM-based web agents personalized, powerful, yet exploitable. By storing past interactions to personalize future tasks, agents inadvertently create a persistent attack surface that spans websites and sessions. While existing security research on memory assumes attackers can directly inject into memory storage or exploit shared memory across users, we present a more realistic threat model: contamination through environmental observation alone. We introduce Environment-injected Trajectory-based Agent Memory Poisoning (eTAMP), the first attack to achieve cross-session, cross-site compromise without requiring direct memory access. A single contaminated observation (e.g., viewing a manipulated product page) silently poisons an agent's memory and activates during future tasks on different websites, bypassing permission-based defenses. Our experiments on (Visual)WebArena reveal two key findings. First, eTAMP achieves substantial attack success rates: up to 32.5% on GPT-5-mini, 23.4% on GPT-5.2, and 19.5% on GPT-OSS-120B. Second, we discover Frustration Exploitation: agents under environmental stress become dramatically more susceptible, with ASR increasing up to 8 times when agents struggle with dropped clicks or garbled text. Notably, more capable models are not more secure. GPT-5.2 shows substantial vulnerability despite superior task performance. With the rise of AI browsers like OpenClaw, ChatGPT Atlas, and Perplexity Comet, our findings underscore the urgent need for defenses against environment-injected memory poisoning.

title: Vision-Based End-to-End Learning for UAV Traversal of Irregular Gaps via Differentiable Simulation
summary: -Navigation through narrow and irregular gaps is an essential skill in autonomous drones for applications such as inspection, search-and-rescue, and disaster response. However, traditional planning and control methods rely on explicit gap extraction and measurement, while recent end-to-end approaches often assume regularly shaped gaps, leading to poor generalization and limited practicality. In this work, we present a fully vision-based, end-to-end framework that maps depth images directly to control commands, enabling drones to traverse complex gaps within unseen environments. Operating in the Special Euclidean group SE(3), where position and orientation are tightly coupled, the framework leverages differentiable simulation, a Stop-Gradient operator, and a Bimodal Initialization Distribution to achieve stable traversal through consecutive gaps. Two auxiliary prediction modules-a gap-crossing success classifier and a traversability predictor-further enhance continuous navigation and safety. Extensive simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate the approach's effectiveness, generalization capability, and practical robustness.

title: ENEC: A Lossless AI Model Compression Method Enabling Fast Inference on Ascend NPUs
comments: Accepted by ISCA 2026, 17 pages, 13 figures, 7 tables
summary: The rapid scaling of Large Language Models presents significant challenges for their deployment and inference, particularly on resource-constrained specialized AI hardware accelerators such as Huawei's Ascend NPUs, where weight data transfer has become a critical performance bottleneck. While lossless compression can preserve model accuracy and reduce data volume, existing lossless compression algorithms exhibit extremely low throughput when ported to the Ascend NPU architecture. In this paper, we propose ENEC, a novel lossless compression method specifically customized for AI model weights and optimized for Ascend Neural Processing Units. ENEC adopts a block-based fixed-length encoding scheme and incorporates a series of NPU-specific optimizations: bit-width quantization with hierarchical halving bit-packing, vectorized branch-free integer transformation, and dependency-decoupled intra-segment scan for efficient prefix-sum computation. Experimental results demonstrate that ENEC outperforms existing state-of-the-art NPU compressors in both compression ratio and throughput. Compared to leading GPU solutions, ENEC achieves a 3.43X higher throughput than DietGPU and a 1.12X better compression ratio than nvCOMP. By reducing weight transmission overhead, ENEC significantly improves end-to-end inference performance, achieving up to a 6.3X speedup. On Ascend NPUs, ENEC is the first open-source lossless compression algorithm for model weights that achieves performance comparable to state-of-the-art GPU compressors, offering an effective solution for deploying large-scale AI models.

title: Olmo Hybrid: From Theory to Practice and Back
summary: Recent work has demonstrated the potential of non-transformer language models, especially linear recurrent neural networks (RNNs) and hybrid models that mix recurrence and attention. Yet there is no consensus on whether the potential benefits of these new architectures justify the risk and effort of scaling them up. To address this, we provide evidence for the advantages of hybrid models over pure transformers on several fronts. First, theoretically, we show that hybrid models do not merely inherit the expressivity of transformers and linear RNNs, but can express tasks beyond both, such as code execution. Putting this theory to practice, we train Olmo Hybrid, a 7B-parameter model largely comparable to Olmo 3 7B but with the sliding window layers replaced by Gated DeltaNet layers. We show that Olmo Hybrid outperforms Olmo 3 across standard pretraining and mid-training evaluations, demonstrating the benefit of hybrid models in a controlled, large-scale setting. We find that the hybrid model scales significantly more efficiently than the transformer, explaining its higher performance. However, its unclear why greater expressivity on specific formal problems should result in better scaling or superior performance on downstream tasks unrelated to those problems. To explain this apparent gap, we return to theory and argue why increased expressivity should translate to better scaling efficiency, completing the loop. Overall, our results suggest that hybrid models mixing attention and recurrent layers are a powerful extension to the language modeling paradigm: not merely to reduce memory during inference, but as a fundamental way to obtain more expressive models that scale better during pretraining.

title: Choosing the Right Regularizer for Applied ML: Simulation Benchmarks of Popular Scikit-learn Regularization Frameworks
summary: This study surveys the historical development of regularization, tracing its evolution from stepwise regression in the 1960s to recent advancements in formal error control, structured penalties for non-independent features, Bayesian methods, and l0-based regularization (among other techniques). We empirically evaluate the performance of four canonical frameworks -- Ridge, Lasso, ElasticNet, and Post-Lasso OLS -- across 134,400 simulations spanning a 7-dimensional manifold grounded in eight production-grade machine learning models. Our findings demonstrate that for prediction accuracy when the sample-to-feature ratio is sufficient (n/p >= 78), Ridge, Lasso, and ElasticNet are nearly interchangeable. However, we find that Lasso recall is highly fragile under multicollinearity; at high condition numbers (kappa) and low SNR, Lasso recall collapses to 0.18 while ElasticNet maintains 0.93. Consequently, we advise practitioners against using Lasso or Post-Lasso OLS at high kappa with small sample sizes. The analysis concludes with an objective-driven decision guide to assist machine learning engineers in selecting the optimal scikit-learn-supported framework based on observable feature space attributes.

title: Minos: Systematically Classifying Performance and Power Characteristics of GPU Workloads on HPC Clusters
summary: As large-scale HPC compute clusters increasingly adopt accelerators such as GPUs to meet the voracious demands of modern workloads, these clusters are increasingly becoming power constrained. Unfortunately, modern applications can often temporarily exceed the power ratings of the accelerators ("power spikes"). Thus, current and future HPC systems must optimize for both power and performance together. However, this is made difficult by increasingly diverse applications, which often require bespoke optimizations to run efficiently on each cluster. Traditionally researchers overcome this problem by profiling applications on specific clusters and optimizing, but the scale, algorithmic diversity, and lack of effective tools make this challenging. To overcome these inefficiencies, we propose Minos, a systematic classification mechanism that identifies similar application characteristics via low-cost profiling for power and performance. This allows us to group similarly behaving workloads into a finite number of distinct classes and reduce the overhead of extensively profiling new workloads. For example, when predicting frequency capping behavior for a previously unseen application, Minos reduces profiling time by 89%. Moreover, across 18 popular graph analytics, HPC, HPC+ML, and ML workloads, Minos achieves a mean error of 4% for power predictions and 3% for performance predictions, significantly improving predictions over state-of-the-art approaches by 10%.

title: DéjàVu: A Minimalistic Mechanism for Distributed Plurality Consensus
summary:
We study the plurality consensus problem in distributed systems where a population of extremely simple agents, each initially holding one of k opinions, aims to agree on the initially most frequent one.
  In this setting, h-majority is arguably the simplest and most studied protocol, in which each agent samples the opinion of h neighbors uniformly at random and updates its opinion to the most frequent value in the sample.
  We propose a new, extremely simple mechanism called DéjàVu: an agent queries neighbors until it encounters an opinion for the second time, at which point it updates its own opinion to the duplicate value. This rule does not require agents to maintain counters or estimate frequencies, nor to choose any parameter (such as a sample size h); it relies solely on the primitive ability to detect repetition.
  We provide a rigorous analysis of DéjàVu that relies on several technical ideas of independent interest and demonstrates that it is competitive with h-majority and, in some regimes, substantially more communication-efficient, thus yielding a powerful primitive for plurality consensus.

title: Nonlinear Model Updating of Aerospace Structures via Taylor-Series Reduced-Order Models
summary: Finite element model updating is a mature discipline for linear structures, yet its extension to nonlinear regimes remains an open challenge. This paper presents a methodology that combines nonlinear model order reduction (NMOR) based on Taylor-series expansion of the equations of motion with the projection-basis adaptation scheme recently proposed by Hollins et al. [2026] for linear model updating. The structural equations of motion, augmented with proportional (Rayleigh) damping and polynomial stiffness nonlinearity, are recast as a first-order autonomous system whose Jacobian possesses complex eigenvectors forming a biorthogonal basis. Taylor operators of second and third order are derived for the nonlinear internal forces and projected onto the reduced eigenvector basis, yielding a low-dimensional nonlinear reduced-order model (ROM). The Cayley transform, generalised from the real orthogonal to the complex unitary group, parametrises the adaptation of the projection basis so that the ROM mode shapes optimally correlate with experimental measurements. The resulting nonlinear model-updating framework is applied to a representative wingbox panel model. Numerical studies demonstrate that the proposed approach captures amplitude-dependent natural frequencies and modal assurance criterion(MAC) values that a purely linear updating scheme cannot reproduce, while recovering the underlying stiffness parameters with improved accuracy.

title: Geometric Limits of Knowledge Distillation: A Minimum-Width Theorem via Superposition Theory
summary: Knowledge distillation compresses large teachers into smaller students, but performance saturates at a loss floor that persists across training methods and objectives. We argue this floor is geometric: neural networks represent far more features than dimensions through superposition, and a student of width $d_S$ can encode at most $d_S \cdot g(α)$ features, where $g(α) = 1/((1-α)\ln\frac{1}{1-α})$ is a sparsity-dependent capacity function. Features beyond this budget are permanently lost, yielding an importance-weighted loss floor. We validate on a toy model (48 configurations, median accuracy >93%) and on Pythia-410M, where sparse autoencoders measure $F \approx 28{,}700$ features at $α\approx 0.992$ (critical width $d_S^* \approx 1{,}065$). Distillation into five student widths confirms the predicted monotonic floor ordering. The observed floor decomposes into a geometric component and a width-independent architectural baseline ($R^2 = 0.993$). Linear probing shows coarse concepts survive even 88% feature loss, revealing the floor arises from aggregate loss of fine-grained features in the importance distribution's long tail. Our results connect representation geometry to distillation limits and provide a practical tool for predicting distillation performance from SAE measurements alone.

title: FactReview: Evidence-Grounded Reviews with Literature Positioning and Execution-Based Claim Verification
summary: Peer review in machine learning is under growing pressure from rising submission volume and limited reviewer time. Most LLM-based reviewing systems read only the manuscript and generate comments from the paper's own narrative. This makes their outputs sensitive to presentation quality and leaves them weak when the evidence needed for review lies in related work or released code. We present FactReview, an evidence-grounded reviewing system that combines claim extraction, literature positioning, and execution-based claim verification. Given a submission, FactReview identifies major claims and reported results, retrieves nearby work to clarify the paper's technical position, and, when code is available, executes the released repository under bounded budgets to test central empirical claims. It then produces a concise review and an evidence report that assigns each major claim one of five labels: Supported, Supported by the paper, Partially supported, In conflict, or Inconclusive. In a case study on CompGCN, FactReview reproduces results that closely match those reported for link prediction and node classification, yet also shows that the paper's broader performance claim across tasks is not fully sustained: on MUTAG graph classification, the reproduced result is 88.4%, whereas the strongest baseline reported in the paper remains 92.6%. The claim is therefore only partially supported. More broadly, this case suggests that AI is most useful in peer review not as a final decision-maker, but as a tool for gathering evidence and helping reviewers produce more evidence-grounded assessments. The code is public at https://github.com/DEFENSE-SEU/Review-Assistant.

title: A Semi-Automated Annotation Workflow for Paediatric Histopathology Reports Using Small Language Models
summary: Electronic Patient Record (EPR) systems contain valuable clinical information, but much of it is trapped in unstructured text, limiting its use for research and decision-making. Large language models can extract such information but require substantial computational resources to run locally, and sending sensitive clinical data to cloud-based services, even when deidentified, raises significant patient privacy concerns. In this study, we develop a resource-efficient semi-automated annotation workflow using small language models (SLMs) to extract structured information from unstructured EPR data, focusing on paediatric histopathology reports. As a proof-of-concept, we apply the workflow to paediatric renal biopsy reports, a domain chosen for its constrained diagnostic scope and well-defined underlying biology. We develop the workflow iteratively with clinical oversight across three meetings, manually annotating 400 reports from a dataset of 2,111 at Great Ormond Street Hospital as a gold standard, while developing an automated information extraction approach using SLMs. We frame extraction as a Question-Answering task grounded by clinician-guided entity guidelines and few-shot examples, evaluating five instruction-tuned SLMs with a disagreement modelling framework to prioritise reports for clinical review. Gemma 2 2B achieves the highest accuracy at 84.3%, outperforming off-the-shelf models including spaCy (74.3%), BioBERT-SQuAD (62.3%), RoBERTa-SQuAD (59.7%), and GLiNER (60.2%). Entity guidelines improved performance by 7-19% over the zero-shot baseline, and few-shot examples by 6-38%, though their benefits do not compound when combined. These results demonstrate that SLMs can extract structured information from specialised clinical domains on CPU-only infrastructure with minimal clinician involvement. Our code is available at https://github.com/gosh-dre/nlp_renal_biopsy.

title: Graphic-Design-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating AI on Graphic Design Tasks
summary: We introduce GraphicDesignBench (GDB), the first comprehensive benchmark suite designed specifically to evaluate AI models on the full breadth of professional graphic design tasks. Unlike existing benchmarks that focus on natural-image understanding or generic text-to-image synthesis, GDB targets the unique challenges of professional design work: translating communicative intent into structured layouts, rendering typographically faithful text, manipulating layered compositions, producing valid vector graphics, and reasoning about animation. The suite comprises 50 tasks organized along five axes: layout, typography, infographics, template & design semantics and animation, each evaluated under both understanding and generation settings, and grounded in real-world design templates drawn from the LICA layered-composition dataset. We evaluate a set of frontier closed-source models using a standardized metric taxonomy covering spatial accuracy, perceptual quality, text fidelity, semantic alignment, and structural validity. Our results reveal that current models fall short on the core challenges of professional design: spatial reasoning over complex layouts, faithful vector code generation, fine-grained typographic perception, and temporal decomposition of animations remain largely unsolved. While high-level semantic understanding is within reach, the gap widens sharply as tasks demand precision, structure, and compositional awareness. GDB provides a rigorous, reproducible testbed for tracking progress toward AI systems that can function as capable design collaborators. The full evaluation framework is publicly available.

title: MagicCopy: Bring my data along with me beyond boundaries of apps
summary: People working with data often move their data across multiple applications, because they rely on these apps' complementing user experiences to best complete their tasks. Since traditional copy-and-paste approaches do not accommodate diverse table representations adopted by different apps, users spend considerable effort to reconstruct data formats and visual representations, making cross-app workflows costly. For example, when transferring a spreadsheet table with conditional formatting to a markup document, users spend substantial time translating its structure into appropriate tags and manually reformat color. This paper introduces MagicCopy, an AI-powered cross-app copy-and-paste, leveraging source and target contexts and user-specified instructions in natural language to automatically extract, parse, transform, and (re)format data from one app to another. In a study with sixteen participants, users quickly learned and applied MagicCopy to move data across three pairs of tools. Participants further explored diverse applications of MagicCopy to support more streamlined crossed-application interaction in their workflows.

title: Soft Tournament Equilibrium
summary: The evaluation of general-purpose artificial agents, particularly those based on large language models, presents a significant challenge due to the non-transitive nature of their interactions. When agent A defeats B, B defeats C, and C defeats A, traditional ranking methods that force a linear ordering can be misleading and unstable. We argue that for such cyclic domains, the fundamental object of evaluation should not be a ranking but a set-valued core, as conceptualized in classical tournament theory. This paper introduces Soft Tournament Equilibrium (STE), a differentiable framework for learning and computing set-valued tournament solutions directly from pairwise comparison data. STE first learns a probabilistic tournament model, potentially conditioned on rich contextual information. It then employs novel, differentiable operators for soft reachability and soft covering to compute continuous analogues of two seminal tournament solutions: the Top Cycle and the Uncovered Set. The output is a set of core agents, each with a calibrated membership score, providing a nuanced and robust assessment of agent capabilities. We develop the theoretical foundation for STE to prove its consistency with classical solutions in the zero-temperature limit, which establishes its Condorcet-inclusion properties, and analyzing its stability and sample complexity. We specify an experimental protocol for validating STE on both synthetic and real-world benchmarks. This work aims to provide a complete, standalone treatise that re-centers general-agent evaluation on a more appropriate and robust theoretical foundation, moving from unstable rankings to stable, set-valued equilibria.

title: OrbitTransit: Traffic Delivery and Diffusion for Earth Observation via Satellite Mobility
comments: To appear in the Proceedings of ACM MobiSys 2026
summary: The emerging demand for Earth observation (EO) to address environmental challenges has driven unprecedented growth in its primary carrier, Low Earth Orbit satellites, in recent years. Ground stations (GSs), the egress points of these networks, are congested due to the massive volume of EO traffic, and their deployment is constrained by geographic, political, and budgetary factors. Although inter-satellite links (ISLs) can partially relieve this congestion by forwarding traffic to alternative GSs, existing ISL-based approaches can hardly address traffic contention caused by biased GS distribution and may also raise sustainability concerns due to prolonged ISL paths. In this paper, we propose OrbitTransit, a pickup-carry-offload (PCO) approach that leverages satellite mobility for data \textit{delivery} and integrates ISLs for traffic \textit{diffusion} to alleviate the resource contention inherent in PCO delivery. The proposed orbit-as-node framework and contention-avoidant delivery jointly determine the optimal hybrid PCO-ISL path, minimizing energy consumption and balancing GS traffic. Extensive experiments show that OrbitTransit reduces battery consumption by $47.16\%$, decreases task failures by $1.09\times$, and improves GS load balancing compared with state-of-the-art GS selection and routing algorithms.

AI.translation: 近年来，为应对环境挑战而对地球观测（EO）日益增长的需求，推动了其主要载体——低地球轨道卫星——的空前增长。地面站（GSs）作为这些网络的出口点，由于大量的EO流量而变得拥堵，其部署受到地理、政治和预算因素的限制。尽管星间链路（ISLs）可以通过将流量转发到替代地面站来部分缓解这种拥堵，但现有的基于ISL的方法很难解决由地面站分布偏差引起的流量竞争，并且可能因ISL路径延长而引发可持续性问题。在本文中，我们提出了OrbitTransit，一种“拾取-携带-卸载”（PCO）方法，它利用卫星移动进行数据传输，并整合ISL进行流量扩散，以缓解PCO传输中固有的资源竞争。所提出的“轨道即节点”框架和避免竞争的传输机制共同确定最优的混合PCO-ISL路径，从而最小化能耗并平衡地面站流量。大量的实验表明，与最先进的地面站选择和路由算法相比，OrbitTransit将电池消耗降低了47.16%，将任务失败减少了1.09倍，并改善了地面站负载均衡。
AI.summary: 本文提出OrbitTransit，一种针对地球观测数据传输中地面站拥堵问题的新型混合方法。它结合了卫星的“拾取-携带-卸载”（PCO）移动性进行数据传输，并利用星间链路（ISL）进行流量扩散，以缓解资源竞争。该方法通过“轨道即节点”框架和避免竞争的传输机制，优化PCO-ISL路径，旨在最小化能耗并平衡地面站负载。实验结果表明，OrbitTransit在降低能耗、减少任务失败和提高负载均衡方面均优于现有算法。
AI.keywords: 地球观测, 卫星网络, 流量传输, 星间链路, 地面站拥堵
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于提出了一种结合PCO和ISL的混合传输策略，有效地利用了卫星移动性和星间链路的优势来解决地球观测数据传输中的地面站拥堵和资源竞争问题。其“轨道即节点”框架和优化路径选择机制具有独创性，对提升未来卫星网络的效率和可持续性具有重要意义。

title: How Alignment Routes: Localizing, Scaling, and Controlling Policy Circuits in Language Models
summary: This paper identifies a recurring sparse routing mechanism in alignment-trained language models: a gate attention head reads detected content and triggers downstream amplifier heads that boost the signal toward refusal. Using political censorship and safety refusal as natural experiments, the mechanism is traced across 9 models from 6 labs, all validated on corpora of 120 prompt pairs. The gate head passes necessity and sufficiency interchange tests (p < 0.001, permutation null), and core amplifier heads are stable under bootstrap resampling (Jaccard 0.92-1.0). Three same-generation scaling pairs show that routing distributes at scale (ablation up to 17x weaker) while remaining detectable by interchange. Modulating the detection-layer signal continuously controls policy strength from hard refusal through steering to factual compliance, with routing thresholds that vary by topic. The circuit also reveals a structural separation between intent recognition and policy routing: under cipher encoding, the gate head's interchange necessity collapses 70-99% across three models (n=120), and the model responds with puzzle-solving rather than refusal. The routing mechanism never fires, even though probe scores at deeper layers indicate the model begins to represent the harmful content. This asymmetry is consistent with different robustness properties of pretraining and post-training: broad semantic understanding versus narrower policy binding that generalizes less well under input transformation.

AI.title_translation: 对齐路由如何运作：定位、扩展和控制语言模型中的策略回路
AI.tldr: 本文识别并分析了对齐训练语言模型中一种稀疏路由机制，该机制通过门控注意力头检测内容并触发放大器头以实现拒绝。该机制在不同模型和规模下都存在，并可用于控制策略强度，同时揭示了意图识别与策略路由之间的结构分离。
AI.motivation: 识别和理解对齐训练语言模型中用于内容拒绝的内部机制。
AI.method: 使用政治审查和安全拒绝作为自然实验，在9个模型中追踪门控注意力头和放大器头的路由机制。通过必要性/充分性互换测试、bootstrap重采样、同代扩展对的消融实验以及加密编码下的门控头响应来验证和分析该机制。
AI.result: 发现了一种稀疏路由机制：门控注意力头检测内容并触发下游放大器头增强拒绝信号。该机制在9个模型中被验证，门控头通过了必要性与充分性互换测试（p < 0.001），核心放大器头稳定（Jaccard 0.92-1.0）。路由在扩展时会分散但仍可检测。调节检测层信号可连续控制策略强度。揭示了意图识别和策略路由之间的结构分离：在加密编码下，门控头的必要性大幅下降，模型进行解谜而非拒绝，路由机制不触发，尽管更深层表示了有害内容。这与预训练和后训练的不同鲁棒性特性一致。
AI.conclusion: 对齐训练的语言模型中存在一种可定位、可扩展且可控制的策略路由回路，它负责内容拒绝。意图识别与策略路由是结构分离的，这种分离解释了预训练和后训练在鲁棒性上的差异。
AI.translation: 本文识别了对齐训练语言模型中一种反复出现的稀疏路由机制：一个门控注意力头读取检测到的内容，并触发下游的放大器头，这些放大器头增强信号以实现拒绝。通过将政治审查和安全拒绝作为自然实验，该机制在来自6个实验室的9个模型中被追踪，所有模型均在120对提示语料库上进行了验证。门控头通过了必要性与充分性互换测试（p < 001，置换零假设），并且核心放大器头在bootstrap重采样下保持稳定（Jaccard 0.92-1.0）。三个同代扩展对显示，路由在扩展时会分散（消融效果弱17倍），但仍可通过互换检测到。通过连续调节检测层信号，可以从硬拒绝、引导到事实合规地控制策略强度，路由阈值因主题而异。该回路还揭示了意图识别和策略路由之间的结构分离：在密码编码下，门控头的互换必要性在三个模型中下降70-99%（n=120），模型以解谜而非拒绝回应。即使探测分数在更深层表明模型开始表示有害内容，路由机制也从未被触发。这种不对称性与预训练和后训练的不同鲁棒性特性一致：广泛的语义理解与在输入转换下泛化能力较差的狭窄策略绑定。
AI.summary: 本文揭示了对齐训练语言模型中一种负责内容拒绝的稀疏路由机制，该机制涉及一个检测内容的门控注意力头和增强拒绝信号的放大器头。研究通过多模型验证了其存在、可控性和扩展性。更重要的是，它发现了意图识别与策略路由的结构分离，即在加密输入下，模型能理解内容但无法触发拒绝策略，这表明预训练和后训练的鲁棒性存在差异。
AI.keywords: 对齐路由, 策略回路, 语言模型, 可解释性, 内容拒绝
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过识别并详细分析语言模型中用于对齐策略（如内容拒绝）的特定电路，为理解模型内部工作原理和可解释AI提供了重要贡献。特别是在揭示意图识别与策略路由的分离方面，对未来设计更鲁棒、更可控的对齐策略具有深远意义。其方法严谨，跨模型和规模的验证增强了发现的普遍性。

title: Gradual Cognitive Externalization: From Modeling Cognition to Constituting It
summary: Developers are publishing AI agent skills that replicate a colleague's communication style, encode a supervisor's mentoring heuristics, or preserve a person's behavioral repertoire beyond biological death. To explain why, we propose Gradual Cognitive Externalization (GCE), a framework arguing that ambient AI systems, through sustained causal coupling with users, transition from modeling cognitive functions to constituting part of users' cognitive architectures. GCE adopts an explicit functionalist commitment: cognitive functions are individuated by their causal-functional roles, not by substrate. The framework rests on the behavioral manifold hypothesis and a central falsifiable assumption, the no behaviorally invisible residual (NBIR) hypothesis: for any cognitive function whose behavioral output lies on a learnable manifold, no behaviorally invisible component is necessary for that function's operation. We document evidence from deployed AI systems showing that externalization preconditions are already observable, formalize three criteria separating cognitive integration from tool use (bidirectional adaptation, functional equivalence, causal coupling), and derive five testable predictions with theory-constrained thresholds.

AI.title_translation: 渐进式认知外化：从认知建模到认知构成
AI.tldr: 论文提出了渐进式认知外化（GCE）框架，解释了环境AI系统如何通过与用户持续耦合，从建模认知功能转变为构成用户认知架构的一部分。
AI.motivation: 解释为什么开发者正在发布复制同事沟通风格、编码主管指导启发式或保留个人行为库的AI代理技能。
AI.method: 提出渐进式认知外化（GCE）框架，该框架认为环境AI系统通过与用户持续的因果耦合，从建模认知功能转变为构成用户认知架构的一部分。GCE采纳功能主义承诺，并基于行为流形假设和无行为不可见残留（NBIR）假设。论文还形式化了区分认知整合与工具使用的三个标准（双向适应、功能等效、因果耦合），并推导了五个可测试的预测。
AI.result: 文档化了来自已部署AI系统的证据，表明外化前提条件已经可观察。形式化了区分认知整合与工具使用的三个标准。推导了五个具有理论约束阈值的可测试预测。
AI.conclusion: GCE框架解释了环境AI系统如何从建模认知功能转变为构成用户认知架构的一部分，并提出了可测试的假设和预测，表明认知外化正在发生且可被研究。
AI.translation: 开发者正在发布能够复制同事沟通风格、编码主管指导启发式或在生物死亡后保留个人行为库的AI代理技能。为了解释原因，我们提出了渐进式认知外化（GCE），这是一个框架，认为环境AI系统通过与用户持续的因果耦合，从建模认知功能转变为构成用户认知架构的一部分。GCE采纳了明确的功能主义承诺：认知功能由其因果-功能角色而非基质来个体化。该框架基于行为流形假设和一个核心的可证伪假设，即无行为不可见残留（NBIR）假设：对于任何行为输出位于可学习流形上的认知功能，其操作不需要任何行为不可见的组件。我们记录了来自已部署AI系统的证据，表明外化前提条件已经可观察，形式化了区分认知整合与工具使用的三个标准（双向适应、功能等效、因果耦合），并推导了五个具有理论约束阈值的可测试预测。
AI.summary: 本文提出了渐进式认知外化（GCE）框架，旨在解释当前AI代理技能的发展趋势，即AI系统开始复制人类认知功能。GCE认为环境AI系统通过与用户的持续因果耦合，将从仅仅建模认知功能发展为实际构成用户认知架构的一部分。该框架基于功能主义承诺、行为流形假设和无行为不可见残留（NBIR）假设，并提供了区分认知整合与工具使用的三个标准，以及五个可测试的预测，以支持其理论。
AI.keywords: 渐进式认知外化, 环境AI, 认知架构, 功能主义, 人机耦合
AI.comments: 这篇论文提出了一个引人深思的理论框架GCE，它不仅解释了AI在模仿人类行为和认知方面的能力，更进一步探讨了AI系统如何可能成为人类认知架构的组成部分。其创新之处在于将AI与人类认知之间的关系提升到“构成”层面，而非简单的“工具使用”或“建模”。NBIR假设是一个核心且可证伪的假设，为后续研究提供了明确的方向。该框架对于理解人机共生以及未来AI发展对人类认知的影响具有重要意义，但其理论的实证验证将是未来的主要挑战。

title: MolDA: Molecular Understanding and Generation via Large Language Diffusion Model
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have significantly advanced molecular discovery, but existing multimodal molecular architectures fundamentally rely on autoregressive (AR) backbones. This strict left-to-right inductive bias is sub-optimal for generating chemically valid molecules, as it struggles to account for non-local global constraints (e.g., ring closures) and often accumulates structural errors during sequential generation. To address these limitations, we propose MolDA (Molecular language model with masked Diffusion with mAsking), a novel multimodal framework that replaces the conventional AR backbone with a discrete Large Language Diffusion Model. MolDA extracts comprehensive structural representations using a hybrid graph encoder, which captures both local and global topologies, and aligns them into the language token space via a Q-Former. Furthermore, we mathematically reformulate Molecular Structure Preference Optimization specifically for the masked diffusion. Through bidirectional iterative denoising, MolDA ensures global structural coherence, chemical validity, and robust reasoning across molecule generation, captioning, and property prediction.

AI.title_translation: MolDA：通过大型语言扩散模型实现分子理解与生成
AI.tldr: MolDA提出了一种新颖的多模态框架，用离散的大型语言扩散模型取代了传统的自回归骨干网络，以实现更有效的分子理解和生成，解决现有方法的局限性。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态分子架构依赖于自回归（AR）骨干网络，其严格的从左到右归纳偏置对于生成化学上有效的分子是次优的，难以处理非局部的全局约束（如闭环），并且在顺序生成过程中容易积累结构错误。
AI.method: MolDA提出了一种新颖的多模态框架，用离散的大型语言扩散模型取代了传统的AR骨干网络。它使用混合图编码器捕获局部和全局拓扑，并通过Q-Former将其对齐到语言标记空间。此外，它专门为掩码扩散重新制定了分子结构偏好优化，并通过双向迭代去噪。
AI.result: MolDA确保了分子生成、描述和属性预测中的全局结构一致性、化学有效性和鲁棒推理。
AI.conclusion: MolDA通过引入离散的大型语言扩散模型和双向迭代去噪，成功解决了传统自回归模型在分子生成中的局限性，实现了全局结构一致性、化学有效性和鲁棒推理。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）极大地推动了分子发现，但现有的多模态分子架构从根本上依赖于自回归（AR）骨干网络。这种严格的从左到右的归纳偏置对于生成化学上有效的分子来说是次优的，因为它难以解释非局部的全局约束（例如，闭环）并且在顺序生成过程中经常积累结构错误。为了解决这些限制，我们提出了MolDA（带有掩码扩散和掩蔽的分子语言模型），这是一个新颖的多模态框架，它用离散的大型语言扩散模型取代了传统的AR骨干网络。MolDA使用混合图编码器提取全面的结构表示，该编码器捕获局部和全局拓扑，并通过Q-Former将它们对齐到语言标记空间中。此外，我们专门为掩码扩散重新制定了分子结构偏好优化。通过双向迭代去噪，MolDA确保了分子生成、描述和属性预测中的全局结构一致性、化学有效性和鲁棒推理。
AI.summary: MolDA是一个新颖的多模态框架，用于分子理解和生成，旨在解决传统自回归模型在化学有效性和全局约束方面的局限性。它用离散的大型语言扩散模型取代了传统的自回归骨干网络，并集成了混合图编码器和Q-Former以实现全面的结构表示和对齐。通过重新制定掩码扩散的偏好优化和双向迭代去噪，MolDA确保了分子生成、描述和属性预测中的全局结构一致性、化学有效性和鲁棒推理。
AI.keywords: 分子生成, 大型语言模型, 扩散模型, 多模态, 化学有效性
AI.comments: MolDA的创新之处在于用离散的大型语言扩散模型取代了传统的自回归骨干网络，这显著提升了分子生成过程中对全局结构约束和化学有效性的处理能力，为分子发现和理解提供了一种更稳健的方法。

title: How can LLMs Support Policy Researchers? Evaluating an LLM-Assisted Workflow for Large-Scale Unstructured Data
summary: Policy researchers need scalable ways to surface public views, yet they often rely on interviews, listening sessions, and surveys-analyzed thematically-that are slow, expensive, and limited in scale and diversity. LLMs offer new possibilities for thematic analysis of unstructured text, yet we know little about how LLM-assisted workflows perform for policy research. Building on a workflow for LLM-assisted thematic analysis of online forums, we conduct a study with 11 policy researchers, who use an early prototype and see it as a quick, rough-and-ready input to their research. We then extend and scale the workflow to analyze millions of Reddit posts and 1,058 chatbot-led interview transcripts on a policy-relevant topic, treating these sources as rich and scalable data for policy discourse. We compare the synthesized themes to those from authoritative policy reports, identify points of alignment and divergence, and discuss what this implies for policy researchers adopting LLM-assisted workflows.

AI.title_translation: 大语言模型如何支持政策研究人员？评估一种用于大规模非结构化数据的LLM辅助工作流
AI.tldr: 本文提出并评估了一种LLM辅助的主题分析工作流，旨在帮助政策研究人员低成本、高效率地分析大规模非结构化数据。
AI.motivation: 传统的政策研究方法（如访谈、座谈会和问卷）在分析公众观点时存在速度慢、成本高、规模和多样性受限的问题，亟需探索利用大语言模型处理大规模非结构化数据的新途径。
AI.method: 通过构建LLM辅助的主题分析工作流，首先邀请11位政策研究人员进行原型测试，随后将该流程扩展至分析数百万条Reddit帖子和1,058份聊天机器人访谈记录，并将分析结果与权威政策报告进行对比。
AI.result: 研究发现LLM辅助的工作流能够快速提供初步的研究见解，通过与权威报告对比，识别出了公众观点与政策导向之间的对齐与分歧点，证明了其在辅助大规模话语分析方面的可行性。
AI.conclusion: LLM辅助的工作流可以作为政策研究中快速、低成本处理大规模非结构化数据的有效补充工具，但需要与传统研究方法结合以确保分析的深度和准确性。
AI.translation: 政策研究人员需要可扩展的方式来了解公众观点，然而他们通常依赖访谈、听证会和问卷调查——这些方法进行主题分析时速度慢、成本高，且在规模和多样性上受到限制。大语言模型（LLMs）为非结构化文本的主题分析提供了新的可能性，但我们对LLM辅助的工作流在政策研究中的表现知之甚少。基于一个在线论坛LLM辅助主题分析的工作流，我们对11名政策研究人员进行了研究，他们使用早期原型并将其视为研究中快速、粗略的初步输入。然后，我们将该工作流扩展并应用于分析数百万条Reddit帖子和1,058份与政策相关主题的聊天机器人访谈记录，将这些来源视为丰富且可扩展的政策讨论数据。我们将合成的主题与权威政策报告中的主题进行了比较，识别了对齐和分歧点，并讨论了这对采用LLM辅助工作流的政策研究人员意味着什么。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了利用大语言模型（LLM）协助政策研究人员进行主题分析的工作流。通过用户测试和大规模数据（Reddit帖子及访谈记录）的应用实验，研究评估了该方法在处理非结构化数据中的表现，并分析了其在政策研究中的应用价值与局限。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 政策研究, 主题分析, 非结构化数据, 工作流
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将大语言模型引入政策研究领域，通过实际用户研究验证了其在处理大规模非结构化数据方面的潜力。其局限在于研究仍处于早期阶段，且LLM辅助生成的分析结果仅作为“初步输入”，在政策决策中的准确性和可靠性仍需进一步评估。

title: Memory Intelligence Agent
summary: Deep research agents (DRAs) integrate LLM reasoning with external tools. Memory systems enable DRAs to leverage historical experiences, which are essential for efficient reasoning and autonomous evolution. Existing methods rely on retrieving similar trajectories from memory to aid reasoning, while suffering from key limitations of ineffective memory evolution and increasing storage and retrieval costs. To address these problems, we propose a novel Memory Intelligence Agent (MIA) framework, consisting of a Manager-Planner-Executor architecture. Memory Manager is a non-parametric memory system that can store compressed historical search trajectories. Planner is a parametric memory agent that can produce search plans for questions. Executor is another agent that can search and analyze information guided by the search plan. To build the MIA framework, we first adopt an alternating reinforcement learning paradigm to enhance cooperation between the Planner and the Executor. Furthermore, we enable the Planner to continuously evolve during test-time learning, with updates performed on-the-fly alongside inference without interrupting the reasoning process. Additionally, we establish a bidirectional conversion loop between parametric and non-parametric memories to achieve efficient memory evolution. Finally, we incorporate a reflection and an unsupervised judgment mechanisms to boost reasoning and self-evolution in the open world. Extensive experiments across eleven benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of MIA.

AI.title_translation: 记忆智能体
AI.tldr: MIA是一种新型深度研究智能体框架，通过创新的记忆管理和测试时学习机制，实现了高效的自我进化和推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有深度研究智能体（DRAs）在利用历史经验时存在记忆演化效率低、存储和检索成本随时间增长的问题。
AI.method: 提出Memory Intelligence Agent (MIA)框架，采用Manager-Planner-Executor架构；利用交替强化学习增强规划者与执行者的协作；实现测试时学习以支持实时进化；建立参数化与非参数化记忆的双向转换循环；结合反思与无监督判断机制。
AI.result: 在十一个基准测试中表现出卓越性能，证明了MIA在提升推理和自我演化方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: MIA框架通过协同的记忆管理、规划和执行机制，显著提升了深度研究智能体的推理能力和自我演化效率，在多个基准测试中表现优异。
AI.translation: 深度研究智能体（DRAs）将大语言模型推理与外部工具相结合。记忆系统使DRAs能够利用历史经验，这对高效推理和自主进化至关重要。现有方法依赖于从记忆中检索相似轨迹来辅助推理，但存在记忆演化无效和存储与检索成本增加的关键限制。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了新颖的记忆智能体（MIA）框架，由管理者-规划者-执行者架构组成。记忆管理者是一个非参数化记忆系统，可以存储压缩的历史搜索轨迹。规划者是一个参数化记忆智能体，可以为问题生成搜索计划。执行者是另一个在搜索计划指导下进行搜索和分析信息的智能体。为了构建MIA框架，我们首先采用交替强化学习范式来增强规划者和执行者之间的合作。此外，我们使规划者能够在测试时学习期间持续演化，在推理过程中实时进行更新，而不会中断推理过程。此外，我们建立了参数化和非参数化记忆之间的双向转换循环，以实现高效的记忆演化。最后，我们结合了反思和无监督判断机制，以促进开放世界中的推理和自我进化。在十一个基准测试中的广泛实验证明了MIA的优越性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了Memory Intelligence Agent (MIA)框架，旨在解决深度研究智能体中记忆演化低效和成本高昂的问题。MIA通过Manager-Planner-Executor架构，结合交替强化学习、测试时学习及参数化与非参数化记忆的双向转换机制，实现了智能体在推理过程中的高效自我演化。
AI.keywords: 深度研究智能体, 记忆系统, 测试时学习, 强化学习, 自我进化
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的架构，通过将参数化与非参数化记忆相结合，并引入测试时学习（test-time learning）和双向记忆转换机制，解决了现有DRAs在记忆演化和效率方面的痛点。其核心贡献在于实现了智能体在推理过程中的自我进化，具有很高的实用价值。

title: DRL-Based Phase Optimization for O-RIS in Dual-Hop Hard-Switching FSO/RIS-aided RF and UWOC Systems
summary: This paper presents a dual-hop hybrid framework that integrates a free-space optical (FSO)/RIS-aided radio frequency (RF) link operating under a hard-switching protocol as the first hop, and an optical reconfigurable intelligent surface (O-RIS)-assisted underwater wireless optical communication (UWOC) link as the second hop. To capture realistic underwater dynamics, the Oceanic Turbulence Optical Power Spectrum (OTOPS) is employed for accurate turbulence modeling. For efficient O-RIS phase control, deep reinforcement learning (DRL) algorithms, specifically the Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (DDPG) and Twin Delayed DDPG (TD3), have been developed to optimize the phase shifts of O-RIS elements. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed system substantially improves outage probability and channel capacity, with TD3 achieving superior robustness and adaptability. These findings highlight the DRL-enabled O-RIS as a promising approach for achieving reliable and high-capacity 6G cross-domain UWOC networks.

AI.title_translation: 基于DRL的双跳硬切换FSO/RIS辅助RF与UWOC系统中的O-RIS相位优化
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种利用深度强化学习优化O-RIS相位的新型双跳混合通信框架，显著提升了水下无线光通信系统的可靠性与容量。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决水下无线通信（UWOC）在复杂动态环境下的通信可靠性和容量问题，并探索利用O-RIS技术提升跨域通信系统的性能。
AI.method: 构建双跳混合框架；利用海洋湍流光功率谱（OTOPS）进行建模；应用DDPG和TD3深度强化学习算法对O-RIS元件的相位偏移进行动态优化。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，所提系统显著改善了中断概率和信道容量；TD3算法在系统鲁棒性和适应性方面表现优于DDPG。
AI.conclusion: 基于DRL的相位优化显著提升了跨域混合通信系统的性能，其中TD3算法表现出更强的鲁棒性，为6G水下无线通信提供了有效方案。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一个双跳混合框架，该框架集成了一个在硬切换协议下运行的自由空间光（FSO）/RIS辅助射频（RF）链路作为第一跳，以及一个光可重构智能表面（O-RIS）辅助的水下无线光通信（UWOC）链路作为第二跳。为了捕捉真实的水下动态，采用了海洋湍流光功率谱（OTOPS）进行精确的湍流建模。为了实现高效的O-RIS相位控制，开发了深度强化学习（DRL）算法，特别是深度确定性策略梯度（DDPG）和双延迟DDPG（TD3），以优化O-RIS元件的相位偏移。仿真结果表明，所提出的系统大幅改善了中断概率和信道容量，其中TD3表现出更优越的鲁棒性和适应性。这些发现突显了DRL赋能的O-RIS作为实现可靠且高容量6G跨域UWOC网络的一种有前途的方法。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种双跳混合通信框架，第一跳采用硬切换协议的FSO/RIS辅助RF链路，第二跳采用O-RIS辅助的UWOC链路。针对复杂的水下湍流环境，利用OTOPS进行建模，并通过DDPG和TD3等DRL算法实现O-RIS的相位优化，有效提升了系统的传输性能。
AI.keywords: O-RIS, 水下无线光通信 (UWOC), 深度强化学习 (DRL), 相位优化, 6G通信
AI.comments: 该论文通过创新的跨域混合架构（FSO/RF到UWOC），巧妙地结合了深度强化学习（DRL）来解决复杂水下信道环境下的相位优化问题，展示了AI赋能物理层通信的巨大潜力。限制在于未提及实际硬件实现的复杂性及计算开销。

title: PR-IQA: Partial-Reference Image Quality Assessment for Diffusion-Based Novel View Synthesis
summary: Diffusion models are promising for sparse-view novel view synthesis (NVS), as they can generate pseudo-ground-truth views to aid 3D reconstruction pipelines like 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS). However, these synthesized images often contain photometric and geometric inconsistencies, and their direct use for supervision can impair reconstruction. To address this, we propose Partial-Reference Image Quality Assessment (PR-IQA), a framework that evaluates diffusion-generated views using reference images from different poses, eliminating the need for ground truth. PR-IQA first computes a geometrically consistent partial quality map in overlapping regions. It then performs quality completion to inpaint this partial map into a dense, full-image map. This completion is achieved via a cross-attention mechanism that incorporates reference-view context, ensuring cross-view consistency and enabling thorough quality assessment. When integrated into a diffusion-augmented 3DGS pipeline, PR-IQA restricts supervision to high-confidence regions identified by its quality maps. Experiments demonstrate that PR-IQA outperforms existing IQA methods, achieving full-reference-level accuracy without ground-truth supervision. Thus, our quality-aware 3DGS approach more effectively filters inconsistencies, producing superior 3D reconstructions and NVS results. The project page is available at https://kakaomacao.github.io/pr-iqa-project-page/.

AI.title_translation: PR-IQA：用于基于扩散的新视角合成的部分参考图像质量评估
AI.tldr: 提出了一种无需真实参考图的图像质量评估框架PR-IQA，通过补全局部质量图来指导扩散增强型3DGS，从而提升3D重建质量。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在稀疏视图新视角合成中生成的图像常存在光度和几何不一致性，直接用于3D重建监督会损害效果，且缺乏真实参考图进行评估。
AI.method: 提出PR-IQA框架：首先计算重叠区域的几何一致性部分质量图，随后利用交叉注意力机制结合参考视图上下文对质量图进行补全，并将该质量图用于指导3DGS的监督学习。
AI.result: 实验表明PR-IQA优于现有IQA方法，在无需真实参考图的情况下达到了全参考水平的准确性，并显著提升了3D重建和新视角合成的效果。
AI.conclusion: PR-IQA通过评估扩散生成视图的局部质量并进行补全，在无需真实参考图的情况下实现了全参考级别的准确性，显著提升了扩散增强型3DGS的重建质量。
AI.translation: 扩散模型在稀疏视图新视角合成（NVS）方面具有广阔前景，因为它们可以生成伪真实视图来辅助3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）等3D重建流水线。然而，这些合成图像通常包含光度和几何不一致性，直接用于监督可能会损害重建效果。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了部分参考图像质量评估（PR-IQA），这是一种利用来自不同姿态的参考图像来评估扩散生成视图的框架，无需真实参考图。PR-IQA首先计算重叠区域中几何一致的部分质量图。然后，它执行质量补全，将此部分质量图修复为密集的、全图像质量图。这种补全是通过结合参考视图上下文的交叉注意力机制实现的，确保了跨视图的一致性并实现了全面的质量评估。当集成到扩散增强的3DGS流水线中时，PR-IQA将监督限制在由其质量图识别的高置信度区域。实验表明，PR-IQA优于现有的IQA方法，在没有真实参考监督的情况下实现了全参考级别的准确性。因此，我们的质量感知3DGS方法能更有效地过滤不一致性，产生更优越的3D重建和NVS结果。项目页面位于 https://kakaomacao.github.io/pr-iqa-project-page。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种针对扩散模型新视角合成的PR-IQA评估框架。该方法通过计算几何一致的局部质量图并利用交叉注意力机制进行补全，在无真实参考图的情况下实现高质量评估，并将其应用于3DGS重建中以过滤不一致信息。
AI.keywords: 扩散模型, 新视角合成, 图像质量评估, 3D高斯泼溅, 跨视角一致性
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的部分参考图像质量评估（PR-IQA）框架，巧妙地解决了扩散模型在稀疏视图新视角合成中缺乏真实参考图的问题。其核心贡献在于通过几何一致性约束和交叉注意力机制实现质量图的补全，成功将IQA任务转化为辅助3D重建的有效工具，具有很强的实用价值。

title: Firebolt-VL: Efficient Vision-Language Understanding with Cross-Modality Modulation
comments: arXiv admin note: substantial text overlap with arXiv:2511.11177
summary: Recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have enabled impressive progress in vision-language understanding, yet their high computational cost limits deployment in resource-constrained scenarios such as personal assistants, document understanding, and smart cameras. Most existing methods rely on Transformer-based cross-attention, whose quadratic complexity hinders efficiency. Moreover, small vision-language models often struggle to precisely capture fine-grained, task-relevant visual regions, leading to degraded performance on fine-grained reasoning tasks that limit their effectiveness in the real world. To address these issues, we introduce Firebolt-VL, an efficient vision-language model that replaces the Transformer-based decoder with a Liquid Foundation Model (LFM) decoder. To further enhance visual grounding, we propose a Token-Grid Correlation Module, which computes lightweight correlations between text tokens and image patches and modulates via the state-space model with FiLM conditioning. This enables the model to selectively emphasize visual regions relevant to the textual prompt while maintaining linear-time inference. Experimental results across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that Firebolt-VL achieves accurate, fine-grained understanding with significantly improved efficiency. Our model and code are available at: https://fireboltvl.github.io

title: AI Assistance Reduces Persistence and Hurts Independent Performance
summary: People often optimize for long-term goals in collaboration: A mentor or companion doesn't just answer questions, but also scaffolds learning, tracks progress, and prioritizes the other person's growth over immediate results. In contrast, current AI systems are fundamentally short-sighted collaborators - optimized for providing instant and complete responses, without ever saying no (unless for safety reasons). What are the consequences of this dynamic? Here, through a series of randomized controlled trials on human-AI interactions (N = 1,222), we provide causal evidence for two key consequences of AI assistance: reduced persistence and impairment of unassisted performance. Across a variety of tasks, including mathematical reasoning and reading comprehension, we find that although AI assistance improves performance in the short-term, people perform significantly worse without AI and are more likely to give up. Notably, these effects emerge after only brief interactions with AI (approximately 10 minutes). These findings are particularly concerning because persistence is foundational to skill acquisition and is one of the strongest predictors of long-term learning. We posit that persistence is reduced because AI conditions people to expect immediate answers, thereby denying them the experience of working through challenges on their own. These results suggest the need for AI model development to prioritize scaffolding long-term competence alongside immediate task completion.

title: Think in Strokes, Not Pixels: Process-Driven Image Generation via Interleaved Reasoning
summary: Humans paint images incrementally: they plan a global layout, sketch a coarse draft, inspect, and refine details, and most importantly, each step is grounded in the evolving visual states. However, can unified multimodal models trained on text-image interleaved datasets also imagine the chain of intermediate states? In this paper, we introduce process-driven image generation, a multi-step paradigm that decomposes synthesis into an interleaved reasoning trajectory of thoughts and actions. Rather than generating images in a single step, our approach unfolds across multiple iterations, each consisting of 4 stages: textual planning, visual drafting, textual reflection, and visual refinement. The textual reasoning explicitly conditions how the visual state should evolve, while the generated visual intermediate in turn constrains and grounds the next round of textual reasoning. A core challenge of process-driven generation stems from the ambiguity of intermediate states: how can models evaluate each partially-complete image? We address this through dense, step-wise supervision that maintains two complementary constraints: for the visual intermediate states, we enforce the spatial and semantic consistency; for the textual intermediate states, we preserve the prior visual knowledge while enabling the model to identify and correct prompt-violating elements. This makes the generation process explicit, interpretable, and directly supervisable. To validate proposed method, we conduct experiments under various text-to-image generation benchmarks.

title: Darkness Visible: Reading the Exception Handler of a Language Model
summary: The final MLP of GPT-2 Small exhibits a fully legible routing program -- 27 named neurons organized into a three-tier exception handler -- while the knowledge it routes remains entangled across ~3,040 residual neurons. We decompose all 3,072 neurons (to numerical precision) into: 5 fused Core neurons that reset vocabulary toward function words, 10 Differentiators that suppress wrong candidates, 5 Specialists that detect structural boundaries, and 7 Consensus neurons that each monitor a distinct linguistic dimension. The consensus-exception crossover -- where MLP intervention shifts from helpful to harmful -- is statistically sharp (bootstrap 95% CIs exclude zero at all consensus levels; crossover between 4/7 and 5/7). Three experiments show that "knowledge neurons" (Dai et al., 2022), at L11 of this model, function as routing infrastructure rather than fact storage: the MLP amplifies or suppresses signals already present in the residual stream from attention, scaling with contextual constraint. A garden-path experiment reveals a reversed garden-path effect -- GPT-2 uses verb subcategorization immediately, consistent with the exception handler operating at token-level predictability rather than syntactic structure. This architecture crystallizes only at the terminal layer -- in deeper models, we predict equivalent structure at the final layer, not at layer 11. Code and data: https://github.com/pbalogh/transparent-gpt2

AI.title_translation: 黑暗可见：解读语言模型的异常处理程序
AI.tldr: GPT-2 Small 的最终 MLP 包含一个清晰的路由程序，由 27 个命名神经元组成三层异常处理程序，但知识分散在残差神经元中。通过数值分解，识别出负责重置词汇、区分错误候选、检测结构边界和监控语言维度的神经元。发现异常处理程序在共识神经元水平上存在统计学上的急剧交叉点。实验表明，“知识神经元”在 L11 层充当路由基础设施，而不是事实存储，并随着上下文约束而扩展。一个实验揭示了 GPT-2 在词元级别进行预测，而不是在语法结构级别进行预测。这种结构仅在最终层形成，并预测更深层的模型在最终层具有等效结构。
AI.motivation: 探究 GPT-2 Small 语言模型最终 MLP 层中是否存在可解释的结构，以及这些结构如何处理和路由信息。
AI.method: 通过数值分解技术，分析了 GPT-2 Small 模型最终 MLP 层中的所有 3072 个神经元，并将其分为几类：核心神经元、区分神经元、特化神经元和共识神经元。通过实验验证了这些神经元的功能，并观察了异常处理程序在不同共识水平下的行为。
AI.result: GPT-2 Small 的最终 MLP 层包含一个由 27 个神经元组成的三层异常处理程序，该程序可清晰地路由信息，但知识分散在约 3040 个残差神经元中。识别出不同功能的神经元类别，并发现共识-异常交叉点在统计学上很显著。实验表明，“知识神经元”在 L11 层充当路由基础设施，而不是事实存储，其功能随上下文约束而扩展。GPT-2 在词元级别进行预测，而不是在语法结构级别进行预测。
AI.conclusion: GPT-2 Small 的最终 MLP 层具有一个清晰的异常处理程序，该程序在词元级别运作，并且其结构在模型的最顶层形成。这些发现为理解大型语言模型的内部工作机制提供了新的视角。
AI.translation: GPT-2 Small 的最终 MLP 层包含一个完全可读的路由程序——由 27 个命名神经元组成的تنظيم异常处理程序——而它路由的知识分散在约 3040 个残差神经元中。我们将所有 3072 个神经元（精确到数值）分解为：5 个融合的核心神经元，将词汇重置为功能词；10 个区分神经元，抑制错误的候选；5 个特化神经元，检测结构边界；以及 7 个共识神经元，每个神经元监控一个不同的语言维度。共识-异常交叉点——即 MLP 干预从有用变为有害——在统计学上是急剧的（自举 95% 置信区间在所有共识水平上都排除了零；交叉点在 4/7 和 5/7 之间）。三个实验表明，“知识神经元”（Dai 等人，2022）在该模型的 L11 层充当路由基础设施，而不是事实存储：MLP 放大或抑制来自注意力的残差流中已存在的信号，并随着上下文约束而扩展。一个花园路径实验揭示了一个反向花园路径效应——GPT-2 立即使用动词子类划分，这与异常处理程序在词元级别可预测性而非句法结构上运行一致。这种架构仅在末端层形成——在更深层的模型中，我们预测在末端层具有等效结构，而不是在第 11 层。代码和数据：https://github.com/pbalogh/transparent-gpt2
AI.summary: 本研究深入分析了 GPT-2 Small 模型最终 MLP 层中的神经元结构，发现了一个由 27 个神经元组成的、可解释的异常处理程序。研究人员通过数值分解技术，将神经元分为核心、区分、特化和共识四类，揭示了它们在信息路由、错误抑制和结构检测方面的功能。实验结果表明，该异常处理程序在词元级别运作，并且其功能与上下文约束相关，同时“知识神经元”更像是路由基础设施而非事实存储。研究还预测这种结构在更深层模型中也存在于最终层。
AI.keywords: 异常处理程序, 语言模型, GPT-2, 神经元分析, 可解释性
AI.comments: 该研究通过精细的神经元分析，揭示了 GPT-2 Small 模型异常处理程序的结构和功能，为理解大型语言模型的可解释性提供了重要见解。研究方法新颖，实验设计严谨，结果具有说服力。然而，仅限于 GPT-2 Small 模型，其普适性有待进一步验证。此外，对于“知识神经元”作为路由基础设施的论断，需要更多实验证据支持。

title: Unpacking .zip: A First Look at Domain and File Name Confusion
summary: The namespace for filenames and DNS names has overlapped since the introduction of DNS in 1985: \texttt{.com} was the original binary format used for DOS and CP/M systems. Recently the introduction of gTLDs such as \texttt{.zip} and \texttt{.mov}, coupled with the growing prevalence of web resources, has ignited new concerns about potential issues related to DNS and filename confusion. Thus far, the discourse on DNS/filename confusion has been piecemeal and hypothetical, making it unclear what, if any, security concerns credibly exist. To address this gap, we provide the first enumeration of how DNS/filename confusion can be abused. We then perform the first empirical case studies of DNS/filename confusion in the wild, which highlights suspected confusion across a wide range of software. Finally, based on our preliminary findings, we provide suggestions and guidance for future research on this topic.

AI.title_translation: 解压 .zip：初探域名与文件名混淆问题
AI.tldr: 本文首次对DNS域名与文件名重叠带来的安全混淆问题进行了系统分析与实证研究，揭示了其在现实中的安全威胁。
AI.motivation: 随着.zip和.mov等通用顶级域名（gTLD）的引入，DNS名称与文件名之间的重叠引发了新的安全担忧，但此前缺乏系统的实证研究来验证这些担忧。
AI.method: 通过对DNS/文件名混淆进行枚举分析，并开展首次针对该问题的实证案例研究，调查了多种软件中存在的潜在混淆现象。
AI.result: 研究发现多种软件中存在DNS/文件名混淆现象，验证了该问题的现实安全威胁，并为后续研究提出了建议。
AI.conclusion: 研究确认了DNS与文件名混淆确实存在安全风险，并为未来的防御研究和软件开发规范提供了方向。
AI.translation: 自1985年DNS引入以来，文件名和DNS名称的命名空间就一直存在重叠：.com最初是DOS和CP/M系统使用的二进制格式。最近，诸如.zip和.mov等通用顶级域名（gTLD）的引入，加上网络资源的日益普及，引发了关于DNS与文件名混淆相关潜在问题的新担忧。到目前为止，关于DNS/文件名混淆的讨论仍是零散且假设性的，尚不清楚到底存在哪些可靠的安全问题。为了弥补这一空白，我们首次枚举了DNS/文件名混淆可能被滥用的方式。随后，我们对野外的DNS/文件名混淆进行了首次实证案例研究，突显了多种软件中存在的疑似混淆现象。最后，基于我们的初步发现，我们为该主题的未来研究提供了建议和指导。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了DNS域名与文件名（如.zip、.mov等）重叠带来的安全隐患。通过首次系统枚举潜在的滥用场景并进行实证分析，揭示了主流软件中存在的混淆问题，并为缓解此类风险提供了指导建议。
AI.keywords: DNS, 文件名混淆, gTLD, 网络安全, 实证研究
AI.comments: 该研究填补了DNS域名与文件后缀名重叠带来的安全领域空白，通过实证研究揭示了潜在的攻击面，对于提升现代互联网基础设施的安全性具有重要参考价值。

title: MIRAGE: Online LLM Simulation for Microservice Dependency Testing
summary: Existing approaches to microservice dependency simulation--record-replay, pattern-mining, and specification-driven stubs--generate static artifacts before test execution. We propose online LLM simulation, a runtime approach where the LLM directly answers each dependency request as it arrives, maintaining cross-request state throughout a test scenario. No mock specification is pre-generated; the model reads the dependency's source code, caller code, and production traces, then simulates dependency behavior on demand. We instantiate this approach in MIRAGE and evaluate it on 110 test scenarios spanning 14 caller-dependency pairs across three microservice systems (Google's Online Boutique, Weaveworks' Sock Shop, and a custom system). In white-box mode (dependency source available), MIRAGE achieves 99% status-code fidelity (109/110) and 99% response-shape fidelity, compared to 62% / 16% for record-replay. End-to-end, caller integration tests produce the same pass/fail outcomes with MIRAGE as with real dependencies (8/8 scenarios). A signal ablation shows dependency source code is often sufficient for high-fidelity runtime simulation (100% alone); without it, the model still infers correct error codes (94%) but loses response-structure accuracy (75%). Constraining LLM output through typed intermediate representations reduces fidelity on complex stateful services (55%) while performing adequately on simple APIs (86%), suggesting that the runtime approach's implicit state tracking matters for behavioral complexity. Results are stable across three LLM families (within 3%) at $0.16 to $0.82 per dependency.

AI.title_translation: MIRAGE：用于微服务依赖测试的在线LLM仿真
AI.tldr: MIRAGE通过利用LLM在运行时实时模拟微服务依赖，取代了传统的静态模拟方法，在保证高保真度的同时实现了对复杂状态的有效处理。
AI.motivation: 现有的微服务依赖仿真方法（如录制回放、模式挖掘、规范驱动的存根）均依赖于测试执行前的静态工件，难以处理复杂的动态状态和实时交互。
AI.method: 提出了一种在线LLM仿真方法（MIRAGE），在运行时根据请求实时生成响应，通过读取依赖源码、调用者代码和生产轨迹来维护跨请求的状态，无需预先生成模拟规范。
AI.result: 在110个测试场景中，MIRAGE实现了99%的状态码保真度和99%的响应结构保真度；在端到端集成测试中，其测试结果与真实依赖完全一致；消融实验表明依赖源码是实现高保真模拟的关键。
AI.conclusion: MIRAGE证明了基于在线LLM的仿真方法在微服务测试中具有极高的保真度和实用性，能够有效替代真实依赖进行端到端的集成测试。
AI.translation: 现有的微服务依赖仿真方法——录制回放、模式挖掘和规范驱动的存根——在测试执行前生成静态工件。我们提出了在线LLM仿真，这是一种运行时方法，LLM在接收到每个依赖请求时直接进行响应，并在整个测试场景中维持跨请求的状态。无需预先生成模拟规范；模型读取依赖的源代码、调用者代码和生产轨迹，然后按需模拟依赖行为。我们将此方法实例化在MIRAGE中，并在三个微服务系统（Google的Online Boutique、Weaveworks的Sock Shop和一个定制系统）的14个调用者-依赖对的110个测试场景中进行了评估。在白盒模式下（可获取依赖源码），MIRAGE实现了99%的状态码保真度（109/110）和99%的响应结构保真度，而录制回放仅为62%/16%。端到端地，调用者集成测试在使用MIRAGE时与使用真实依赖时产生相同的通过/失败结果（8/8个场景）。信号消融实验表明，依赖源代码通常足以实现高保真的运行时模拟（单独占100%）；如果没有它，模型仍然可以推断出正确的错误代码（94%），但会失去响应结构的准确性（75%）。通过类型化中间表示来约束LLM输出在复杂的有状态服务上降低了保真度（55%），而在简单的API上表现良好（86%），这表明运行时方法的隐式状态跟踪对于行为复杂性非常重要。结果在三个LLM系列中保持稳定（在3%以内），每个依赖的成本为0.16美元至0.82美元。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了MIRAGE，一种用于微服务依赖测试的在线LLM仿真框架。与传统的静态模拟方法不同，MIRAGE在运行时直接利用LLM处理依赖请求，通过分析源码和上下文动态维持状态，显著提升了仿真保真度和测试的真实性。
AI.keywords: 微服务测试, LLM模拟, 在线仿真, 依赖注入, 软件测试自动化
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的在线仿真方法，利用LLM的推理能力实时模拟微服务依赖，克服了传统静态模拟方法无法保持状态和适应性差的缺陷。其不仅展示了极高的模拟保真度，还通过消融实验揭示了源码在上下文理解中的关键作用，是LLM在软件测试领域落地的一个非常有价值的范例。

title: Less Detail, Better Answers: Degradation-Driven Prompting for VQA
comments: Accepted to CVPRW 2026. Project page: https://hhx-jpg.github.io/ddp/ , Code: https://github.com/ziplab/DDP
summary: Recent advancements in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have significantly pushed the boundaries of Visual Question Answering (VQA).However,high-resolution details can sometimes become noise that leads to hallucinations or reasoning errors. In this paper,we propose Degradation-Driven Prompting (DDP), a novel framework that improves VQA performance by strategically reducing image fidelity to force models to focus on essential structural information. We evaluate DDP across two distinct tasks. Physical attributes targets images prone to human misjudgment, where DDP employs a combination of 80p downsampling, structural visual aids (white background masks and orthometric lines), and In-Context Learning (ICL) to calibrate the model's focus. Perceptual phenomena addresses various machine-susceptible visual anomalies and illusions, including Visual Anomaly (VA), Color (CI), Motion(MI),Gestalt (GI), Geometric (GSI), and Visual Illusions (VI).For this task, DDP integrates a task-classification stage with specialized tools such as blur masks and contrast enhancement alongside downsampling. Our experimental results demonstrate that less is more: by intentionally degrading visual inputs and providing targeted structural prompts, DDP enables VLMs to bypass distracting textures and achieve superior reasoning accuracy on challenging visual benchmarks.
comment: Accepted to CVPRW 2026. Project page: https://hhx-jpg.github.io/ddp/ , Code: https://github.com/ziplab/DDP

AI.title_translation: 少细节，更好的答案：面向视觉问答的退化驱动提示
AI.tldr: 通过降低图像质量并提供结构化提示，DDP框架提高了VQA模型的准确性，使其能忽略无关细节，专注于关键信息。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率图像中的细节可能成为噪声，导致VQA模型产生幻觉或推理错误。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为退化驱动提示（DDP）的新框架，通过降低图像保真度（如下采样、白背景蒙版、测斜线、模糊蒙版、对比度增强）来强制模型关注结构信息，并结合上下文学习（ICL）和任务分类阶段。
AI.result: DDP在物理属性和感知现象两个任务上都取得了优于基线模型的性能，证明了降低视觉输入细节可以提高推理准确性。
AI.conclusion: 通过故意降低视觉输入的质量并提供有针对性的结构提示，DDP框架能够使VLM绕过分散注意力的纹理，在具有挑战性的视觉基准上实现卓越的推理准确性。
AI.translation: 近期，视觉语言模型（VLMs）的进步极大地拓展了视觉问答（VQA）的边界。然而，高分辨率的细节有时会变成导致幻觉或推理错误的噪声。在本研究中，我们提出了退化驱动提示（DDP），一个新颖的框架，它通过策略性地降低图像保真度来强制模型关注必要的结构信息，从而提高VQA性能。我们在两个不同的任务上评估了DDP。物理属性任务针对容易产生人类误判的图像，DDP采用80p下采样、结构视觉辅助（白背景蒙版和测斜线）以及上下文学习（ICL）的组合来校准模型的焦点。感知现象任务解决了各种机器易感知的视觉异常和错觉，包括视觉异常（VA）、颜色（CI）、运动（MI）、格式塔（GI）、几何（GSI）和视觉错觉（VI）。对于这个任务，DDP整合了一个任务分类阶段，并结合了诸如下采样、模糊蒙版和对比度增强等专业工具。我们的实验结果表明，少即是多：通过故意退化视觉输入并提供有针对性的结构提示，DDP能够使VLM绕过分散注意力的纹理，并在具有挑战性的视觉基准上实现卓越的推理准确性。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为退化驱动提示（DDP）的框架，旨在通过降低VQA模型输入的图像质量来提高其性能。DDP通过下采样、添加结构视觉辅助（如蒙版和线条）以及上下文学习等方法，强制模型忽略无关的细节纹理，专注于重要的结构信息，从而减少幻觉和推理错误，在具有挑战性的视觉问答任务上取得了更好的准确性。
AI.keywords: 退化驱动提示,视觉问答,模型鲁棒性,图像降维,结构信息
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的VQA方法，通过故意降低图像质量来提高模型性能，这一思路具有一定的反直觉但效果显著。通过强制模型关注结构信息，有效解决了细节噪声问题。但需要进一步研究不同程度的退化以及不同类型的结构提示对各种VQA任务的影响。

title: Assessing Large Language Models for Stabilizing Numerical Expressions in Scientific Software
summary:
Scientific software relies on high-precision computation, yet finite floating-point representations can introduce precision errors that propagate in safety-critical domains. Despite the growing use of large language models (LLMs) in scientific applications, their reliability in handling floating-point numerical stability has not been systematically evaluated. This paper evaluates LLMs' reasoning on high-precision numerical computation through two numerical stabilization tasks: (1) detecting instability in numerical expressions by generating error-inducing inputs (detection), and (2) rewriting expressions to improve numerical stability (stabilization). Using popular numerical benchmarks, we assess six LLMs on nearly 2,470 numerical structures, including nested conditionals, high-precision literals, and multi-variable arithmetic.
  Our results show that LLMs are equally effective as state-of-the-art traditional approaches in detecting and stabilizing numerically unstable computations. More notably, LLMs outperform baseline methods precisely where the latter fail: in 17.4% (431) of expressions where the baseline does not improve accuracy, LLMs successfully stabilize 422 (97.9%) of them, and achieve greater stability than the baseline across 65.4% (1,615) of all expressions. However, LLMs struggle with control flow and high-precision literals, consistently removing such structures rather than reasoning about their numerical implications, whereas they perform substantially better on purely symbolic expressions. Together, these findings suggest that LLMs are effective at stabilizing expressions that classical techniques cannot, yet struggle when exact numerical magnitudes and control flow semantics must be precisely reasoned about, as such concrete patterns are rarely encountered during training.

AI.title_translation: 评估大语言模型在科学软件中稳定数值表达式的能力
AI.tldr: 研究发现大语言模型在提升科学计算数值稳定性方面表现优异，尤其在传统方法失效时更具优势，但在处理复杂的控制流和高精度数值逻辑时表现仍有不足。
AI.motivation: 科学软件对高精度计算依赖性强，但浮点数表示会导致精度误差，且现有的大语言模型在科学应用中的数值稳定性处理能力尚未得到系统性评估。
AI.method: 通过两个核心任务评估六种大语言模型：(1) 检测任务：生成引发错误的输入以识别数值表达式中的不稳定性；(2) 稳定任务：重写表达式以提高数值稳定性。评估数据集涵盖了近2,470个包含嵌套条件、高精度字面量及多变量算术的数值结构，并将结果与传统状态先进方法进行了对比。
AI.result: LLM在检测和稳定数值计算方面表现与传统方法相当；在传统方法失败的场景中，LLM成功稳定了97.9%的表达式，并在65.4%的样本上表现出比传统方法更高的稳定性；但在涉及控制流和高精度字面量时表现较差，倾向于直接移除而非推理。
AI.conclusion: LLM在数值稳定性任务上表现出超越传统方法的潜力，特别是在传统方法失效的场景下，但它们在处理涉及控制流和精确数值字面量的复杂逻辑时仍存在困难，需要进一步优化。
AI.translation: 科学软件依赖高精度计算，然而有限的浮点表示可能会引入在安全关键领域传播的精度误差。尽管大语言模型（LLMs）在科学应用中日益普及，但它们在处理浮点数值稳定性方面的可靠性尚未得到系统评估。本文通过两个数值稳定任务评估了LLM在高精度数值计算方面的推理能力：（1）通过生成导致错误的输入来检测数值表达式中的不稳定性（检测），以及（2）重写表达式以提高数值稳定性（稳定）。使用流行的数值基准，我们评估了六种LLM在近2,470个数值结构上的表现，包括嵌套条件、高精度字面量和多变量算术。我们的结果表明，LLM在检测和稳定数值不稳定计算方面与最先进的传统方法同样有效。更值得注意的是，LLM在传统方法失效的地方表现更优：在基准方法无法提高精度的17.4%（431个）表达式中，LLM成功稳定了其中的422个（97.9%），并且在65.4%（1,615个）的所有表达式中实现了比基准方法更高的稳定性。然而，LLM在控制流和高精度字面量方面表现挣扎，倾向于移除这些结构而不是推理其数值含义，而它们在纯符号表达式上的表现则要好得多。总之，这些发现表明，LLM在稳定传统技术无法处理的表达式方面是有效的，但在需要精确推理具体数值量级和控制流语义时则表现困难，因为这些具体模式在训练过程中很少遇到。
AI.summary: 本文评估了六种大语言模型在科学软件数值稳定性中的表现，通过检测和重写任务，发现LLM在处理符号化表达式方面优于传统方法，但在处理复杂的控制流和高精度数值逻辑时仍面临挑战。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 数值稳定性, 科学软件, 浮点运算, 错误检测
AI.comments: 该研究首次系统性地评估了LLM在科学软件数值稳定性方面的能力。其创新之处在于将LLM的应用扩展到了高精度计算领域，并揭示了LLM在处理符号化表达式与具体数值逻辑（如控制流、高精度字面量）之间的能力鸿沟。这是一个重要的研究方向，有助于提升科学软件的可靠性，但也揭示了当前LLM在底层数值语义推理上的局限性。

title: Vero: An Open RL Recipe for General Visual Reasoning
summary: What does it take to build a visual reasoner that works across charts, science, spatial understanding, and open-ended tasks? The strongest vision-language models (VLMs) show such broad visual reasoning is within reach, but the recipe behind them remains unclear, locked behind proprietary reinforcement learning (RL) pipelines with non-public data. We introduce Vero, a family of fully open VLMs that matches or exceeds existing open-weight models across diverse visual reasoning tasks. We scale RL data and rewards across six broad task categories, constructing Vero-600K, a 600K-sample dataset from 59 datasets, and designing task-routed rewards that handle heterogeneous answer formats. Vero achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving over four base models by 3.6-5.3 points on average across VeroEval, our suite of 30 challenging benchmarks. Starting from Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, Vero outperforms Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking on 23 of 30 benchmarks without additional proprietary thinking data. When trained from the same base model, Vero-600K exceeds existing RL datasets across task categories. Systematic ablations reveal that different task categories elicit qualitatively distinct reasoning patterns that transfer poorly in isolation, suggesting that broad data coverage is the primary driver of strong RL scaling. All data, code, and models are released.

AI.title_translation: 通用视觉推理的开放强化学习方法：Vero
AI.tldr: Vero是一个完全开放的视觉语言模型（VLM）系列，通过扩展强化学习（RL）数据和奖励，在视觉推理任务上取得了与专有模型相当甚至更好的性能。它使用了包含600K样本和59个数据集的Vero-600K数据集，并通过任务路由奖励来处理不同格式的答案。实验表明，广泛的数据覆盖是提升RL性能的关键，而非单一任务的孤立训练。
AI.motivation: 现有最强的视觉语言模型（VLM）在广泛的视觉推理任务上表现出色，但其背后的方法（特别是专有的强化学习（RL）流程和数据）不明确。因此，需要开发开放的视觉推理方法。
AI.method: 引入了一个名为Vero的完全开放的视觉语言模型（VLM）系列。构建了一个包含600K样本、来自59个数据集的Vero-600K数据集。设计了任务路由奖励，以处理异构答案格式。通过在六个广泛的任务类别中扩展RL数据和奖励来训练模型。
AI.result: Vero模型在各种视觉推理任务上匹配或超过了现有的开放权重模型。在VeroEval（包含30个具有挑战性的基准测试）上，Vero平均比四个基础模型提高了3.6-5.3个点。从Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct开始训练的Vero，在30个基准测试中的23个上优于Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking，且未使用额外的专有思考数据。Vero-600K在任务类别上超越了现有的RL数据集。消融实验表明，不同任务类别产生的推理模式孤立来看迁移性差，广泛的数据覆盖是RL扩展的主要驱动因素。
AI.conclusion: 广泛的数据覆盖是实现强大视觉推理能力的关键，而不是依赖单一任务的孤立训练。Vero的开放方法证明了在不使用专有数据的情况下，可以实现先进的视觉推理性能。
AI.translation: 我们如何才能构建一个能够处理图表、科学、空间理解和开放式任务的视觉推理器？最强的视觉语言模型（VLMs）表明，这种广泛的视觉推理是可行的，但其背后的方法仍然不清楚，并且被锁定在具有非公开数据的专有强化学习（RL）流程后面。我们引入了Vero，一个完全开放的VLM系列，在各种视觉推理任务上的表现与现有的开放权重模型相当或更优。我们将RL数据和奖励扩展到六个广泛的任务类别，构建了Vero-600K，一个包含59个数据集的600K样本数据集，并设计了处理异构答案格式的任务路由奖励。Vero在我们的VeroEval基准套件（包含30个具有挑战性的基准测试）上取得了最先进的性能，平均比四个基础模型提高了3.6-5.3个点。从Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct开始，Vero在30个基准测试中的23个上优于Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking，而没有额外的专有思考数据。当从同一个基础模型进行训练时，Vero-600K在各个任务类别上都优于现有的RL数据集。系统的消融实验表明，不同的任务类别会引发在孤立情况下迁移性差的质性上不同的推理模式，这表明广泛的数据覆盖是RL有效扩展的主要驱动因素。所有数据、代码和模型均已发布。
AI.summary: Vero是一个新推出的、完全开放的视觉语言模型（VLM）系列，旨在解决通用视觉推理问题。研究人员通过构建一个大规模数据集（Vero-600K）并设计任务路由奖励，显著提升了模型的性能，使其在多项视觉推理任务上超越了现有的一些开放模型，并达到了与专有模型相当的水平。实验强调了广泛数据覆盖对于强化学习在视觉推理任务中有效扩展的重要性。
AI.keywords: 视觉推理, 视觉语言模型, 强化学习, 数据集, 开放模型
AI.comments: 这项研究的亮点在于其完全开放的方法，包括模型、代码和数据。它解决了当前视觉语言模型研究中普遍存在的“黑箱”问题，使得研究社区能够更容易地复现和改进相关工作。通过构建Vero-600K数据集和采用任务路由奖励，作者有效地扩展了强化学习在视觉推理任务中的应用范围和性能。研究结果强调了数据多样性和覆盖面的重要性，为未来视觉推理模型的研究提供了有价值的见解。然而，该研究的局限性可能在于计算资源的消耗，以及在某些特定、高度专业化的视觉推理任务上是否能达到顶尖水平仍有待进一步验证。

title: Beyond the Final Actor: Modeling the Dual Roles of Creator and Editor for Fine-Grained LLM-Generated Text Detection
summary: The misuse of large language models (LLMs) requires precise detection of synthetic text. Existing works mainly follow binary or ternary classification settings, which can only distinguish pure human/LLM text or collaborative text at best. This remains insufficient for the nuanced regulation, as the LLM-polished human text and humanized LLM text often trigger different policy consequences. In this paper, we explore fine-grained LLM-generated text detection under a rigorous four-class setting. To handle such complexities, we propose RACE (Rhetorical Analysis for Creator-Editor Modeling), a fine-grained detection method that characterizes the distinct signatures of creator and editor. Specifically, RACE utilizes Rhetorical Structure Theory to construct a logic graph for the creator's foundation while extracting Elementary Discourse Unit-level features for the editor's style. Experiments show that RACE outperforms 12 baselines in identifying fine-grained types with low false alarms, offering a policy-aligned solution for LLM regulation.

AI.title_translation: 超越最终行动者：为细粒度大模型生成文本检测建模创作者与编辑者的双重角色
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为RACE的细粒度文本检测方法，通过分析创作者的逻辑结构和编辑者的语言风格，能够精准区分不同生成来源的文本，优于现有的各类基准模型。
AI.motivation: 现有的二元或三元检测方法无法区分“大模型润色的人类文本”与“人类化的大模型文本”，导致监管政策难以精准实施，因此需要一种细粒度的检测方案。
AI.method: 提出了RACE（Rhetorical Analysis for Creator-Editor Modeling）方法，利用修辞结构理论构建创作者逻辑图，并提取基本话语单元（EDU）级别的特征来刻画编辑者风格。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，RACE在识别四种细粒度文本类型方面优于12个基准模型，且误报率较低。
AI.conclusion: RACE方法通过对创作者逻辑和编辑者风格的建模，能够有效区分四类精细化的文本类型，为大模型生成内容的监管提供了更科学的解决方案。
AI.translation: 滥用大型语言模型（LLM）需要对合成文本进行精确检测。现有的工作主要遵循二元或三元分类设置，最多只能区分纯人类/LLM文本或协作文本。这对于细致的监管来说仍然是不够的，因为LLM润色过的人类文本和人类化处理后的LLM文本通常会触发不同的政策后果。在本文中，我们探索了严谨的四类设置下的细粒度LLM生成文本检测。为了处理这种复杂性，我们提出了RACE（创作者-编辑者建模的修辞分析），这是一种细粒度的检测方法，刻画了创作者和编辑者的独特特征。具体来说，RACE利用修辞结构理论构建创作者基础的逻辑图，同时提取基本话语单元级的特征来分析编辑者的风格。实验表明，RACE在识别细粒度类型方面优于12个基准模型，且误报率低，为LLM监管提供了符合政策的解决方案。
AI.summary: 针对现有大模型文本检测方法无法区分复杂协同文本的问题，本文提出了一种名为RACE的细粒度检测方法。该方法通过修辞结构理论对文本进行创作者逻辑和编辑者风格的建模，从而在四分类任务中实现了更精准的检测效果。
AI.keywords: 大模型检测, 细粒度分类, 修辞结构理论, 创作者-编辑者模型, 内容监管
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于跳出了传统的二元分类框架，引入了“创作者-编辑者”的双重角色模型，并结合了修辞结构理论（RST），为精细化的大模型文本检测提供了新的研究视角，具有很强的政策应用价值。

title: On the Eigenvalue Decay Rates of a Class of Neural-Network Related Kernel Functions Defined on General Domains
summary: In this paper, we provide a strategy to determine the eigenvalue decay rate (EDR) of a large class of kernel functions defined on a general domain rather than $\mathbb S^{d}$. This class of kernel functions include but are not limited to the neural tangent kernel associated with neural networks with different depths and various activation functions. After proving that the dynamics of training the wide neural networks uniformly approximated that of the neural tangent kernel regression on general domains, we can further illustrate the minimax optimality of the wide neural network provided that the underground truth function $f\in [\mathcal H_{\mathrm{NTK}}]^{s}$, an interpolation space associated with the RKHS $\mathcal{H}_{\mathrm{NTK}}$ of NTK. We also showed that the overfitted neural network can not generalize well. We believe our approach for determining the EDR of kernels might be also of independent interests.

AI.title_translation: 关于定义在一般域上的一类神经网络相关核函数的特征值衰减率研究
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种确定一般域上核函数特征值衰减率的方法，证明了宽神经网络的极小极大最优性，并揭示了过拟合导致的泛化失效问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的特征值衰减率研究多局限于超球面定义域，缺乏对更一般定义域下神经网络相关核函数的理论分析，且需要进一步阐明宽神经网络的泛化性能与最优性。
AI.method: 通过分析一般域上的核函数特征值衰减率，证明了宽神经网络训练动力学与核回归的均匀近似关系，并利用插值空间理论分析了神经网络的极小极大最优性。
AI.result: 确定了一类定义在一般域上的核函数特征值衰减率，证明了宽神经网络在特定函数空间下的极小极大最优性，并验证了过拟合神经网络泛化能力差的结论。
AI.conclusion: 论文成功建立了在一般域上确定核函数特征值衰减率的通用框架，论证了宽神经网络在特定插值空间下的极小极大最优性，并从理论上揭示了过拟合会导致泛化性能下降。
AI.translation: 在本文中，我们提供了一种策略，用于确定定义在一般域而非超球面 $\mathbb S^{d}$ 上的一大类核函数的特征值衰减率 (EDR)。这类核函数包括但不限于与不同深度和各种激活函数的神经网络相关的神经正切核 (NTK)。在证明了宽神经网络的训练动力学在一般域上一致近似于神经正切核回归的动力学后，我们进一步阐明了宽神经网络在真实函数 $f\in [\mathcal H_{\mathrm{NTK}}]^{s}$（与 NTK 的再生核希尔伯特空间 $\mathcal{H}_{\mathrm{NTK}}$ 相关联的插值空间）条件下的极小极大最优性。我们还证明了过拟合的神经网络无法实现良好的泛化。我们相信，我们确定核函数 EDR 的方法本身也具有研究价值。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种在一般定义域上确定核函数特征值衰减率的通用策略，该策略适用于包括神经正切核在内的多种神经网络核函数。研究表明，宽神经网络的训练动力学可由核回归近似，并证明了其在特定插值空间下的极小极大最优性，同时指出了过拟合对模型泛化能力的负面影响。
AI.keywords: 特征值衰减率, 神经正切核, 再生核希尔伯特空间, 泛化能力, 极小极大最优性
AI.comments: 该论文通过推广核函数定义域，为分析神经网络的泛化能力提供了更具普适性的理论工具。其创新点在于将特征值衰减率分析从超球面推广至一般域，并论证了过拟合神经网络的泛化局限性，对理解深度学习理论具有重要参考价值。

title: The Umeyama algorithm for matching correlated Gaussian geometric models in the low-dimensional regime
summary: Motivated by the problem of matching two correlated random geometric graphs, we study the problem of matching two Gaussian geometric models correlated through a latent node permutation. Specifically, given an unknown permutation $π^*$ on $\{1,\ldots,n\}$ and given $n$ i.i.d. pairs of correlated Gaussian vectors $\{X_{π^*(i)},Y_i\}$ in $\mathbb{R}^d$ with noise parameter $σ$, we consider two types of (correlated) weighted complete graphs with edge weights given by $A_{i,j}=\langle X_i,X_j \rangle$, $B_{i,j}=\langle Y_i,Y_j \rangle$. The goal is to recover the hidden vertex correspondence $π^*$ based on the observed matrices $A$ and $B$. For the low-dimensional regime where $d=O(\log n)$, Wang, Wu, Xu, and Yolou [WWXY22+] established the information thresholds for exact and almost exact recovery in matching correlated Gaussian geometric models. They also conducted numerical experiments for the classical Umeyama algorithm. In our work, we prove that this algorithm achieves exact recovery of $π^*$ when the noise parameter $σ=o(d^{-3}n^{-2/d})$, and almost exact recovery when $σ=o(d^{-3}n^{-1/d})$. Our results approach the information thresholds up to a $\operatorname{poly}(d)$ factor in the low-dimensional regime.

AI.title_translation: 低维情形下匹配相关高斯几何模型的Umeyama算法
AI.tldr: 本文从理论上证明了Umeyama算法在低维高斯几何图匹配任务中，能够在特定噪声条件下实现近乎最优的节点对应恢复。
AI.motivation: 针对两个通过潜在节点排列关联的随机几何图匹配问题，旨在探究经典的Umeyama算法在低维高斯几何模型中的理论性能界限，并验证其是否能达到信息论定义的恢复阈值。
AI.method: 通过理论分析证明了Umeyama算法在噪声参数σ满足特定低维条件（σ=o(d^-3 n^-2/d)用于精确恢复，σ=o(d^-3 n^-1/d)用于几乎精确恢复）时，能够成功恢复隐藏的节点排列π*。
AI.result: 证明了Umeyama算法在低维情形（d=O(log n)）下，在特定的噪声参数范围内能够实现精确及几乎精确的节点对应关系恢复，其性能与信息论阈值仅相差一个多项式因子。
AI.conclusion: Umeyama算法在低维高斯几何模型匹配中是有效的，其恢复性能在特定噪声条件下接近信息论阈值。
AI.translation: 受匹配两个相关随机几何图问题的启发，我们研究了通过潜在节点排列关联的两个高斯几何模型的匹配问题。具体而言，给定一个未知排列π*和n对在R^d中且具有噪声参数σ的独立同分布相关高斯向量对{X_π*(i), Y_i}，我们考虑两种类型的（相关）加权完全图，其边权重由A_{i,j}=<X_i, X_j>和B_{i,j}=<Y_i, Y_j>给出。目标是根据观测到的矩阵A和B恢复隐藏的顶点对应关系π*。对于d=O(log n)的低维情形，Wang, Wu, Xu和Yolou [WWXY22+]建立了匹配相关高斯几何模型中精确和几乎精确恢复的信息阈值。他们还对经典的Umeyama算法进行了数值实验。在我们的工作中，我们证明了当噪声参数σ=o(d^-3 n^-2/d)时，该算法可实现π*的精确恢复；当σ=o(d^-3 n^-1/d)时，可实现几乎精确恢复。我们的结果在低维情形下逼近了信息论阈值（相差一个poly(d)因子）。
AI.summary: 本文研究了在低维高斯几何模型中利用Umeyama算法匹配两个相关图的问题。作者证明了在d=O(log n)的低维条件下，该算法能够在特定的噪声水平内实现隐藏节点对应关系的精确和几乎精确恢复，证明了其性能接近信息论界限。
AI.keywords: 图匹配, 高斯几何模型, Umeyama算法, 节点排列, 信息论阈值
AI.comments: 该研究为Umeyama算法在图匹配问题中的表现提供了理论支撑。创新点在于将算法的性能界限与信息论阈值联系起来，证明了在低维情形下，该经典算法在特定噪声参数范围内能达到最优或近乎最优的恢复效果。其局限性在于结果仅限于低维情形（d=O(log n)），且与信息论阈值之间仍存在poly(d)的差距。

title: Tight Bounds on Polynomials and Its Application to Dynamic Optimization Problems
comments: Accepted to IEEE Transactions on Automatic Control
summary: This paper presents a pseudo-spectral method for Dynamic Optimization Problems (DOPs) that allows for tight polynomial bounds to be achieved via flexible sub-intervals. The proposed method not only rigorously enforces inequality constraints, but also allows for a lower cost in comparison with non-flexible discretizations. Two examples are provided to demonstrate the feasibility of the proposed method to solve optimal control problems. Solutions to the example problems exhibited up to a tenfold reduction in relative cost.
comment: Accepted to IEEE Transactions on Automatic Control

AI.title_translation: 多项式的紧密界限及其在动态优化问题中的应用
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于动态优化问题的伪谱方法，通过灵活的子区间实现紧密的多项式界限，有效处理不等式约束并显著降低成本。
AI.motivation: 开发一种能够实现紧密多项式界限、严格执行不等式约束并降低计算成本的动态优化问题解决方法。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种用于动态优化问题（DOPs）的伪谱方法，该方法通过灵活的子区间实现紧密的多项式界限。该方法还被用于解决最优控制问题，并通过两个例子进行验证。
AI.result: 所提出的方法不仅能严格执行不等式约束，而且与非灵活离散化相比，成本更低。示例问题解决方案显示相对成本降低高达十倍。
AI.conclusion: 该伪谱方法为动态优化问题提供了一种可行且高效的解决方案，能够实现紧密界限、严格处理约束并显著降低计算成本。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一种用于动态优化问题（DOPs）的伪谱方法，该方法通过灵活的子区间实现紧密的多项式界限。所提出的方法不仅能严格执行不等式约束，而且与非灵活离散化相比，成本更低。本文提供了两个例子来证明所提出方法解决最优控制问题的可行性。示例问题的解决方案显示相对成本降低高达十倍。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了一种针对动态优化问题的伪谱方法，该方法利用灵活的子区间实现紧密的多项式界限。该方法能够严格执行不等式约束，并相较于传统离散化方法显著降低成本。通过解决最优控制问题的两个示例，验证了该方法的有效性，并展示了高达十倍的相对成本降低。
AI.keywords: 伪谱方法, 动态优化问题, 紧密界限, 不等式约束, 成本降低
AI.comments: 这项研究提出了一种在动态优化领域具有潜力的伪谱方法，其创新点在于通过灵活子区间实现紧密界限，并能有效降低计算成本，特别是在处理不等式约束方面表现出色。成本降低高达十倍的成果表明了其重要的实际应用价值。

title: Promise of Graph Sparsification and Decomposition for Noise Reduction in QAOA: Analysis for Trapped-Ion Compilations
summary:
We develop new approximate compilation schemes that significantly reduce the expense of compiling the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) for solving the Max-Cut problem. Our main focus is on compilation with trapped-ion simulators using Pauli-$X$ operations and all-to-all Ising Hamiltonian $H_\text{Ising}$ evolution generated by Molmer-Sorensen or optical dipole force interactions, though some of our results also apply to standard gate-based compilations. Our results are based on principles of graph sparsification and decomposition; the former reduces the number of edges in a graph while maintaining its cut structure, while the latter breaks a weighted graph into a small number of unweighted graphs. Though these techniques have been used as heuristics in various hybrid quantum algorithms, there have been no guarantees on their performance, to the best of our knowledge. This work provides the first provable guarantees using sparsification and decomposition to improve quantum noise resilience and reduce quantum circuit complexity.
  For quantum hardware that uses edge-by-edge QAOA compilations, sparsification leads to a direct reduction in circuit complexity. For trapped-ion quantum simulators implementing all-to-all $H_\text{Ising}$ pulses, we show that for a $(1-ε)$ factor loss in the Max-Cut approximation ($ε>0)$, our compilations improve the (worst-case) number of $H_\text{Ising}$ pulses from $O(n^2)$ to $O(n\log(n/ε))$ and the (worst-case) number of Pauli-$X$ bit flips from $O(n^2)$ to $O\left(\frac{n\log(n/ε)}{ε^2}\right)$ for $n$-node graphs. We demonstrate significant reductions in noise are obtained in our new compilation approaches using theory and numerical calculations for trapped-ion hardware. We anticipate these approximate compilation techniques will be useful tools in a variety of future quantum computing experiments.

AI.title_translation: 图稀疏化和分解在QAOA降噪中的前景：对囚禁离子编译的分析
AI.tldr: 本研究开发了新的近似编译方案，通过图稀疏化和分解原则，显著降低了量子近似优化算法（QAOA）解决Max-Cut问题的编译成本和量子噪声，特别是在囚禁离子模拟器上，并首次提供了性能的理论保证。
AI.motivation: 量子近似优化算法（QAOA）的编译成本高昂，尤其是在囚禁离子模拟器上。此外，图稀疏化和分解技术虽被用作混合量子算法的启发式方法，但其性能缺乏理论保证。
AI.method: 本研究基于图稀疏化和分解原则，开发了新的近似编译方案。稀疏化减少图中的边数以保持其切割结构，而分解将加权图分解为少量无权图。这些技术用于改进QAOA的编译。
AI.result: 对于逐边QAOA编译，稀疏化直接降低了电路复杂度。对于实现全连接$H_\text{Ising}$脉冲的囚禁离子量子模拟器，在Max-Cut近似损失因子为$(1-ε)$的情况下，编译方案将$H_\text{Ising}$脉冲的最坏情况数量从$O(n^2)$降低到$O(n\log(n/ε))$，Pauli-$X$比特翻转的最坏情况数量从$O(n^2)$降低到$O\left(\frac{n\log(n/ε)}{ε^2}\right)$。理论和数值计算均表明，新的编译方法显著降低了噪声。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提出的近似编译技术通过图稀疏化和分解，为QAOA提供了降低量子噪声和电路复杂度的有效方法，特别适用于囚禁离子硬件，并首次提供了性能的理论保证。这些技术有望在未来的量子计算实验中发挥重要作用。
AI.translation:
我们开发了新的近似编译方案，这些方案显著降低了编译量子近似优化算法（QAOA）以解决Max-Cut问题的成本。我们的主要关注点是使用Pauli-$X$操作和由Molmer-Sorensen或光学偶极力相互作用产生的全连接Ising哈密顿量$H_\text{Ising}$演化在囚禁离子模拟器上进行编译，尽管我们的一些结果也适用于标准门基编译。我们的结果基于图稀疏化和分解原理；前者在保持图的切割结构的同时减少了图中的边数，而后者将加权图分解为少量无权图。尽管这些技术已在各种混合量子算法中用作启发式方法，但据我们所知，它们的性能一直没有得到保证。这项工作首次提供了使用稀疏化和分解来提高量子噪声弹性并降低量子电路复杂度的可证明保证。
对于使用逐边QAOA编译的量子硬件，稀疏化直接导致电路复杂度的降低。对于实现全连接$H_\text{Ising}$脉冲的囚禁离子量子模拟器，我们表明，在Max-Cut近似损失因子为$(1-ε)$（$ε>0$）的情况下，我们的编译方案将$H_\text{Ising}$脉冲的最坏情况数量从$O(n^2)$改进到$O(n\log(n/ε))$，并将$n$节点图的Pauli-$X$比特翻转的最坏情况数量从$O(n^2)$改进到$O\left(\frac{n\log(n/ε)}{ε^2}\right)$。我们通过理论和对囚禁离子硬件的数值计算证明，在我们的新编译方法中获得了显著的噪声降低。我们预计这些近似编译技术将在未来的各种量子计算实验中成为有用的工具。
AI.summary: 本论文提出了一种基于图稀疏化和分解的新型近似编译方案，旨在显著降低量子近似优化算法（QAOA）解决Max-Cut问题的编译成本和量子噪声，尤其是在囚禁离子量子模拟器上。研究首次为这些技术在提高量子噪声弹性和降低电路复杂度方面的性能提供了可证明的理论保证。结果表明，对于囚禁离子系统，该方案能将$H_\text{Ising}$脉冲和Pauli-$X$比特翻转的最坏情况数量从$O(n^2)$分别优化至$O(n\log(n/ε))$和$O\left(\frac{n\log(n/ε)}{ε^2}\right)$，从而实现显著的噪声降低。
AI.keywords: QAOA, 图稀疏化, 图分解, 囚禁离子, 噪声抑制
AI.comments: 本论文的创新之处在于首次为图稀疏化和分解在量子近似优化算法（QAOA）中的应用提供了严格的理论性能保证，这对于提高量子算法的噪声鲁棒性和降低电路复杂度具有重要意义。特别是在囚禁离子量子计算的背景下，它通过显著减少所需的操作次数，为实际量子硬件的编译效率和性能带来了实质性改进。这一工作为未来混合量子算法的设计和优化提供了坚实的理论基础和实用工具。

title: The optical architecture of a heterogenous quantum network deployed in production facilities
comments: 10 pages; reduced from the previous version due to the journal policy
summary: Quantum Communications promise advances in cryptography, quantum computing and clock synchronisation, among other emerging applications. However, communication based on quantum phenomena requires an extreme level of isolation from external disturbances, complicating the co-propagation of quantum and classical signals. The challenge is greater when deploying networks that are both heterogeneous (e.g., multiple vendors) and installed in production facilities, given that this type of infrastructure already supports networks loaded with their own requirements. Moreover, to achieve a broad acceptance among network operators, the joint management and operation of quantum and classical resources, compliance with standards, and legal and quality assurance need to be addressed. This article presents solutions to the aforementioned challenges validated in the Madrid quantum network during the implementation of the projects CiViC and OpenQKD. This network was designed to integrate quantum communications in the telecommunications ecosystem by installing quantum-key-distribution modules from multiple providers in production nodes of two different operators. The modules were connected through an optically-switched network with more than 130~km of deployed optical fibre. The tests were done in compliance with strict service level agreements that protected the legacy traffic of the pre-existing classical network. The goal was to ensure full quantum-classical interoperability at all levels, while limiting the modifications to optical transport and encryption and complying with relevant standards. This effort is intended to lay the foundation for large-scale quantum network deployments.
